John was playing with his toys in his bedroom. Suddenly he heard sirens outside. He looked out of his window and saw an ambulance. He was so excited and shouted out to his mom, "Mom look! An ambulance!" 
John's mom went to the window and looked outside. She said, "It's okay, John. The ambulance is here because they are helping someone who isn't feeling well".
John asked, "Can I go outside and watch?" His mother said, "Yes, but stay close. Let's be fair and let the ambulance finish its job".
John listened to his mother and watched closely. The ambulance finished helping the person who was not feeling well. After they drove away, John said to his mom, "I saw them finish helping the person who wasn't feeling well". His mom said, "Yes, you did. That was very fair of the ambulance."

Bob was running around the park. He quickly noticed a wire on the ground, but he kept running. He soon stumbled and fell over the wire. He felt sad, but decided to pick up the wire. It felt unique as he tried to twist it. 
Bob went over to his best friend and showed her the wire. "What should we do with it?" said Bob. His friend replied, "let's make something out of it". 
So Bob and his friend started heading back to Bob's house. On their way, they saw an old man walking slowly. Bob wanted to help the old man, so he and his friend started to twist the wire into a nice walking stick for the old man. 
The old man was very thankful, but just as he was about to walk away, he suddenly stumbled and fell. He was hurt and couldn't get back up. Bob's and his friend were very worried and it turned out the old man had a broken leg. 
Bob and his friend felt very bad that they had caused this accident. They had meant to help the old man, but instead had caused him trouble. They had to leave the old man lying on the ground and quickly ran away.

Once upon a time, there was a gifted princess. She lived in a big castle with her mom and dad. The princess loved to share her toys with her friends.
One day, the princess met a new friend. The friend said, "Can I play with you?" The princess said, "Yes! Let's share my toys and play together." They played with dolls, cars, and blocks. They had a lot of fun.
But then, something unexpected happened. The princess's new friend turned into a frog! The princess was surprised. She said, "You are a frog now, but I will still share my toys with you." So, the princess and the frog played together and shared the toys. They were happy and stayed friends forever.

Once upon a time, there was a cheerful girl named Lily. She lived in a small house with her mom and dad. Lily was always happy and loved to play with her friends.
One day, Lily went to a party for a marriage. She saw a little cat stuck in a tree. The cat was scared and needed help. Lily wanted to rescue the cat, so she called her dad. Her dad came and helped her save the cat from the tree.
After they rescued the cat, everyone at the marriage party clapped and cheered. The cat was very happy to be safe. Lily felt proud that she could help the cat. From that day on, Lily and the cat became best friends, and they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia was very hungry and wanted to eat her lunch. She asked her mom, "Mom, can I have my lunch now?"
Her mom said, "Yes, Mia. Let's make a light lunch together. We can have some yummy sandwiches." Mia was very happy and helped her mom make the sandwiches.
They sat down and ate their lunch. Mia was very careful not to spill anything on her dress. She loved her light lunch and said, "Thank you, Mom, for the yummy lunch!"
Her mom smiled and said, "You're welcome, Mia. I'm glad you liked it. I always care about making you happy."
And so, Mia and her mom had a great day together, enjoying their light lunch and taking care of each other.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a humble spider. The spider had a cobweb in the corner of the room. Every day, the spider would load her cobweb with food for her little baby spiders.
One day, a big wind came and blew the cobweb away. The spider and her babies were very sad. They had no home now. The spider tried to make a new cobweb, but she could not. She was too tired and hungry.
Then, a little girl saw the spider and her babies. The little girl felt sad for them. She helped the spider make a new cobweb in her room. The spider and her babies were happy again. They learned that if you are kind and humble, others will help you when you need it. And the little girl learned that even the smallest creatures need love and care.

Once there was a little girl named Jenny. She was walking in the park when she saw a sack on the ground. She was curious and wanted to know what was inside.
Jenny went to pick it up, but it was too heavy! She looked around for help, and thatâs when she saw a little puppy looking at her.
The puppy said, âHi Jenny, my name is Jack. Can I help you?â
Jenny smiled and said, âYes please! Can you help me carry this sack?â
Jack nodded his head and they both grabbed the sack together and carried it to a bench. They opened it up and found lots of toys inside. They had so much fun playing with the toys until they heard somebody call out âJenny?â
It was Jennyâs mom! Jenny and Jack quickly put the sack back together and Jenny said goodbye to Jack.
Jenny met a new furry friend that day, and she had a whole bunch of fun!

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the attic. Tim wanted to learn about the things in the attic. He saw a big box. The box was wet. Tim was sad because he did not like wet things.
Tim opened the wet box. Inside, he found a big, wet book. He opened the book and started to learn from it. The book had fun stories about animals and their friends.
Then, something unexpected happened. The wet book started to talk! The book said, "Thank you for opening me, Tim. I am a magic book!" Tim was so happy. He now had a new friend to help him learn. Together, they had lots of fun in the attic.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Mia wanted to make a great cake. She put all the things she needed in a big bowl. Mia mixed and mixed until it was ready. She was so happy and could not wait to eat the cake.
Mia put the cake in the hot oven to cook. She went to play with her toys while she waited. But, Mia forgot about the cake! The cake stayed in the oven for a very long time.
When Mia remembered the cake, she ran to the oven. She opened the oven door and saw the cake had started to melt! It was not a great cake anymore. Mia was sad, but then she had an idea. She took the melted cake and put it in a cup. She called it a "melted cake cup" and shared it with her friends. They all loved it and said it was the best thing they ever tasted. In the end, Mia was happy that her mistake made something new and yummy.

One day, a brown dog named Max went to play in the park. He saw a big hill with a top. Max wanted to go to the top of the hill.
Max met a cat named Lily. Lily said, "I want to go to the top too!" Max said, "Let's go together!" They walked and walked, but the top was far away. Max insisted, "We can do it!"
Finally, they reached the top of the hill. They saw a big, colorful box. Max and Lily opened the box, and inside were lots of toys! They played with the toys and shared them with their friends. The top of the hill was a fun place to be.

Anna and Ben are twins. They like to play and have fun. One day, they go with Mom and Dad to a restaurant. The restaurant has many people and many foods. Anna and Ben are hungry and excited.
They sit at a table and look at the menu. Anna wants pizza. Ben wants pasta. Mom and Dad want salad. They tell the waiter what they want. The waiter is kind and smiles. He says he will bring the food soon.
Anna and Ben wait and wait. They are bored. They want to eat. They see a big cake on a cart. The cake has candles and frosting. It looks yummy. Anna and Ben want the cake. They think it is for them.
They spring from their chairs and run to the cart. They try to grab the cake. But the cake is not for them. The cake is for another family. The family is celebrating a birthday. They are surprised and angry. They shout at Anna and Ben.
Mom and Dad hear the noise. They see Anna and Ben with the cake. They are shocked and sorry. They run to the cart and take Anna and Ben away. They say sorry to the family and the waiter. They say Anna and Ben are naughty and need to learn.
Anna and Ben are sad and ashamed. They cry and say sorry too. They do not want the cake anymore. They want to go home. They learn that they should not take things that are not theirs. They learn that they should wait and be patient. They learn that they should be kind to others.

Tom and Sue are friends. They like to play in the sand. They make a big castle with a flag. They are happy.
But then a big boy comes. He is mean. He kicks the castle and laughs. He says, "Your castle is stupid. You are stupid. Go away!"
Tom and Sue are sad and angry. They want to make him stop. They see a towel on the sand. It is wet and dirty. They have an idea.
They run to the big boy. They throw the towel on his head. They say, "You are stupid. You are wet. Go away!"
But the big boy is stronger. He takes the towel off his head. He is mad. He grabs Tom and Sue. He pushes them into the water. He says, "You are stupid. You are wet. You are cold. Go away!"
Tom and Sue are scared and cold. They cry for help. But no one hears them. They sink into the water. They cannot breathe. They die. The end.

One day, a girl named Amy wanted to go to the museum. She put on her shoes and went outside. The sun was up, and the day was dry. Amy felt happy and began to skip down the path.
On her way, she met a boy named Tom. Tom was also going to the museum. Amy said, "Hi, Tom! Let's go to the museum together!" Tom smiled and said, "Yes, let's go!" So, they both skipped down the path, side by side.
When they reached the museum, they saw many fun things. They saw big animals, pretty rocks, and old things. They played and learned a lot. After a fun day, Amy and Tom went home. They were happy they had gone to the museum and made a new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a small house near a church. Lily liked the church because it was calm and quiet. She would go there to play and sing songs.
One day, Lily's mom asked her to help unpack a box. Inside the box were toys and books. Lily was excited to find a new toy car. She showed it to her friend, Tim. "Look, Tim! I have a new car!" said Lily. Tim smiled and said, "Wow! It is nice!"
Together, Lily and Tim went to the church to play with the new car. They had fun racing it on the calm church floor. They laughed and played until it was time to go home. Lily was happy that she had helped her mom unpack and found a new toy to share with her friend.

Once upon a time, there was a big, dull box made of lumber. It lived in a forest with many trees. The box was not happy because it could not play with the other animals.
One day, a little boy came to the forest. He saw the big, dull box and wanted to make it happy. So, he thought of a way to make the box feel better. He decided to make the box melt and become something new.
The little boy got some sun rays and made them shine on the box. The box started to melt and became a beautiful, shiny puddle. The puddle was very happy and could now play with all the other animals in the forest. They all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a doctor. The doctor was very nice. He helped people when they were sick. One day, a naughty dog came to the doctor's place. The dog was making a big mess. The doctor was not happy.
The doctor wanted to make the naughty dog nice. He gave the dog a yummy treat. The dog liked the treat. The doctor said, "You need to be nice, not naughty." The dog wagged its tail and stopped being naughty.
Everyone saw the doctor help the naughty dog. They were very happy. They all clapped their hands. They said, "Yay! The doctor is so good!" The doctor and the dog smiled. They were happy too.

On the morning of February 8 , 1861 , Rector and Totten signed an agreement placing the arsenal in the hands of state officials . That afternoon , the citizen militia marched to the arsenal with Governor Rector at its head . All of the federal troops had left at this point , except Totten who had stayed behind to listen to the Governor 's speech and to hand the arsenal over in person .

One day, a little girl named Lucy wanted to make toast. She asked her mom for help. Her mom said, "Okay, let's go to the kitchen." They walked to the kitchen together.
Lucy and her mom took out the bread. They put the bread in the toaster. They pushed the button and waited for the toast to be ready. Lucy was very excited.
When the toast popped up, Lucy and her mom took it out. They put butter and jam on the toast. They took a bite and it was delicious. Lucy was so happy she made toast with her mom. They enjoyed their yummy toast together.

One day, a girl named Lily went to the market with her mom. They wanted to sell some pretty flowers from their garden. Lily saw a big bush with very attractive red flowers. She told her mom, "I want to sell these pretty red flowers!"
Her mom said, "Okay, let's pick some flowers from the bush and take them to the market." They picked the flowers and went to the market. They put the flowers on a table and waited for people to come and buy them.
Soon, a nice lady came and said, "Oh, these red flowers are so pretty! I want to buy them all." Lily and her mom were very happy. They sold all the attractive red flowers from the bush. They went home and told their family about their fun day at the market.

Once upon a time, there was a pilot named Tim. Tim was very serious about his job. He loved to fly big planes in the sky. One day, Tim met a pretty girl named Sue. Sue was nice and she liked Tim too.
Tim said to Sue, "I have to fly a big plane today. Will you come with me?" Sue said, "Yes, I would love to go with you." So, they went to the big plane and Tim flew it high in the sky. Sue was happy and she felt safe with Tim.
As they flew in the sky, Tim looked at Sue and said, "I have a surprise for you, but it will come later." Sue was excited and could not wait for the surprise. When they landed, Tim kissed Sue on the cheek. Sue blushed and smiled. She knew that the surprise was the kiss and she was very happy. Tim and Sue became the best of friends and they flew together every day.

Sara and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big white dog. The dog is friendly. He wags his tail and licks their faces.
"Can we pet him?" Sara asks.
"Yes, he is nice. His name is Spot," a man says. He is the dog's owner.
Sara and Tom pet Spot. They rub his ears and his belly. Spot is happy. He barks and jumps.
"Can we play with him?" Tom asks.
"Sure, you can. He likes to fetch and run," the man says. He gives them a ball.
Sara and Tom throw the ball. Spot runs and catches it. He brings it back. They do this many times.
But then, Spot sees a squirrel. He drops the ball and chases the squirrel. He runs very fast.
"Spot, come back!" the man calls.
But Spot does not listen. He wants to catch the squirrel.
"Spot, stop!" Sara and Tom shout.
But Spot does not stop. He runs out of the park. He crosses the street.
"Spot, no!" the man yells.
But Spot does not hear. He is too busy.
A car is coming. It is big and loud. It honks its horn.
"Spot, look out!" Sara and Tom scream.
But Spot does not look. He is too excited.
The car brakes. It skids. It stops.
Spot is safe. He is not hurt. He is lucky.
The man runs to Spot. He hugs him. He scolds him.
"Spot, you are a bad dog. You could have been hit by the car. You could have died. You must never run away like that. You must listen to me. Do you understand?" the man says.
Spot looks at the man. He looks sorry. He wags his tail. He licks his face.
"I'm sorry, Spot. I love you. But you have to be careful. You have to obey me. OK?" the man says.
Spot nods. He barks. He agrees.
Sara and Tom run to Spot. They hug him. They are glad he is OK.
"Spot, you are a good dog. But you are also a silly dog. You scared us. You made us worry. You have to be smart. You have to stay with us. OK?" Sara and Tom say.
Spot nods. He barks. He agrees.
They all go back to the park. They play with the ball. They have fun.
Spot does not chase squirrels. He does not run away. He does not refuse to listen.
He stays with his friends. He is a happy dog.

Once upon a time, there was a little car named Speedy. Speedy was a nervous car, always scared to go fast. One day, Speedy's friend, a big truck named Buddy, asked him to go on a race.
Speedy was very nervous, but he wanted to try. They started the race, and Speedy went as fast as he could. Buddy was going faster, but Speedy did not give up. He tried and tried to catch up with Buddy.
At the end of the race, Speedy finally arrived at the finish line. He did not win, but he was happy that he tried his best. Speedy was not so nervous anymore, and he couldn't wait to race again.

Sara and Ben are twins. They like to play with their toys and their dog, Spot. One day, their mom gives them a camera. She says they can take pictures of anything they want.
"Wow, a camera!" Sara says. "Let's go outside and take pictures of the flowers and the birds."
"Okay!" Ben says. "And we can take pictures of Spot, too. He is very funny."
They run outside with the camera and Spot. They see many pretty things. They take turns to hold the camera and press the button. They hear a click sound when they take a picture.
"Look, a butterfly!" Sara says. She points to a yellow and black butterfly on a pink flower. She gives the camera to Ben. "You take a picture of it."
Ben holds the camera and tries to aim at the butterfly. He presses the button. But the butterfly flies away.
"Oh no!" Ben says. "I missed it."
Sara hugs him. "It's okay. Maybe we can find another butterfly. Or we can take a picture of something else."
They look around and see Spot. He is chasing his own tail. He is spinning and spinning. He looks very silly.
"Let's take a picture of Spot!" Sara says. She takes the camera from Ben. She aims at Spot and presses the button. She hears a click sound.
But Spot stops spinning. He looks at the camera. He blinks. He thinks the camera is a toy. He runs towards Sara and Ben. He jumps on them. He licks their faces.
"Spot, no!" Sara says. "You are making us wet."
"Spot, stop!" Ben says. "You are messing up the camera."
They laugh and push Spot away. They look at the camera. They see a picture of Spot on the screen. He is blinking and smiling.
"Wow, what a lucky picture!" Sara says. "Spot looks very cute."
"Yes, he does!" Ben says. "We have a lucky camera. And a lucky dog."
They hug Spot and the camera. They are very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a wise old frog who lived in a pond. Every morning, the frog would wake up and jump from one lily pad to another. One day, a little duck came to the pond to play.
"Hello, wise frog," said the duck. "Can you teach me how to jump like you?"
The wise frog smiled and said, "Yes, little duck. I can show you how to jump. But first, you must wake up early and come to the pond when the sun is up."
The next day, the little duck woke up early and went to the pond. The wise frog showed the duck how to jump from one lily pad to another. They had fun playing and jumping all day.
From that day on, the little duck and the wise frog became good friends. They would wake up early every day and play at the pond until the sun went down. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a long chimney on a little house. The house was in a big yard with lots of trees and flowers. The chimney was very tall and it liked to talk to the birds that sat on it.
One day, a little bird came to sit on the chimney. The bird said, "Hello, chimney! How are you today?" The chimney was happy to have a friend and replied, "I am good, little bird. How are you?" The bird was also happy and replied, "I am good too, thank you!"
The little bird and the long chimney became good friends. They talked and played every day. The bird told the chimney about the sky and the clouds, and the chimney told the bird about the house and the yard. They were very happy to have each other as friends.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby cat named Kitty. Kitty lived in a big classroom with lots of toys and friends. Kitty loved to play with her friends and learn new things every day.
One day, Kitty's favorite toy went missing. It was a soft, blue ball. Kitty was very sad and wanted to find it. So, she started to search the classroom. She looked under the chairs, behind the door, and inside the toy box.
Finally, Kitty found her blue ball under a big, red pillow. She was so happy! Kitty played with her ball and shared it with her friends. They all had a great time together in the classroom. And from that day on, Kitty always put her toys away so she would never have to search for them again.

Earlier that morning , at 04 : 45 , B and D Companies 3 RAR had moved north across the valley , while Anti-Tank Platoon crossed the Imjin , taking up positions further north in order to protect the right flank . The assaulting companies would then move west towards a series of objectives before assaulting Hill 317 . Initially 3 RAR was to attack from the east , while 1 RNF would attack from the southwest through Hill 217 , however with the Fusiliers facing stiff resistance on Hill 217 itself they were unable to get forward to assist . The previous attempts to capture Maryang San had failed due to the approach to steep eastern slopes of the feature being across a wide , open valley that was dominated by enfilade fire from mutually supporting Chinese positions . Consequently , the Australians planned to cross the valley under cover of darkness and position themselves on the Chinese flank in the foothills , before scaling the position at first light . A Company would create a diversion on the left flank , while B Company would clear the lower slopes before D Company passed through to assault the Chinese main defensive position , known as the ' Victor ' feature , in a one-up , one-in-depth assault . However , following the casualties of previous nights on Hill 199 , 220 and 355 , and the effect of constant shelling , 3 RAR was now reduced to just 320 men . In contrast , the Australians faced two fresh Chinese battalions on Maryang San , in total about 1, 200 men .

On 29 March 2016 , Vistara inaugurated premium lounge service for its Business-class passengers and Club Vistara Gold card holders at the departure level of Terminal 3 of Indira Gandhi International Airport at Delhi . Once upon a time, there was a boy called Tobi who lived in a small village. One day, it was very gloomy outside and Tobi was feeling sad. He wanted to have some fun, so he asked his mum for something to do.
His mum said, "Ok, Tobi, why don't you go to the store and see if they have something for you?â
So Tobi put on an apron and went to the store. When he got there, the store keeper said, "Tobi, I have something special for you. I can supply you with a new toy that will make you very happy!"
Tobi was so excited and he thanked the store keeper. He quickly rush back home and when he got there, the sun was shining and Tobi was all smiles! He showed his mum the new toy and she was very happy too. 
The gloom had been gone and all thanks to the friendly store keeper and his special supply.

Once, there was a girl named Lily. She wanted to introduce her new friend, Ben, to her mom. Ben was a deep blue bear. Lily loved to give Ben a massage to make him feel good.
One day, Lily and Ben went to see her mom. Lily said, "Mom, this is Ben, my new friend." Her mom looked at Ben and said, "Hello, Ben. Nice to meet you." 
But then, Lily's dog, Max, came into the room. Max saw Ben and thought he was a toy. Max grabbed Ben with his teeth and ran away. Lily and her mom tried to catch Max, but they couldn't. Ben was gone, and Lily was very sad.

Once upon a time, there was a bright woman named Jane. She loved to catch bugs in her big net. One day, Jane went to the park to look for bugs.
At the park, Jane saw a little girl named Sue. Sue was sad. "Why are you sad?" Jane asked. Sue said, "I lost my ball, and I can't find it." Jane wanted to help, so they looked for the ball together.
As they looked, Jane's net caught something. It was not a bug, but Sue's ball! Sue was so happy. "Thank you, Jane!" Sue said. They played with the ball and caught bugs together all day.

One day, a big cat and a little mouse were in a kitchen. They saw a jar on the top of a shelf. The jar was full of yummy cookies. The cat and the mouse wanted the cookies, but they could not reach the jar.
The mouse said to the cat, "I have an idea! You lift me up, and I will get the jar." The cat lifted the mouse up, but they still could not reach the jar. They needed help.
A deaf dog walked into the kitchen. The cat and the mouse told the dog about the jar. The dog could not hear them, but he saw them trying to get the jar. The dog wanted the cookies too. The dog, the cat, and the mouse worked together to prevent the jar from falling. They got the jar down safely and shared the cookies. They were all happy and became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a small chair in a distant room. The chair was all alone and wished to have a friend. It was a very quiet room, and the chair was sad.
One day, a little girl named Lily came into the room. She saw the chair and said, "Hello, chair! Do you want to be my friend?" The chair felt happy and nodded. Lily sat on the chair and they played together.
After some time, Lily heard her mom calling her. "Lily, come here!" She had to go, but she told the chair, "Don't be sad. I will come back soon." The chair knew that it would have a friend when Lily came back. And from that day on, the chair was never lonely again.

One day, a fisherman went to the sea. He wanted to catch fish. He had a big net to catch many fish. The sun was bright, and the sea was calm. The fisherman was happy.
As the fisherman was catching fish, he saw a big fish in his net. The big fish said, "Please let me go. I am sorry for going into your net." The fisherman felt sorry for the big fish. He let the big fish go back into the sea.
The fisherman went home with his fish. When he got home, he saw that all his fish were gone. The big fish had eaten them all. The fisherman was sad and sorry that he let the big fish go. The fisherman had no fish to eat or sell.

Ben and Lily were twins who liked to play in the park. One day, they saw a big maze made of bushes and flowers. They wanted to try it and find the way out.
"Let's go, Ben!" Lily said. "It looks fun!"
"OK, Lily!" Ben said. "But we have to stay together. The maze is big and we might get lost."
They ran into the maze and followed the paths. They saw many colors and shapes, but they did not see the exit. They turned left and right, but they only found more bushes and flowers.
After a while, they felt dizzy and tired. They did not know where they were or how to get out. They started to cry.
"Help! Help!" they shouted. "We are lost in the maze!"
No one heard them. They felt scared and alone.
Then, they heard a splash. They looked around and saw a fountain with water. The water was sparkling and cool. They ran to the fountain and drank some water. They felt better.
They also saw a sign next to the fountain. It said: "This way to the exit." They followed the sign and soon they saw the end of the maze. They were happy and relieved.
They ran out of the maze and hugged each other. They also saw their mom and dad waiting for them. They were worried and angry.
"Where were you, Ben and Lily?" mom asked. "We were looking for you everywhere. You should not go into the maze without us. It is dangerous and you could get hurt."
"We are sorry, mom and dad," Ben and Lily said. "We wanted to have fun, but we got lost and dizzy. We learned our lesson. We will not go into the maze again without you."
Mom and dad hugged them and forgave them. They also praised them for finding the fountain and the sign. They said they were brave and smart.
Ben and Lily felt happy and loved. They learned that the maze was not as fun as they thought, and that they should always listen to their parents and stay together. They also learned that water can help them when they are thirsty and dizzy. They thanked the fountain and the sign for helping them. They went home and had a nice nap.

One day, a cool cat named Tom found a shiny medal in his yard. He wanted to show it to his best friend, a dog named Max. Tom ran to Max's house with the medal. Max was so happy to see the shiny medal. Tom said, "Look, Max! I found a cool medal!"
Max wanted to wear the medal. Max said, "Please, Tom, can I wear the medal?" Tom said, "Yes, Max, you can wear the medal." Max put the medal on and felt very proud. They played in the yard, wearing the cool medal.
Suddenly, a big bird came and took the medal from Max's neck. Max and Tom were very sad. They asked the bird, "Please, give the medal back." The bird said, "I will give the medal back if you play a game with me." Tom and Max played the game with the bird, and they won! The bird gave the cool medal back to them. They were so happy and played together all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a musician. He loved to play his blue guitar. Every day, he played songs for all his friends. They loved to hear him play.
One day, the musician needed a new guitar string. He went to the store to buy one. When he got back, he saw that his blue guitar was gone. He was very sad and didn't know what to do.
Then, a little bird flew by and said, "I know where your guitar is!" The musician followed the bird. They found his blue guitar by a big tree. The bird had taken it to play music too! The musician was happy and played a song with the bird. They became best friends and played music together every day.

One day, a lively bunny named Bob was hopping in the garden. He saw a big broccoli plant. He wanted to eat it, but he knew it was not his.
Bob saw his friend, a bird named Sue. Sue was flying in the sky. Bob called out, "Sue, can you help me? I want to eat the broccoli, but it is not mine."
Sue flew down and said, "Bob, we should not destroy the plant. Let's ask the farmer if we can have some." They went to the farmer and asked if they could eat the broccoli.

Although DuMont 's programming pre-dated videotape , many DuMont offerings were recorded on kinescopes . These kinescopes were said to be stored in a warehouse until the 1970s . Actress Edie Adams , the wife of comedian Ernie Kovacs ( both regular performers on early television ) testified in 1996 before a panel of the Library of Congress on the preservation of television and video . Adams claimed that so little value was given to these films that the stored kinescopes were loaded into three trucks and dumped into Upper New York Bay . Nevertheless , a number of DuMont programs survive at The Paley Center for Media in New York City , the UCLA Film and Television Archive in Los Angeles , in the Peabody Awards Collection at the University of Georgia , and the Museum of Broadcast Communications in Chicago .

Once upon a time, there was a friendly dog named Spot. Spot lived in a little house with a big heart on the door. Spot loved to play with his ball and run all around the yard. One day, a cat named Fluffy came to visit. Fluffy was very shy and did not want to play with Spot.
Spot said, "Come play with me, Fluffy!" But Fluffy was scared and hid behind a tree. Spot did not want Fluffy to be scared, so he tried to be very quiet. But then, Spot saw a big bird in the sky and he could not help but yell, "Look, a bird!"
Fluffy got very scared when Spot yelled. She ran away from the little house with the heart on the door. Spot was sad that Fluffy ran away. He looked for her but could not find her. Spot went back to his little house and hoped that one day, Fluffy would come back to play. But Fluffy never came back, and Spot was sad forever.

Once upon a time there were two friends - Bob and Dave. They were playing together in the park. Suddenly, Bob found a strange object on the ground. He picked it up and shouted, "What is this thing? It looks like a weapon!" Dave replied, "Be careful! Put it down!"

Once upon a time, there was a big, strong whale named Willy. Willy lived in the deep blue sea with his family. He loved to swim and play with his friends all day long.

One day, a duck went to the pond. The duck was tired. The duck saw a frog. The frog was wearing a hat. The duck said, "I like your hat."
The frog said, "Thank you, I found it in the pond. Do you want to wear a hat too?" The duck said, "Yes, I want to wear a hat." So, the frog and the duck looked for a hat in the pond for the duck to wear.

Once upon a time, there was a big kitchen where many animals cooked food. A big bear, named Ben, and a small mouse, named Max, were best friends. They liked to cook together. Ben was very strong and could weigh heavy things. Max was tiny, but he was fast and could reach small places.

Later that day, a big pot fell from the shelf. It was too heavy for anyone to lift. Max tried, but he couldn't do it. Then, Ben came and used his strength to weigh the pot. He put it back on the shelf. Everyone clapped and thanked Ben. Max said, "See? You are important, too."
Ben smiled and hugged Max. They learned that everyone is special in their own way. They worked together in the kitchen, and they were the best friends forever.

Once there was a boy named Tom. Tom wanted to get a chocolate from his mum, but his mum said no. Tom was very disappointed, but he tried to ignore it.
Tom's mum said, "Tom, you don't need chocolate. It's not good for you. Eat something healthy."
Tom was sad but he decided to try something else. He climbed a high tree in the garden. But when he got to the top, he realised it was too high and he was scared. So he decided to ignore his fear and slowly climbed down. 
When Tom reached the bottom, his mum hugged him and said "I'm very proud of you for not ignoring your fear and climbing down. That takes a lot of courage."

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a big piano. A little girl named Amy lived there. She was fearful of the piano because it made loud noises.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sally. Sally loved to grab her toys and play with them. Her favorite day to play was Wednesday because her mom said it was an important day. Sally didn't know why, but she liked it a lot.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a lot of stuff in his room. One day, Tim decided to play a game. He wanted to hide all his stuff from his mom. Tim thought it would be fun to see if his mom could find everything.
Tim hid his stuff all over the house. He put some under the bed, some in the closet, and some behind the couch. When his mom came home, she was very confused. She could not find any of Tim's stuff. She asked Tim if he knew where everything was. Tim just smiled and said, "I hid it all!"

When the World Rankings were introduced in October 2003 , England was ranked 1st . They briefly fell to 2nd in September that year before regaining 1st place . They fell to 2nd , and then to 3rd in June 2004 . After the 2005 Six Nations they fell to 6th where they remained until they moved into 5th in December that year . In 2006 , their ranking again fell and they finished the year ranked 7th . 2007 saw them bounce back to 3rd after their good run in that year 's World Cup , where they finished Runners Up . In 2008 , their rankings slipped so that during the 2009 Six Nations Championship they dropped to their lowest ranking of 8th . They again were 8th during the autumn internationals of the same year . After a resurgence which saw them rise to a ranking of 4th in the world , the team again slipped , following a poor showing at the 2011 Rugby World Cup , and was ranked 6th in February 2012 . England entered the 2015 Rugby World Cup ranked 4th . However , after failing to exit the pool stage , England were ranked 8th in the world as of 1 November 2015 .

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim lived near a big forest. One day, he wanted to send a letter to his friend, who lived on the other side of the forest.

Don 't take it personally is a visual novel , or interactive fiction game where the majority of the story is told through still images of the speaking characters in front of anime-style backgrounds with text overlaid . The player 's viewpoint follows one character , the teacher in a school , with the player seeing his thoughts as well as his and the other characters ' statements . The player advances the conversations the teacher is in or witnesses at will , but cannot go backwards and has little control over what any of the characters , including the teacher , are saying except at a few key moments . At these points , the player is presented with two or three choices for what the teacher says ; which option is chosen can change what path the plot takes , in either a minor or major way .

Once upon a time, there was a big bear named Ben. Ben loved to play in the woods. One day, he saw a clear sign. The sign said, "Be kind to your friends." This sign reminded Ben to be nice to everyone.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a red bike with pedals. He loved to ride his bike all day.

Once, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to play games. One day, he went to a big fair with his mom and dad. There were many fun games to play. Tim saw a game where he could win a prize. He wanted to try it.

Once upon a time there lived a kind and compassionate butterfly. Her name was Mimi and she loved to fly around and explore the world. 
One day, Mimi spotted a group of tiny flowers in a meadow. They were all tangled up together and were sadly unable to bloom. Mimi wanted to help so she fluttered herself softly down to the flowers and spoke tenderly to them.

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful cat named Lily. Lily lived in a big house with her friend, a funny dog named Max. They liked to play and joke with each other all day.

Once upon a time, there was a young farmer. He lived on a small farm and he had only one sheep. One day, he went out to the field to look for his sheep.
He saw it grazing in the grass and called out, "Hello, little sheep!"
The sheep turned and said, "Baa!"
The farmer laughed and said, "Would you like to come with me?"
The sheep nodded and followed the farmer back to the barn.
The farmer said, "I'm going to give you some food." He filled up a bowl with hay and the sheep ate it quickly.
The farmer smiled and petted the sheep's head. He said, "Good job, little sheep!"
The sheep was happy and started to bleat.
The farmer said, "It looks like you're doing very well! I'm glad I gave you a home."
The young sheep was grateful and the farmer was glad too. They continued to take care of each other every day.

Once upon a time, there was a fat cat named Kitty. Kitty lived in a big, safe house with her best friend, a little girl named Sue. They loved to play together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a messy boy named Tim. He had a red wagon that he loved. Tim would put all his toys in the wagon and pull it around. One day, Tim wanted to invite his friends to play with him and his wagon.

Crash Boom Bang ! ' s stages resemble board games , as each play area is split into a number of squares . The game takes place among four players , with the computer assigned to spare players . All players simultaneously roll dice . The number each player rolls is the amount of squares they move forward . Depending on the type of square that the player lands on , Wumpa Fruit ( which is used as points during the race ) can be won or lost , an item can be obtained , a special event might be triggered , or a mini-game might commence . If a player lands on a fork in the road , the player will have to select the desired direction with either the stylus or the control pad .

Once there was a seed. The seed sat in the ground, alone in the dirt. The sun shone down on the seed, and it began to grow. Up it grew until it became a tall celery plant.
The celery was green and tall, and it grew until it was time to pick it. Someone plucked the celery from the ground and found it was very sweet. They chopped it up and made a delicious salad.
The celery tasted so sweet. Everyone enjoyed eating it. Even the little children liked it. They ate the celery and had a wonderful meal.
After they finished the salad, they buried some of the seeds in the ground. Soon they grew into a new celery plant. This next one grew just as sweet as the old one. The celery kept growing and growing, making everyone happy!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. He lived in a small house with his mom and dad. One day, Tom's mom said, "Tom, do you remember the white landscape we saw last winter?" Tom nodded his head and smiled.
Tom and his mom went outside to play in the snow. The ground was white and the trees were white too. They made a big snowman with a hat and a scarf. Tom said, "Look mom, our snowman is so big and white!"
As they played, a friendly dog came to join them. The dog wagged its tail and barked, "Woof! Woof!" Tom laughed and said, "Hi doggy, do you like the white landscape too?" The dog barked again and ran around in the snow.
Tom, his mom, and the dog played in the white landscape all day. They had lots of fun making snow angels and throwing snowballs. When it was time to go inside, Tom said, "I will always remember this day."
That night, Tom went to bed with a big smile on his face. He dreamt of the white landscape, the snowman, and the friendly dog. It was a day he would never forget.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy animals. One day, he found a small, round thing in his toy box. He did not know what it was.

Once upon a time, there was a big building. In the building, there was an elevator. The elevator would go up and down to help people get to different floors. One day, a fierce dog went inside the building. The dog was big and loud, but it was also lost and scared.

Once there was a little girl. Her name was Sarah. Every day, Sarah loved to play in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a brown mule. He lived on a farm with other animals. The brown mule loved to play with his friends, the cows and the sheep.

Once upon a time, there was an elderly lady named Sue. She had a long cord in her house. Sue liked to pretend with the cord.
One day, Sue took the cord and pretended it was a big snake. She made the cord snake wiggle and dance. Sue had lots of fun with her pretend snake.
The next day, Sue used the cord to pretend it was a jump rope. She played and jumped with the cord all day. Sue loved to pretend with her cord and have fun.

Tom and Mia like to play hockey with their friends. They have sticks and a ball and they run on the grass. They try to hit the ball into the net. Sometimes they score and sometimes they miss.
One day, they play hockey near a pond. The pond has water and fish and ducks. It is deep and cold. Tom and Mia are careful not to go too close to the pond. They do not want to fall in.
But then, Tom sees a big duck on the pond. The duck has a ball in its mouth. It is their ball! The duck took their ball and swam away. Tom is angry. He wants his ball back.
He runs to the pond and shouts at the duck. He waves his stick and tries to scare the duck. But the duck does not listen. It swims faster and farther. Tom follows the duck. He forgets to be careful.
Mia sees Tom go too close to the pond. She is scared. She calls Tom to stop. She tells him to come back. But Tom does not hear her. He only sees the duck and the ball.
He reaches the edge of the pond and leans over. He tries to grab the ball from the duck. But the duck is clever. It releases the ball and bites Tom's hand. Tom screams and drops his stick. He loses his balance and falls into the pond.
Mia runs to help Tom. She sees him splash and cry in the water. She grabs his stick and pulls him out. She hugs him and tells him to calm down. She says he is lucky. The pond is deep and he could have drowned.
Tom is wet and cold and sore. He is sorry for being silly. He says thank you to Mia for saving him. He says sorry to the duck for being mean. He does not care about the ball anymore. He just wants to go home and get warm and dry.
Mia and Tom walk back to their friends. They tell them what happened. Their friends are glad they are okay. They say they can share their ball and play hockey together. They say they will not go near the pond again. They say they will be careful and have fun.

Once there lived two friends named Jack and Jane. They had always loved to visit each other and always enjoyed their cheerful visits.
One day, Jack noticed something was wrong with Jane. He asked her what was the matter but she didn't say anything, only shook her head sadly.
Jack was really worried so he asked her if he could come and visit her. But Jane said "No" and shook her head again. Jack asked if he could help in any way but Jane said nothing and gave him a sad look.
So, Jack tried his best to cheer Jane up but she just stayed silent. He said goodbye sadly and started to walk away.
Suddenly he noticed that Jane was in tears. He felt really bad for her and went back to her, but it was too late. Jane told him she was too sad and had decided to leave. Jack felt so sad and said goodbye again.
After that, they never visited each other again.

Once upon a time, there was a little, honest boy named Tim. Tim loved to draw patterns with his crayons. He liked to make circles, squares, and triangles. Tim's patterns were very pretty and colorful.

Once upon a time, in a small cabin in the woods, there lived a kind old man. The old man was deaf, but he was very wise. He had a dog named Buddy, who was his best friend. Buddy was a good dog who always behaved well.

Once upon a time, in a large country, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy loved to dream. Every night, she would close her eyes and dream of fun things. One day, Amy told her mom that she had a dream about a big, shiny ball. Her mom smiled and said, "Maybe one day, you will find it."

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to climb on everything. One day, Tim found a big letter on the floor. The letter was the letter "A". Tim was very enthusiastic about it. He wanted to show it to his friend, Sam.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy named Tim. He loved to watch planes fly in the sky. One day, he woke up early to see the big planes.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jack who had a very special coat. One day, he wore his coat and went out for a walk. He came to a field where there was a group of birds chirping and singing.
Jack wanted to talk to the birds, so he said, "Hello, little birds! Can you talk to me?"
The birds were a bit scared, so they just chirped. But then one of them said, "Yes, we can talk! What do you want to know?"

The birds flew around his coat and then one of them said, "Your coat is blue! You must be very gifted to be able to talk to us!"
Jack beamed with pride and said, "Yes, I am gifted! Thank you birds, for talking to me!" Then, he went back home with a big smile on his face.

One day, a boy and his mom went to the museum. The boy felt proud because he was a big boy now. He could see big and fun things in the museum. The mom said, "We have to wait for dad. He is delayed at work."
While they waited, the boy saw a big red button. He wanted to push it. His mom said, "No! Don't push the button." But the boy did not listen. He pushed the button. 
Boom! The museum lights went off. Everyone was sad and scared. The boy felt bad for not listening to his mom. The moral is to always listen to your mom and dad.

Once upon a time, in a tidy little house, there lived a boy named Tim. Tim had a big toy box full of fun toys. His favorite toy was a long, colorful tube. Tim loved to play with the tube all day long.
One sunny morning, Tim took his tube outside to play. He saw his friend, Sarah, in her yard. "Look at my tube!" Tim said to Sarah. "It's so big and fun!" Sarah smiled and said, "Wow! Can I play with it too?" Tim nodded, and they both played with the tube together.
As they played, they saw the sun rise high in the sky. The tube made fun shadows on the ground. Tim and Sarah laughed and played until they were tired. Then, they went inside Tim's tidy house for a snack. They were happy to have spent the day playing with the tube and watching the sun rise.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a girl named Mia. Mia loved to perform for her friends and family. She would dance and sing for them all the time. One day, Mia's mom told her, "Mia, you are so good at performing, you should share your talent with everyone in town!"
Mia thought this was a great idea. So, she and her mom made a plan. They would invite everyone in town to a big show in the park. Mia's mom would make chocolate treats for everyone to eat while they watched Mia perform. Mia was so excited!
The day of the show came, and it was a little bit icy outside. But that didn't stop Mia! She put on her warmest clothes and went to the park with her mom. When they got there, they saw that many people had come to watch Mia perform. Mia's mom passed out the chocolate treats to everyone, and they all sat down to watch.
Mia started to dance and sing, and everyone clapped and cheered. Even though it was icy, everyone was having a great time. Mia felt so happy that she could share her talent with everyone she knew. After the show, Mia's friend said, "Mia, you are the best performer ever! Thank you for sharing your talent with us!"
From that day on, Mia knew that she could bring happiness to others by performing. And she never let a little icy weather stop her from sharing her love of dance and song with her friends, family, and the whole town.

One day, a gray cat was walking down the road. The cat saw a big bus. The bus had a nice driver. The driver said, "Hello, cat! Do you want to ride the bus?" The cat said, "Yes, please!"
The driver let the cat sit in the front seat. The cat was very happy. The driver started to read a big book. The book had lots of words and pictures. The cat liked the pictures. The driver read the words out loud. The cat listened and smiled.
Then, something unexpected happened. The cat said, "I can read too!" The driver was very surprised. The cat read the book with the driver. They read and read until the bus reached the end of the road. The cat and the driver became good friends. They read books together every day.

One day, a little girl named Mia was playing in her room. She had many toys, but her room was not organized. Her mom told her, "Mia, you must clean up your toys."
Mia did not want to clean up her toys. She wanted to go outside and play with her friends. So, she left her room and went outside. She played all day and had fun.
When Mia came home, she saw her toys all over her room. She felt regret for not cleaning up her toys. She said to her mom, "I am sorry, Mom. I will clean up my room now."
Mia and her mom cleaned up the room together. They made the room organized and nice. Mia was happy to have a clean room and promised to keep it that way.

Once upon a time, there was a little orange taxi. The taxi loved to drive around the town and help people. One day, it rained a lot, and the taxi got all wet.
After the rain stopped, the sun came out. The taxi wanted to dry, so it drove under the sun. As it drove, the taxi saw a girl named Lily. She was sad because she was wet from the rain too.
The taxi stopped and said, "Hi, Lily! I can help you get dry. Let's drive under the sun together." Lily smiled and got into the taxi. They drove around town, and soon both the taxi and Lily were dry and happy. From that day on, they became best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a nosy little dog named Spot. Spot loved to run and play on the big pitch near his house. One sunny day, Spot saw a big cat named Fluffy sitting on the edge of the pitch.
Spot wanted to play with Fluffy, but Fluffy did not want to play. Spot ran up to Fluffy and barked, "Come play with me!" Fluffy hissed and said, "No, I don't want to play with you, nosy dog!" This made Spot feel sad, but he did not give up.
The next day, Spot saw Fluffy again on the pitch. This time, Spot ran around Fluffy in big circles, hoping Fluffy would join in. To Spot's surprise, Fluffy started to run too! They both ran and played together on the pitch, and soon they became good friends. From that day on, nosy Spot and Fluffy had lots of fun playing together.

One day, a little girl named Lily was playing in her room. She liked to observe her toys and make up silly stories with them. Suddenly, she felt the ground shake. It was an earthquake! Lily was scared and didn't know what to do.
Lily ran to her mom and said, "Mommy, the ground is shaking! What do we do?" Her mom hugged her and said, "Don't worry, Lily. It's just a small earthquake. Let's go under the table and wait for it to stop."
As they sat under the table, Lily started to feel better. She looked at her mom and said, "Mommy, can we make up a silly story about the earthquake?" Her mom smiled and said, "Of course, Lily. Let's make up a story about a silly dancing elephant who made the ground shake with his big dance moves!" They laughed and made up stories until the earthquake stopped.

Once upon a time, in a small house, lived a boy named Tim. Tim had a tight blue shirt that he loved to wear every day. One day, while playing outside, he saw a big cat. The cat was not nice. It was a threat to the small birds in the garden.
Tim wanted to help the birds. He thought of a plan to gain the cat's friendship. He went inside the house and took some fish from the kitchen. He gave the fish to the cat. The cat liked the fish and started to like Tim too.
Now, the cat was not a threat to the birds anymore. Tim and the cat became good friends. They played together every day. The birds were happy, and they sang beautiful songs. Tim's tight blue shirt became a symbol of friendship and peace in the garden.

Tim and Sam were brothers who liked to play in the park. They ran, jumped, slid and swung on the swings. They had a lot of fun.
One day, they saw a big cobweb on a tree. It was shiny and sticky. Tim wanted to touch it, but Sam said no. He said it was dirty and scary. He said there might be a wild spider in it.
Tim did not listen to Sam. He reached out his hand to the cobweb. He wanted to feel it. But as soon as he touched it, he felt a sharp pain. He screamed and pulled back his hand. There was a red spot on his finger. A wild spider had bitten him.
Sam ran to Tim and hugged him. He said he was sorry and he should have listened to Sam. He said they should go home and tell mom. Tim nodded and cried. He said he was sorry too and he should have listened to Sam. He said he did not like cobwebs or wild spiders.
They held hands and walked home. They told mom what happened. Mom cleaned Tim's finger and put a band-aid on it. She said it would be okay. She said they should be careful in the park and not touch things they did not know. Tim and Sam said they understood. They said they loved mom and each other. They hugged and said they would still play in the park, but not with cobwebs or wild spiders.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Timmy. He loved playing with puzzles. One day, Timmy's mommy gave him a yummy surprise - a special puzzle to put together. Timmy found the puzzle pieces and set to work. 
"What kind of puzzle is this?" He asked.
"It's an animal puzzle," said his mommy. "Once you put it together it will restore the image of a beautiful fox!"
Timmy was so excited that he couldn't stop playing with it. He worked hard until he finally put all the pieces together and the puzzle revealed the beautiful fox.
Timmy was so pleased with himself. He couldn't believe he had done it all by himself! He proudly showed it to his mommy and she said, "That's wonderful, Timmy. You did it! You restored the image of the fox!"
Timmy and his mommy enjoyed the puzzle all day. They smiled, laughed and had yummy snacks while they worked on the puzzle together. It was a very happy day!

One day, Tim found a toy laser. He was very happy. Tim wanted to show his friend, Sam. He ran to Sam's house.
"Look at my laser!" said Tim. "It is so cool!" Sam looked at the laser. "I want to play with it too," said Sam. Tim did not want to share. Sam was sad.
Sam was persistent. He asked Tim again and again. Tim realized it was not nice to not share. He let Sam play with the laser. They both had fun. They were happy friends again.

" Rockstar 101 " made its first chart appearance on the United States ' Billboard Hot Dance Club Songs chart , where it peaked at number two ; it stayed on the chart for 14 weeks . The song peaked on the US Hot Digital Songs chart at number 28 , spending seven weeks on the chart . It subsequently peaked at number 64 on the US Billboard Hot 100 chart and spent five weeks on the chart . It also peaked at number 10 on the US R & B / Hip-hop Digital Songs chart . " Rockstar 101 " debuted on the Australian Singles Chart at number 50 on August 22 , 2010 ; it peaked at number 24 two weeks later for one week , and remained on the chart for six weeks .

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful red car. It was very fast and it loved to race. The car had a friend named Tim. Tim was a little boy who liked to play with the car.
One sunny day, Tim and the car went outside to play. They raced up and down the street. Tim said, "Car, you are so fast! I want to keep you forever!" The car was happy to hear this and beeped its horn.
As they played, a big blue truck came down the street. The truck saw the beautiful red car and wanted to race too. Tim, the car, and the truck had a fun race together. In the end, the red car won the race. Tim was very proud of his car and said, "You are the best car ever!" They all laughed and played until the sun went down.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Pete and Ben. Pete was rich while Ben was poor. Pete invited Ben over to his house to share his tea.
Ben was so excited to have a rich friend that could invite him to his own house! When Pete and Ben were together, they liked to shoot things with their toy guns. One day, Pete noticed that Ben's gun was broken. Pete had an extra gun and offered it to Ben.
Ben was very grateful to Peter and thanked him, but Pete said, "No, this is a sharing time. If I give you my gun, then I have nothing of my own left to share with you." Ben understood what Pete meant and so he said, "That's okay, which toy shall we shoot together with your gun?"
This was a moral lesson for both Ben and Pete. No matter the differences between the two friends, both can share the same things if they truly look out for each other. All the tea in the world cannot make up for the value of true friendship!

It was used in relation to the Government of Ireland Act 1914 , which had been under the threat of a Lords veto , now removed . Ulster Protestants had been firmly against the passing of the bill . However , it never came into force because of the outbreak of the First World War . These made special exemptions to the requirement to hold an election every five years .

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big red ball on the grass. They run to the ball and want to play with it.
"Look, a red ball!" Lily says. "Can we play with it?"
"Yes, let's play!" Tom says. They kick the ball and throw the ball and catch the ball. They have fun.
But then, a big dog comes to the park. The dog sees the red ball and thinks it is a toy. The dog runs to the ball and grabs it with his mouth. He starts to chew the ball.
"Hey, that's our ball!" Tom says. He tries to get the ball from the dog, but the dog growls and runs away.
"Stop, dog, stop!" Lily says. She chases the dog, but the dog is too fast. He runs out of the park with the ball.
Lily and Tom are sad. They lost their red ball. They sit on the grass and cry.
A nice lady sees them and comes to them. She has a basket with cookies.
"What's wrong, children?" she asks.
"A dog took our red ball and chewed it!" Lily says.
"That's too bad!" the lady says. "But don't cry. I have something for you. Do you like cookies?"
"Yes, we like cookies!" Tom says.
The lady gives them each a cookie. They are sweet and crunchy. Lily and Tom smile and say thank you.
They eat their cookies and feel better. They decide to play something else. They look for flowers and bugs and rocks. They forget about the red ball and the dog. They are happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a nice man named Tom. Tom was a mechanic. He fixed cars all day and loved his job.
One day, a lady came to Tom with a broken car. Tom looked at the car and knew what to do. He fixed the car very fast. The lady was so happy!
The lady wanted to thank Tom. She gave him money to pay for his help. Tom was happy too. He used the money to buy ice cream for his family. Everyone loved the nice mechanic Tom.

When Tintin in the Congo was first released by the series ' Scandinavian publishers in 1975 , they objected to page 56 , where Tintin drills a hole into a live rhinoceros , fills it with dynamite , and blows it up . They asked Hergé to replace this page with a less violent scene , which they believed would be more suitable for children . Hergé agreed , as he regretted the scenes of big-game hunting in the work soon after producing it . The altered page involved the rhinoceros running away unharmed after accidentally knocking down and triggering Tintin 's gun .

Once upon a time, in a far away land, there was a humble town. The town was near a big volcano. The people in the town were nice and happy.
One day, the sun set and it was time for bed. The people in the town went to sleep. But, they did not know that the volcano was going to wake up.
The volcano woke up and made a loud noise. The people in the town woke up too. They were scared, but they knew what to do. They all worked together to stay safe. In the end, the town was okay and the people were happy again.
Hakim has refused a position on the Asia Pacific Screen Awards numerous times , due to being unable to reconcile her schedule with the awards .

Once upon a time, there was a big red truck. The truck was owned by a wealthy man named Tom. Tom was very nice and liked to help people. One day, Tom saw a little boy named Tim. Tim was sad because he lost his toy.
Tom asked, "Why are you sad, Tim?" Tim said, "I lost my toy when I stumble near the park." Tom wanted to help Tim find his toy. So, they went to the park together.
At the park, they saw a big pile of toys. Tim was so happy! He thanked Tom and they became good friends. The moral of the story is that helping others can bring happiness to everyone.

George and his mom were walking in the park.
George asked his mom, "What do you see?"
His mum smiled and said, "I see a big cross in the distance."
George was excited. He askedâ"Can we go see it?"
His mom said, "Yes, we can go, but first let's have a picnic!"
They spread out a blanket and sat down to eat. After they finished, they continued their walk. 
The closer they came to the cross, the more George wanted to run ahead, but his mom said, "Wait, there's a promise to keep."
When they finally arrived at the cross, it was even bigger and more grand than they thought.
George asked, "What is this, mom?"
She said, "It's a monument. People built it to remind us to keep our promises."
George said, "You said we'd come here, and we did. That was a great promise!" 
His mom smiled and replied, "Yes, it was."

Once upon a time, there was a yellow car. This car loved to go on adventures. One day, the yellow car went on a safari.
On the safari, the yellow car saw many animals. It saw big elephants, tall giraffes, and fast cheetahs. The yellow car was very happy to see all these animals.
Then, the yellow car saw a monkey. The monkey liked to throw things. It threw a banana at the yellow car. The yellow car laughed and continued its safari adventure. The yellow car had a great time and went home with a big smile.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia loved to play outside in the earth. She liked to dig in the dirt and find bugs.
One day, Mia found a tiny bug that was spicy red. Mia wanted to mind the bug and make it her friend. She put the bug in a jar with some dirt and leaves.
Mia showed her new friend to her mom and dad. They said, "Be kind and mind the bug." Mia played with the spicy bug every day and they were very happy.

One day, a little baby was playing with her toys. She had a big ball, a small doll, and a toy car. She was very happy. The sun was shining, and the baby was laughing.
Suddenly, a bitter wind blew through the open window. The baby's toys flew away! The baby was very sad. She cried and cried. Then, a nice cat came in through the open window. The cat saw the baby crying and wanted to help. 
The cat ran outside and found the baby's toys. The cat brought the toys back to the baby one by one. The baby stopped crying and smiled at the cat. She said, "Thank you, cat!" The cat meowed happily. And from that day on, the baby and the cat were the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pretty ornament. It was a shiny star. Lily loved her ornament very much.
One day, Lily and her friend Tim were playing. Tim saw the ornament and wanted to touch it. But Lily was upset. She did not want to share her shiny star.
Lily's mom saw them and said, "Lily, you should discuss with Tim. Sharing is good." So, Lily and Tim talked. They decided to share the shiny star.
In the end, Lily and Tim played happily with the ornament. They learned that sharing made them both happy. And that was a good thing to do.

One day, a busy ant named Tim was walking on a carpet. The carpet was big and soft. Tim was looking for food to take back to his ant friends.
As Tim walked, he saw a big cookie on the carpet. He said, "Wow! This cookie will make my friends happy!" Tim tried to lift the cookie, but it was too heavy. He needed help.
Tim went back to his ant friends and said, "I found a big cookie, but I need help to carry it." Many ants came to help Tim. Together, they lifted the cookie and carried it back. The ants were so happy that their food increased a lot. They thanked Tim for finding the cookie and shared it with everyone.

Tom and Mia are friends. They like to play with blocks and dolls. But one day, Tom is angry. He does not want to share his blocks with Mia. He says, "Go away, Mia. These are my blocks. You are bad."
Mia is sad. She does not understand why Tom is angry. She likes Tom and his blocks. She says, "Please, Tom. Can I play with you? I am not bad. I am your friend."
Tom does not listen. He pushes Mia away. Mia falls down and hurts her knee. She cries. She sees blood on her knee. She is scared.
Tom feels sorry. He did not mean to hurt Mia. He says, "I am sorry, Mia. I did not want to hurt you. I was angry. I hate this note."
Mia looks at the note. It is from Tom's mom. It says, "Tom, you have to go to the dentist today. I know you do not like it, but it is good for your teeth. I love you."
Mia says, "Oh, Tom. I understand. You are afraid of the dentist. I am afraid too. But it is not so bad. The dentist is nice. He gives you a sticker and a toy. And your mom loves you. She wants you to be healthy."
Tom smiles. He says, "Thank you, Mia. You are a good friend. I am sorry I was mean to you. Can I give you a hug?"
Mia nods. She says, "Yes, Tom. I forgive you. Can we play with the blocks and the dolls together?"
Tom says, "Yes, Mia. We can. And can you help me write a note to my mom? I want to tell her I love her too."
Mia says, "Of course, Tom. I can help you. Let's write the note with crayons. And let's draw a heart and a smiley face."
Tom and Mia hug. They are happy. They write the note. They play with the blocks and the dolls. They are friends.

One day, a big black bird sat on a tree. From the tree, the bird had a nice view of a big house. In the house, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy saw the big black bird and said, "Hello, bird! What are you doing up there?"
The big black bird did not answer. Amy was sad. She wanted to be friends with the bird. So, she climbed the tree to get a better view. When she got close to the bird, she saw that it was not a big black bird at all. It was a big black hat!
Amy laughed and said, "Silly me! I thought you were a bird!" She took the hat and went back to her house. Now, Amy had a new black hat to wear and a funny story to tell her friends.

Cindy was happy to go to the park that day. She had been feeling sad, but being outside made her feel much better.
As she wandered, she noticed a squirrel walking along a path. It had a small piece of paper in its hands.
"What do you have there, squirrel?" Cindy asked.
The squirrel stopped and looked at her. It then handed her the paper.
"This is a poem," said the squirrel. "It'll make you happy."
Cindy looked at the poem and smiled. She could tell it was going to be special.
But then as she read the poem, something strange happened. Everything felt like it was happening in slow motion. Cindy soon realized that the poem had a lesson for her. It was about how sometimes stupid things happen and how it's important to learn from them.
The poem reminded Cindy that it was ok to make mistakes and to never give up. She smiled and thanked the squirrel for the special present. She left the park feeling much happier than when she had arrived.

Once upon a time, there was a little mouse called Maisy who lived in the forest. Maisy was very sad because her mum had gone away. She had been away for a very long time.
One day, Maisy saw something move in the bushes. She twitched her nose, excited to find out what it was.
Suddenly, a white rabbit popped out of the bushes. He smiled at Maisy and said: "Hello there, little one."
Maisy blinked, surprised by the rabbit. She asked him why he was there. The rabbit said he was looking for his friend who had gone away and he couldn't find her. 
Maisy was sad and said: "My mum's gone away too. I miss her very much." 
The rabbit then hopped closer and said: "I know how you feel. Here, give me a hug and that will make you feel better".
Maisy smiled, and then she felt a lot better. When it was time to go, the rabbit said goodbye and hopped away. Maisy knew her mum was never coming back and that it was time to end her sadness. 
Maisy was happy, and she was no longer dead inside. She knew this was the start of something new and wonderful.

Lily and her mum went to the park. It was a sunny day and it was very clear. When they arrived, Lily was so excited when she saw the parrots. She ran up to the colourful birds and watched them flying around.
"Let's enjoy them!" said her mum. 
Lily jumped up and down, happy to be so close to the parrots. She watched them curiously, as they flew from branch to branch. She couldn't believe they were so close.
Suddenly, one parrot came down to Lily and sat on her shoulder. Lily was so surprised, she laughed and smiled. She loved the parrot's colourful feathers against her skin.
Mum laughed too. "Let's enjoy this moment," she said. 
Lily was so happy to be so close to the parrot. She enjoyed this special moment for a long time. When it was time to leave, she waved goodbye to the parrot. Lily knew she would never forget this special day with the parrot.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She had a pretty picture in a frame on her wall. The picture was of a smooth, round ball. Amy loved this picture very much.
One day, Amy's little brother, Tim, was playing ball inside the house. He accidentally threw the ball too hard, and it hit the picture frame on the wall. The frame broke, and Amy was very sad.
Tim felt bad for breaking the frame. He said, "I'm sorry, Amy. I didn't mean to break it." Amy was sad, but she knew her brother didn't do it on purpose. She decided to forgive him. They hugged and promised to be more careful when playing inside the house.

Nina was feeling a bit down. She had always wanted to go on a holiday but she was feeling too scared to try it. She looked out the window and saw that the sky was grey and it was raining.
"Don't worry," said her mum. "It will get better. Let's go and play inside. We can listen to music, play some games and have some fun!"
Nina smiled but felt a little bit better. She spent the day playing with her mum, singing and dancing. And then, suddenly, the rain stopped and the sun shone through the windows. 
Nina's mum smiled. "It looks like a good day for a holiday!" she said.
Nina's eyes lit up. She smiled and said excitedly, "Let's go!"
Her mum nodded. "Let's go. I'll encourage you the entire way. You can do it, no matter how ugly it gets!" 
As they drove, Nina was surprised to see how the sky changed from grey to blue and the trees became greener. Soon enough, they reached the beach and were surrounded by beautiful views. 
Nina felt a wave of courage come over her. A holiday wasn't so scary after all! She smiled and thanked her mum for encouraging her. 
The two of them spent the day having fun in the sun, building sand castles and swimming in the sea.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly fireman. He was so friendly and enjoyed helping people.
One day, he decided to take a walk down the street. As he walked, he heard a little girl crying. He quickly rushed to the girl's aid.
The fireman asked the girl why she was crying. With a few sniffles and hiccups, the little girl said, "My stuffed animal is stuck in the tree!"
The fireman smiled and said, "I will help you. It will be alright."
He grabbed a ladder and put it against the tree. He climbed up and carefully rescued the stuffed animal.
The little girl was so happy! She smiled and said, "Thank you, jolly fireman!"
The fireman smiled and told her, "No problem. We fireman love to help people!"

Dershowitz threatened libel action over the charges in Finkelstein 's book , as a consequence of which , the publisher deleted the word " plagiarism " from the text before publication .
