One day, a clumsy cat named Tom was walking in the park. He saw a small girl with a brush in her hand. The girl was trying to brush her doll's hair, but it was not easy for her.
Tom went to the girl and said, "Can I help you brush your doll's hair?" The girl smiled and said, "Yes, please!" Tom took the brush from the girl and started to brush the doll's hair. But Tom was so clumsy that he got the brush stuck in the doll's hair.
The girl started to complain, "Oh no, you made it worse!" Just then, a friendly dog named Spot came running up to them. Spot saw the problem and said, "I can help!" With his teeth, Spot gently took the brush out of the doll's hair.
The girl was so happy and said, "Thank you, Spot!" Tom felt a little sad because he couldn't help. But the girl gave Tom a big hug and said, "It's okay, you tried your best!" And from that day on, Tom, the girl, and Spot became the best of friends.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a smart boy named Tim. One hot day, Tim wanted to get some ice to cool down. So, he went to the big ice box in the kitchen.
Tim saw his mom in the kitchen. He said, "Mom, can I get some ice?" His mom smiled and said, "Yes, Tim. You can get some ice."
Tim got the ice and put it in his cup. He felt very happy and cool. He shared the ice with his little sister. They both laughed and enjoyed the cold ice on a hot day.

Once upon a time, there was a happy bird. She was playing in the sunshine, hopping around in the grass and singing her happy song. She looked up and smiled when she saw a little girl walking by. The little girl stopped and waved at the bird and the bird nodded back.
The little girl then asked the bird: "Hi, birdy. What are you doing?"
The bird smiled and said: "I am feeling happy and playing in the sunshine!"
The little girl smiled back and the bird nodded.
The bird then said, "I'm getting ready to fly up and touch the sunshine up in the sky."
The little girl said with excitement, "You can do that?! I want to come with you and touch the sunshine too!" 
The bird nodded and said, "Yes! You can come with me! We can touch the sunshine together." This made the little girl very happy. 
So, the happy bird and the little girl both flew up and touched the sunshine. The sunshine made them both very happy, and they flew around together for the rest of the day.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl, called Zoe. Zoe loved to design things. One day, Zoe had an amazing idea. She decided to design a reward that was fair for everyone.
Zoe worked hard on her design. Several days later, Zoe had finished! She was so excited to show her family her reward.
Zoe presented her design to her family and they were overwhelmed with joy. Everyone agreed it was a very fair reward. They all clapped and cheered for her.
From then on, her family followed her design, and they all enjoyed equal rewards! Zoe was so happy. She was pleased that she had designed something that brought fairness and joy to everyone.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia loved to pick berries in the woods. One sunny day, she went to the woods to find some sweet berries.
As Mia was picking berries, she saw a cute bunny. The bunny said, "Hi Mia, can you help me find some berries too?" Mia was happy to help her new friend. So, they both started to look for berries together.
Mia was very excited and began to rush. She was being careless and stepped on some berries. The bunny said, "Mia, slow down. We need to be careful not to crush the berries." Mia listened to the bunny and they both picked berries carefully. They had a fun day in the woods and went home with their baskets full of sweet berries.

There was a fisherman named Sam. He liked to read books by the sea. One day, he sat in his boat and read a book. He felt safe and happy.
A little fish swam up to Sam's boat. "Hello, fisherman," said the fish. "Can you read me a story, please?" Sam was very surprised. He never heard a fish talk before! But he said, "Okay, little fish. I will read you a story."
As Sam read the story, more and more fish came to listen. They all liked the story. When the story was over, the fish said, "Thank you, fisherman." Then, they swam away. Sam felt happy and safe, knowing he had new friends in the sea.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She had a toy box full of toys. One day, she found a big square in her toy box. The square was new and Sue was very happy.
Sue played with the square all day. She liked to poke it with her finger. But then, something strange happened. When Sue poked the square, it changed into a fake bird. The bird could not fly, but it could sing. Sue was so surprised!
Sue showed the fake bird to her mom and dad. They could not believe it! They all laughed and clapped as the bird sang. Sue loved her new toy even more. And from that day on, she always poked the square to make the bird sing.

Mara was a 3 year old girl who had a pet named Spot. Spot was a clumsy dog who loved to play fetch and run around the yard with Mara.
One day, Spot was having trouble getting through the doggy door, so Mara decided to help him out. She called Spot over and said, âCome Spot, I can help you.â Spot wagged his tail and came running.
Mara held the door open and said, âThere you go. You can squeeze through.â Spot did and ran outside to the yard. He was very happy and thanked Mara with a few licks on her face.
Mara laughed and said, âYouâre welcome! Youâre a clumsy pup, but I like you!â Spot wagged his tail in response, and they both ran around the yard and played the rest of the day.

Once upon a time, there was a big room full of junk. Two friends, Tom and Sue, liked to play in this room. They would build towers, make forts, and have fun with all the junk.
One day, Tom and Sue started to quarrel. Tom wanted to make a clean space in the room, but Sue wanted to keep playing with the junk. Tom said, "I want to clean this room." Sue said, "No, I like the junk."
They quarreled for a long time. Then, they decided to make a clean space and keep the junk. They worked together and made a fun play area. Now, Tom and Sue play in the clean space and have fun with the junk. They don't quarrel anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a big, wide lake. On one side of the lake lived a family of ducks.
They liked to swim in the lake and play in the sunshine. But one day, they noticed something strange. A big, wide skull was floating in the lake. 
The ducks were scared, so they decided to find out what it was. They asked their friend, the fish, and a wise old frog. What could it be?
The fish said it could be the skull of a monster. The wise old frog imagined it was the skull of a witch. The ducks didn't know what to do.
So, they asked a brave little bird. She looked at the skull and said it was nothing to worry about. It was just the old skull of a huge, wide turtle.
The ducks were relieved. From that day on, they asked the brave bird for help when they didn't know what to do. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a smelly shoe. It was all alone in a big room. The shoe wanted to play with the other toys, but they did not want to play with the smelly shoe.
One day, a kind girl came to the room. She saw the smelly shoe and wanted to help it. The girl knew that if she could pay to clean the shoe, it would not be smelly anymore. So, she took the shoe to a place where they could make it nice and clean.
After the shoe was clean, it was not smelly anymore. The other toys saw the clean shoe and wanted to play with it. The shoe was very happy. The kind girl and the shoe played together all day long. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a young boy wanted to go outside and play. However, it was wet outside, so the boy was sad. He looked out of the window, searching for a way to gain some fun.
Suddenly, the boy had an idea. He put on his rain boots and grabbed his yellow raincoat. The boy opened the door and jumped outside into the rain!
The boy laughed as the water touched his skin. He ran around, playing in the rain with a big smile on his face. He splashed around the puddles, feeling the wetness on his face.
The young boy was having so much fun playing in the rain. Soon, he was completely soaked, but the boy didn't mind because he had gained some fun!

Mia and Sam were playing in the park with their mom. They liked to swing, slide and run on the grass. They saw many other kids and some dogs, but they did not talk to them. They only talked to their mom and each other.
One day, a stranger came to the park. He had a big hat and a long coat. He smiled at Mia and Sam and said, "Hello, little ones. Do you want to see something fun?" He took out a shiny ball from his pocket and tossed it in the air. It made a funny sound and changed colors.
Mia and Sam were curious. They wanted to see the ball. They walked towards the stranger, but their mom saw them and called them back. "Mia, Sam, come here. Don't go to the stranger. He is not our friend. We don't know him."
Mia and Sam ran back to their mom. They were scared and confused. They did not understand why the stranger was not nice. Their mom hugged them and said, "It's okay, my loves. The stranger was trying to trick you. He wanted to take you away from me. You should never go to a stranger, even if he has something fun. You should always stay with me or someone you know and trust."
Mia and Sam nodded. They felt better. They said sorry to their mom and thanked her for keeping them safe. They decided to play some more, but they stayed close to their mom. They did not look at the stranger anymore. He left the park soon after.
Mia and Sam were tired after playing. They were sleepy and hungry. Their mom said, "Let's go home, my loves. We can have some snacks and read a story. Then we can settle in our beds and have a nice nap." Mia and Sam agreed. They liked to nap with their mom. They held her hand and walked home. They were happy and safe.

Once upon a time, there was a polite elephant named Ella. Ella lived in a big forest with many friends. Every day, she would play with her friends and eat yummy leaves from the trees.
One sunny day, Ella and her friends decided to have a big picnic. They all brought their favorite food to eat. Ella brought her favorite leaves, and her friends brought fruits and nuts. They all sat down to eat and share their food.
As they were eating, something unexpected happened. A tiny mouse named Max came to join them. Max was very hungry, but he didn't have any food. Ella and her friends were surprised, but they decided to share their food with Max. Max was so happy and thankful. From that day on, Max the mouse and Ella the elephant became best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had an original cap that he loved very much. It was blue and had a big red star on it. Tim wore his cap every day.
One sunny day, Tim went to the park to play. He met a new friend named Sam. Sam looked at Tim's cap and said, "Wow, I like your cap! It's so original!" Tim smiled and said, "Thank you, Sam! Do you want to play with me?" Sam nodded, and they played together all day.
After playing for a long time, Tim and Sam felt very tired. They decided to take a nap under a big tree. They put their caps on the grass and closed their eyes. When they woke up, they felt very happy and ready to play again. Tim and Sam became best friends and always wore their caps when they played together.

Once upon a time, there was a big red ambulance. It had an incredible job to do. It helped people who were hurt or sick.
One day, the ambulance had to go help a little boy who fell off his bike. The ambulance raced down the street with its lights flashing and siren loud. The little boy saw the ambulance and felt better already.
The ambulance had to struggle to get through the busy street. Cars moved out of the way to let the ambulance pass. Finally, the ambulance reached the little boy. The helpers inside made sure the little boy was okay. The boy said thank you to the incredible ambulance and its helpers. They all smiled and went back to their important job.

Opal dreamed of being a doctor some day. She was three years old, but she was determined to make her dream come true.
One day, Opal found a rag on the ground and picked it up. She said to herself, "This is a perfect thing to use when I'm a doctor someday."
As Opal imagined herself healing people in the future, she smiled.
That night, Opal's mom found her playing with the rag. She asked Opal why she was so happy.
Opal replied, "Mommy, I'm happy because I'm going to be a doctor and use this rag to heal people."
Her mom chuckled and said, "That's wonderful, Opal! You should practice healing now, with your rag."
Opal nodded and ran off to play with her rag. She pretended to give shots and bandage people up. She was so excited to help that she felt a little frustrated when she couldn't do it for real. 
But with her determination and her love for helping others, Opal knew that her dream of being a doctor would come true one day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his big toy car. One day, he found a cable under the bed. It was a long and thin cable. Tim had an idea. He wanted to use the cable to pull his toy car.
Tim was very careful when he tied the cable to the car. He did not want to break his toy. He started to pull the car with the cable. Tim was having so much fun. He pulled the car around the house.
Then, something unexpected happened. When Tim went to squeeze the cable tighter, a big, friendly dog jumped out from behind the couch! The dog had been hiding there all along. The dog started to play with Tim and the toy car too. They all had a great time playing together. And that is how Tim found his new best friend, the big, friendly dog.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park. He wanted to play with the other kids. He saw a girl named Sue. Tim wanted to introduce himself to Sue. He walked up to her and said, "Hi, I'm Tim. Want to play?"
Sue looked at Tim and saw that he was wearing a big, funny boot. She started to laugh at him. Tim felt embarrassed. He didn't know what to do. He tried to play with Sue, but she kept laughing at his boot. 
Tim felt very sad. He went home and told his mom about the bad day he had. His mom hugged him and said, "Don't worry, Tim. Tomorrow will be better." But Tim knew that tomorrow he would still have to wear the big, funny boot.

Once upon a time, there was a large dog named Buddy. Buddy loved to carry things in his mouth. Every day, Buddy would go to the front of his house and carry the newspaper for his family. He felt very proud of his job.
One day, Buddy saw a big box near the door. He wondered what was inside. He knew it was too big for him to carry, but he wanted to help. Buddy decided to wait and see what would happen with the big box.
The next day, a man came to Buddy's house. The man opened the big box and took out a beautiful new dog bed. Buddy was so happy! He knew that the big box was a gift for him. Now, Buddy could sleep on his new bed after carrying the newspaper for his family every day.

One day, a girl named Lucy went to play outside with her spade. She wanted to dig in the dirt and make a big hole. Lucy loved to play with her spade, and she liked to pretend she was a cook making a big cake in the dirt.
As Lucy was digging, she found a big, shiny rock. She thought it was a magic rock that could help her cook. She ran to her mom and showed her the rock. Lucy's mom said, "Be careful, Lucy. That rock might be hot and hurt you."
Lucy didn't listen to her mom. She took the rock and put it in a pot on the stove. She turned on the heat and waited for the rock to cook. Suddenly, the rock started to change color and got very hot. Lucy was scared and didn't know what to do.
Just then, Lucy's mom came in and saw the hot rock. She quickly turned off the stove and took the rock out with a big glove. She told Lucy, "I told you it might hurt you. We need to be careful with things we find outside." Lucy learned her lesson and promised to listen to her mom next time. And from that day on, Lucy only cooked with her spade and dirt, making the best dirt cakes ever.

Mum and Annie were sitting on the floor, watching a film together. "What is it about?", asked Annie. "It's about a distant place," replied Mum. "Let's find out more together," she said as they watched.
Suddenly, the film revealed a surprise. There were animals in the distant place! Annie was very excited. "Mummy, what are those funny animals?" she asked. "Those are called elephants." replied Mum. She explained that elephants lived in the distant place, far away from where they were.
Annie couldn't believe it. She thought the elephants were so funny. She laughed and laughed and laughed. Mum laughed too. They had so much fun together, watching the film and learning about the distant place.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a favorite seat in his house. It was a big, soft chair that his mom called the "massage chair". Tim loved to sit in the massage chair after playing outside.
One day, Tim came home from playing in the mud. He was filthy from head to toe. His mom saw him and said, "Tim, you need to take a bath right away!" Tim nodded and went to the bathroom to wash off all the dirt.
After his bath, Tim ran to his favorite massage chair and sat down. His mom saw him and smiled. "Now you can enjoy your clean seat," she said. Tim smiled back and said, "Thank you, Mom!" They both laughed as Tim enjoyed his massage chair, feeling happy and clean.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a girl named Lily. She loved to create things with her hands. One day, she saw a fragile bird in the rain. The bird was sad and wet. Lily wanted to help the bird.
She had an idea! Lily would create an umbrella for the bird. She worked hard to make the umbrella. It was small and just right for the bird. Lily was very happy with her work. She knew the umbrella would keep the bird dry.
The next day, it rained again. Lily went outside and saw the fragile bird. She gave the bird the umbrella she created. The bird was so happy! It stayed dry and safe in the rain. Lily felt good that she could help her new friend.

Once upon a time, in a big farm, there was a curious little cow named Momo. Momo loved to explore the farm and play with her friends. One day, Momo saw a big pile of hay. She had never seen so much hay before! Momo was very curious about the hay and wanted to play with it.
Momo's friends, a group of little chicks, were playing near the hay. They were having a lot of fun, but they were also making a big mess. The hay was flying everywhere! Momo wanted to join them, but she remembered her mom telling her to save the hay for the winter. Momo knew that the hay was important to keep them warm and full during the cold days.
Momo decided to be a good cow and not play with the hay. She told her friends about the need to save the hay for the winter. At first, the chicks were sad, but they understood the importance of saving the hay. They all decided to help clean up the mess they made and save the hay. When winter came, Momo and her friends were warm and happy because they had saved the hay. The moral of the story is to think about the future and save what is important for the hard times.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there lived a charming fox. The fox liked to do many things. He liked to run, jump, and play with his friends.
One day, the fox met a new friend, a little bird. The fox said, "Hello, bird! Do you want to play with me?" The bird said, "Yes! I want to play too!" So, the fox and the bird played all day long. They ran, jumped, and had lots of fun.
But the fox was not a good friend. He wanted to eat the bird. The bird did not know this. The fox said, "Bird, come closer. I have a secret." The bird came closer, and the fox ate the bird.
The other animals in the forest saw what the fox did. They were sad and did not want to play with the fox anymore. The charming fox was all alone.
The moral of the story is: always be a good friend and do not hurt others.

Once upon a time, there was a musician who lived in a distant land. He loved to play songs on his big drum. He played every day and the people liked to dance to his music.
One day, the musician decided to keep his drum in a safe place. He put it under his bed and went to play outside. When he came back, he found that his drum was gone! He was very sad and did not know what to do.
The next day, the musician heard a sound coming from the sky. It was his drum! A big bird had taken it to make music in the sky. The bird saw the sad musician and gave the drum back to him. The musician was so happy, and he played music for the bird and the people in his distant land.

Once upon a time, in a small garden, there was a brilliant beetle named Ben. Ben loved to try new things. One day, he saw a big red ball and wanted to play with it.
Ben asked his friend, Cat, "Can you help me push the ball?" Cat said, "Yes, let's try together!" So, they tried and tried, but the ball was too big for them. They felt sad but did not give up.
A wise old owl saw them and said, "You need more friends to help you." Ben and Cat asked more friends to help. Together, they all pushed the ball, and it moved! They were so happy. The moral of the story is that we can do big things when we work together.

One day, a black lion went to the park. He was big and strong. He wanted to play with the other animals, but they were scared of him. The black lion felt sad because he could not make friends.
The black lion saw a little girl with a big red ball. He wanted to get the ball and play with her. The little girl was not scared of the black lion. They played with the ball together and had fun. The black lion was happy to have a friend.
But then, a big wind came and took the red ball away. The black lion and the little girl tried to get the ball, but they could not. The ball was gone. The black lion and the little girl were sad. They could not play anymore, and the black lion went back to being alone.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. One day, Spot decided to wander away from his home to find a new friend. He walked and walked, hoping to meet someone nice.
As Spot walked, he saw a big tree. He thought, "Maybe someone is hiding behind the tree." Spot took a look behind the tree, and there he found a little cat named Fluffy. Fluffy was shy, but Spot was very friendly. They started to play together and became good friends.
Spot and Fluffy played all day. They ran, jumped, and laughed together. They were very happy and felt successful in their search for a new friend. When the sun started to set, they walked back to Spot's home, hand in hand, knowing they would always be there for each other.

Jim and Tim both wanted the new jeep. Jim had his eye set on it for a long time. So when the jeep arrived at the car lot, he was so excited. He told Tim that it was his and that he should get another car. 
Tim, feeling jealous, lied to Jim and said that he wanted the jeep too. Jim was so surprised but decided to give it to Tim. He told him they could share it. 
The boys enjoyed the jeep for a while. But soon, Jim noticed that Tim seemed to use the jeep more and more. When he asked him why, Tim lied again. So Jim decided not to share the jeep with him anymore.
In the end, the boys had a big fight because of Tim's lying. They stopped being friends and the jeep was put away.
The moral of the story is that lying can ruin relationships. It's always better to be honest and tell the truth.

Once upon a time, there was an adorable little dog named Spot. Spot loved to play outside and swing on his swing. Every day, he would go out and play on his swing.
One day, Spot's mom gave him a cup of yogurt to eat. Spot loved yogurt! He took it with him to the swing. As he started to swing, something unexpected happened. A big wind came and blew his yogurt away!
Spot was sad, but then he saw a squirrel with his yogurt. The squirrel was swinging on a branch and eating the yogurt. Spot was surprised! He thought it was funny. So, Spot and the squirrel became friends and shared the yogurt while they both swung together.

After he completed 12 of 13 passes , McElroy set a new single-game Alabama record for completion percentage of 92. 3 percent to break the previous record he set against North Texas in 2009 . The game also marked the first time Alabama played on a Thursday night since defeating Southern Miss in 2001 , and the return of both former Alabama head coach Bill Curry as the Panthers ' head coach and quarterback Star Jackson who transferred to Georgia State prior to the 2010 season . The 63 points were the most scored by an Alabama team since defeating Vanderbilt 63 – 3 in 1979 .

Once upon a time there was a clumsy bear named Robert. Robert was very slow and could never keep up with the other animals. He always felt sad because he wasn't as fast as the others.
One day, Robert decided to try to go faster. He worked hard and eventually he ran faster than ever before!
Robert was very excited to show the other animals his speed. When he arrived, the other animals were amazed.
"Wow, Robert, you're so fast!" one of the animals said.
Robert couldn't believe his ears. "You really think I'm fast?" he asked.
"Yes, we do!" they all said happily.
From then on, Robert believed in himself and his speed. He was no longer clumsy and could always keep up with the others.

One day, a red cat and a little mouse were in the park. The cat saw the mouse and wanted to play. The mouse had a big piece of cheese. The cat said, "Can I have some cheese?" The mouse said, "No, it's mine!"
The red cat was sad and wanted the cheese. So, the cat tried to take it from the mouse. The mouse said, "No, no, no!" and started to run. The cat ran after the mouse. They ran and ran around the park.
Then, something unexpected happened. A big dog came and saw the cheese. The dog took the cheese and ran away. The red cat and the little mouse stopped running. They looked at each other and said, "We need to get the cheese back!" So, they worked together to get the cheese from the big dog.

Once upon a time, there was a bossy giant. He lived in a big house on a hill. All the people in the town were scared of him. One day, a little girl named Amy went up the hill to see the giant. She was not scared.
Amy knocked on the giant's door. The giant opened the door and said, "Go away! I am busy!" But Amy did not go away. She said, "I want to be your friend." The giant was surprised. No one had ever wanted to be his friend before.
The giant and Amy played together all day. They had so much fun! But then, it was time for Amy to go home. She said, "Goodbye, giant. I will come back tomorrow." The giant was sad, but he knew he had a new friend. He closed the door and smiled.

Once upon a time, there was a pink cat who lived in the forest. The cat was a curious one and was always finding new ways to have fun.
One day, the cat found a novel, which was a type of book with a story inside. The cat was so excited and wanted to share it with his friends in the forest. With a little help, the cat learned to read the book.
He then used the story in the novel to unite all the forest animals together. He asked each animal to contribute something special for their party.
The bear brought some honey for the party. The fox brought something sparkly. The rabbit brought some carrots.
In the end, the party was a great success and the pink cat was very happy. Everyone else was also happy for the pink cat as he had united them all in friendship.

Once upon a time, there was a big fish named Bob. Bob was swimming in the pond, when he saw a net. Bob was a careless fish and didn't see the net. He swam right into it and got stuck.
A little boy named Tim saw Bob in the net. Tim said, "Oh no! Fish is stuck in the net. I will help you." Tim wanted to remove the net from Bob. He pulled and pulled, but the net was very strong.
Finally, Tim's mom came and helped him. "Be careful, Tim," she said. Together, they removed the net and set Bob free. Bob was so happy and thanked Tim and his mom. From that day on, Bob was never careless again.

Dave and Mom were walking down the street. Mom was carrying a fancy box with a red ribbon on top. "What's that box, Mommy?" asked Dave. "It's a surprise, sweetie," mom replied.
They got to the park and sat down. "Can I open it now?" asked Dave. "Yes, Dave. Go ahead," said mom.
Dave pulled the ribbon off and opened the box. Inside was a fancy new grill! Dave was thrilled and ran to show it to all his friends.
Suddenly, mom called out "Oh no, there's no charcoal!" Dave stopped in his tracks and looked at Mom with a sad face. "But Mom, I want to use the grill now," he whined.
Mom smiled. "Don't worry, Dave. I'll go to the store to buy some charcoal and in no time, you'll be able to unpack the grill and make yourself a delicious dinner!" Dave cheered up and ran around the park until mom came back with the charcoal.

Once upon a time, in a big field, there was a lot of corn. In the middle of the corn, there was an ancient tree. It was very old and wise. One day, a little boy named Tim went to the corn field. He wanted to relax under the old tree.
As Tim sat under the tree, he heard a voice. "Hello, little boy," said the voice. Tim looked around and saw a big, friendly bird on a branch. "Hi," said Tim. "I'm here to relax."
The bird and Tim became friends. They talked and played all day. Then, something unexpected happened. The ancient tree began to shake. The corn around them started to dance and sing! Tim and the bird were very surprised.
The tree told Tim and the bird that it was a magical tree. It could make the corn come to life when it was happy. Tim, the bird, and the dancing corn had a big party under the ancient tree. They laughed and played until the sun went down. And from that day on, Tim would visit the corn field to relax and have fun with his new friends.

Once upon a time, there was an ugly brain living in a big house. The brain wanted friends, but no one wanted to play with him because he was so ugly.
One day, the brain had an idea. He decided to ask all the other creatures in the house if they wanted to be friends. He went around asking everyone, but they said no. Everyone said he was too ugly.
The brain felt sad, so he went to his bedroom and thought hard. He thought and thought and finally had another idea. He decided to ask a different creature. He went to ask the lovely bird if she would be his friend.
The bird said yes! She thought the brain was very kind and she wanted to help him. They had lots of fun playing together and the brain was so happy to have a friend. He was no longer so ugly.

One day, a powerful machine arrived at the house. It had come to supply the family with a special present. It was a bathrobe! 
The family was so excited to have a bathrobe! The kids had never seen anything like it before. 
Mama put the bathrobe on her son who was only three years old. He looked so funny with it on, but it felt so soft and comfortable! 
He loved showing off his new bathrobe. He'd twirl around the house making all sorts of funny noises. Everyone was laughing and having a great time.
The powerful machine had supplied the family with a wonderful gift. They had a brand new bathrobe that made their little boy happy and kept him warm.

Once upon a time, there was a small girl named Lily. She loved to pack her toys in a bag and go on adventures. One day, she decided to go to the moon. She packed her bag with her favorite toys: a ball, a doll, and a toy car.
Lily went outside and looked up at the sky. She saw the moon and wished she could fly there. A friendly bird heard her wish and said, "I can help you fly to the moon, but you must be kind to others on our journey." Lily agreed and climbed onto the bird's back. They flew high up in the sky, past the clouds, and towards the moon.
On their way, they met a sad dog who had lost his bone. Lily shared her toy car with the dog, and he was very happy. They continued their journey and met a cat who was cold. Lily gave her doll to the cat to keep her warm. Finally, they reached the moon and met a lonely boy. Lily shared her ball with the boy, and they all played together. The bird was proud of Lily for being kind and sharing her toys. The moral of the story is to always be kind and share with others, and you will make new friends and have fun adventures.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little fish named Fin. Fin loved to play with his friends in the sea. They would swim and dive all day long.
One day, Fin found a pair of scissors on the sea floor. He did not know what they were, but he thought they looked fun. He showed them to his friends, and they all wanted to play with the scissors too.
Fin's mom saw them playing with the scissors and told them to be careful. She said that scissors could be sharp and hurt them. Fin and his friends listened to his mom and put the scissors back where they found them. They went back to diving and swimming, happy and safe.

One day, a cat and a dog were playing in the yard. The cat saw a weird bug and said, "Look, dog! A weird bug!" The dog looked at the bug and said, "Let's chase it!" They ran after the bug, but it was very fast. It went zoom all around the yard.
The cat and dog kept chasing the bug. They were having a lot of fun. Suddenly, the bug flew up into a tree. The cat and dog looked at each other and said, "How can we get the bug now?" The cat had an idea. "I can climb the tree and freeze the bug!" The dog agreed, and the cat started to climb.
As the cat was climbing, the dog saw something unexpected. The weird bug had a baby bug! The baby bug was scared and crying. The dog said, "Stop, cat! The bug has a baby!" The cat stopped climbing and looked at the baby bug. They both felt bad for scaring the bugs.
The cat and dog decided to leave the bugs alone. They learned that it's important to be kind to all creatures, big and small. From that day on, the cat and dog promised to be more careful when playing in the yard.

One day, a little bird named Tim wanted to park his nest on a tree. He saw a big tree with a stubborn cat named Max. Max did not want to share the tree with Tim. Tim asked Max, "Can I park my nest here?"
Max said, "No, this is my tree. You go find another tree." Tim was sad but he did not give up. He tried to find another tree, but all the trees were full of other nests.
Tim went back to Max and said, "Please let me park my nest here. I cannot find another tree." Max saw how sad Tim was and thought for a moment. He finally said, "Okay, you can park your nest here, but only on the other side of the tree."
Tim was very happy and thanked Max. They became good friends and shared the tree. They learned that it was better to share and help each other than to be stubborn.

Once upon a time, there was a kind bird. The bird had a sharp beak. The bird lived in a big tree near a small house.
One day, the bird saw a can of oil under the tree. The can was open. The bird was curious, so it flew down to look at the oil. The bird thought the oil was shiny and pretty.
The bird saw a little girl who lived in the small house. The girl was sad because her bike was squeaky. The kind bird used its sharp beak to pick up some oil. The bird put the oil on the bike's chain. The girl was very happy and thanked the kind bird. They became good friends and played together every day.

A tropical wave moved off the northwestern coast of Africa into the Atlantic Ocean on August 11 . After moving across the Atlantic and Caribbean Sea without development , the system moved through the Intertropical Convergence Zone of the northeastern Pacific Ocean . The cloudiness moved northward toward the Gulf of Tehuantepec on August 22 . The thunderstorm activity organized sufficiently for the system to be upgraded to Tropical Depression Fifteen-E on August 23 while 298 mi ( 480 km ) southeast of Acapulco , Mexico . The depression moved west-northwestward and strengthened into a tropical storm 217 mi ( 350 km ) south-southwest of Puerto Vallarta on August 25 . The storm began to turn more westward due to a strengthening high pressure system to its north and was upgraded to a hurricane on August 27 while 286 mi ( 460 km ) southwest of Cabo San Lucas . As the high to the north continued to strengthen , the hurricane turned west-southwest .

Once upon a time, there was a bald man named Tom. He had a big dog named Max. Max was very strong and liked to run fast. Tom used a leash to walk Max so he would not run away.
One day, Tom and Max went for a walk. They saw a big door. The door was open. Tom thought it would be fun to see what was inside. He did not shut the door behind him.
Inside, they found a big cat. The cat did not like Max. The cat hissed and jumped on Max. Max got scared and pulled on the leash. Tom fell down and the leash broke. Max ran away and Tom could not find him. Tom was very sad because he lost his best friend.

One day, a boy named Tim felt miserable. He had very long hair and needed a haircut. His hair was so long that it covered his eyes, and he couldn't see well. Tim's mom saw him and said, "Tim, it's time for a haircut!"
Tim and his mom went to the haircut place. The haircut man said, "Hi Tim! Sit in the big chair, and I will give you a haircut." Tim sat in the big chair, and the haircut man pulled a cape around him. Tim felt better already.
The haircut man started to snip, snip, snip. Tim's hair fell to the floor. When the haircut man was done, Tim's hair was short and neat. Tim looked in the mirror and smiled. He was not miserable anymore. He said, "Thank you, haircut man!" And they all went home happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to watch planes at the airport. He would go with his mom and dad to see the big planes fly in the sky. The planes were harmless and made Tim very happy.
One day, while Tim was at the airport, he saw a magic plane. The magic plane could disappear! Tim watched as the plane flew up, up, up, and then it was gone. He clapped his hands and laughed with joy.
Tim told his mom and dad about the magic plane. They were so happy to see him having fun. They all went to the airport every week to watch the magic plane disappear. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little rocket. The rocket wanted to fly high in the sky. It said, "I hope I can be successful and go up, up, up!"
One day, the rocket met a big bird. The bird said, "I can help you fly high in the sky." The rocket was happy and said, "Yes, please help me!"
The bird tried to help the rocket. They went up, up, up together. But then, the rocket was too heavy for the bird. The bird could not fly anymore. They both fell down, down, down.
The rocket was sad. It said, "I am not successful. I cannot fly high in the sky." The bird was sad too. They both did not get what they wanted.

Dover Athletic Football Club is a professional association football club based in the town of Dover , Kent , England . The club was formed in 1983 after the dissolution of the town 's previous club , Dover F.C. , whose place in the Southern League was taken by the new club . In the 1989 – 90 season Dover Athletic won the Southern League championship , but failed to gain promotion to the Football Conference as the club 's ground did not meet the required standard . Three seasons later the team won the title again and this time gained promotion to the Conference , where they spent nine seasons before being relegated at the end of the 2001 – 02 season . The club was transferred to the Isthmian League Premier Division in 2004 , but another poor season and financial problems that had been mounting led the club to a further relegation . After three seasons were spent in the Isthmian League Division One South , the club won the championship and with it promotion back to the Premier Division , followed immediately the following season by another championship and with it promotion to Conference South . Five seasons were spent in that division with the club coming close to gaining promotion several times , reaching the play-offs three times . In the 2013 – 14 season , Dover reached the play-off final for the second successive season and defeated Ebbsfleet United to return to the Conference Premier after a twelve-year absence .

The 1998 National League wild-card tie-breaker game was a one-game extension to Major League Baseball 's ( MLB ) 1998 regular season , played between the Chicago Cubs and San Francisco Giants to determine the winner of the National League ( NL ) wild card . The game took place at Wrigley Field in Chicago , on September 28 , 1998 . The Cubs won the game 5 – 3 , holding the Giants scoreless for the majority of the game until the Giants threatened heavily in the ninth inning and scored all three of their runs . As a result of the game , the Cubs qualified for the postseason and the Giants did not .

Anna wanted to buy a gift for her mom. She had some money in her piggy bank. She asked her dad to take her to the store. He said yes and they went in the car.
At the store, Anna saw many things. She saw toys, books, clothes and flowers. She thought hard. What would her mom like? She saw a pretty scarf. It was red and soft. She liked it. She asked her dad if she had enough money. He said yes and helped her pay.
Anna was happy. She wanted to wrap the scarf for her mom. She asked her dad for some paper and tape. He gave her some. She tried to wrap the scarf. It was hard. The paper was too big. The tape was sticky. She asked her dad for help. He said no. He said she could do it. He said she was brave.
Anna tried again. She folded the paper. She cut it with scissors. She taped it. She made a bow. She did it! She wrapped the scarf. She was proud. She was brave. She gave the scarf to her dad. He smiled. He said she did a good job. He said her mom would love it.
They went back to the car. They drove home. Anna was excited. She wanted to give the scarf to her mom. She hoped she would like it. She hoped she would hug her. She loved her mom. She was happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird who was scared of fire because it made a lot of noise. Every day, the bird watched the fire from afar, scared and worried. One night, the bird heard a voice coming from the fire. It was a voice that was kind and gentle - the voice of a kind old man. The old man said he was brave and was not scared of the fire. He asked the bird if it wanted to come closer, so it could be brave too.
The little bird was very scared but thought about it for a while. Slowly, it hopped one step closer to the fire, and it felt a bit better. The old man said he could help the bird if it trusted him. He said if it took one more step, he would show it something special.
The bird decided to trust the man, so it took one more step and saw the fire was actually giving out a lot of light and warmth. Suddenly, the bird felt safe and the fire did not feel so scary anymore.
The old man then taught the bird the importance of trust. If it had not trusted the old man, it would have never known how warm and cozy the fire could be. The kind old man said friendship and trust makes people feel safe and happy and that it was wise to be thoughtful when meeting someone new.
The little bird thanked the kind old man, as it had learnt an important lesson that day:

One day, a cheerful little girl named Lily went to the park with her mom. They saw a big tree with a top that reached up high into the sky. Lily wanted to climb the tree and see the view from the top. Her mom said, "Be careful, Lily!"
Lily started to climb the tree. She saw a cute squirrel on a branch. The squirrel said, "Hi, Lily! Do you want to weigh this nut with me?" Lily said, "Yes, Mr. Squirrel!" They found a big leaf and put the nut on it. The leaf went down a little because the nut was heavy.
After they weighed the nut, Lily climbed more and reached the top of the tree. She saw her house, the park, and even her friends playing. She felt so happy and said, "Wow! I can see everything from up here!" Then, she carefully climbed back down and told her mom all about her adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a big reef in the sea. On the reef, there lived a creative fish named Fin. Fin loved to make new things with the shells he found.
One day, Fin saw another fish named Gilly. Gilly was playing with a pretty shell. Fin wanted the pretty shell too. Fin and Gilly began to quarrel. "This shell is mine!" said Fin. "No, it's mine!" said Gilly.
A wise old turtle saw them quarrel. He said, "Why don't you both be friends and share the pretty shell?" Fin and Gilly thought about it. They stopped the quarrel and became friends. They played together with the pretty shell and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tim. Tim lived in a high tree with his family. He loved to fly and play with his friends all day.
One day, Tim saw a big jail near his tree. He was curious and wanted to see what was inside. Tim flew closer and saw a cat trapped in the jail. The cat was very sad and began to cry.
Tim wanted to help the cat, so he flew back to his friends. Together, they found the key to open the jail. They set the cat free and everyone was happy. The cat stopped crying and became friends with Tim and his friends. They all played together and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby cat named Kitty. Kitty loved to play games with her friends. One day, she saw her friends playing a new game. Kitty wanted to play too, but she didn't understand the game.
Kitty asked her friend, Doggy, "How do you play this game?" Doggy said, "It's easy, just jump over the stick and run back. But you have to be fast!" Kitty tried to play, but she was not fast. She was too chubby to jump over the stick.
Kitty kept trying to play the game, but she couldn't. She felt sad and cried. Her friends told her, "Kitty, you need to eat less and move more. Then you will be fast and can play the game." But Kitty didn't listen. She kept eating and not moving. She never learned to play the game and was always sad.
The moral of the story is to listen to your friends when they try to help you. If Kitty had listened, she would have been able to play the game and be happy.

Mommy and Daddy took Jane to the park. Jane saw a man with a bald head. She pointed and asked Daddy what it was. Daddy told Jane it was a bald head. Jane thought it was funny and she started to laugh.
The man stared at Jane. Jane didn't know what to do, so she hid behind Daddy. Daddy put his hand on her shoulder and said it was ok. Jane slowly looked up at the man.
The man smiled at Jane, and then he said hello. Jane smiled and waved back. She felt brave and said hello back. Daddy laughed and told her she had said hello to the bald man. Jane giggled and asked if she could pet the bald man's head.
Daddy laughed and said no. But he said Jane could pet his bald head instead. Jane smiled and pet Daddy's bald head. She liked the funny feeling of the smooth, bald head. It was much better than the hairy heads she had seen before. 
Jane smiled atDaddy and said she thought bald heads were funny. Daddy laughed and said it was ok to make jokes about bald heads. But he also said it was important to be respectful of other people. Jane nodded and said she would remember.

One day, a little bird was sitting in a cold tree. The bird was sad because it could not sing a song. All the other birds could sing, but this little bird could not.
A kind squirrel saw the sad bird and wanted to help. The squirrel went to the bird and asked, "Why are you sad?" The bird said, "I can't sing a song like the other birds." The squirrel tried to explain how to sing, but the bird still could not do it.
The squirrel had an idea. It found a nice, warm place for the bird to sit. The bird felt better in the warm place. The squirrel explained how to sing again. This time, the bird tried and could sing a beautiful song. The bird was happy, and the squirrel was happy too. They sang songs together all day long.

One day, a little girl named Amy went outside to play in the spring. The sun was shining, and the flowers were pretty. She saw a big rock and tried to move it. But it was difficult. She tried and tried, but the rock did not move.
Amy's friend, Tom, came and saw her. He said, "What are you doing?" Amy told him, "I want to move this rock, but it is difficult." Tom said, "Let's try together!" So, they both pushed and pushed, but the rock remained in the same place.
Suddenly, a wise old bird flew down and said, "You must be smart and think of a way to move the rock." Amy and Tom thought and thought. Then, they found a long stick and used it to push the rock. The rock moved! They were so happy and played together all day long.

Once upon a time there lived a little girl named Mary. Mary loved to eat cocoa. One day Mary decided to go to the big orange house. She knocked on the door and a kind old man opened the door. 
The kind old man asked Mary, "Why have you come to my house?" 
Mary smiled and said, "I want to receive cocoa." 
The kind old man smiled and said, "Well, it just so happens I have an orange cocoa pot!" 
The kind old man gave Mary some orange cocoa and she thanked him kindly. Mary ran back home and enjoyed her cocoa with joy. 
The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and wonder about the world. One sunny day, she saw a big tree with a delicious red jelly hanging from it. Lily had never seen a jelly tree before.
Lily called her friend, Tom, and said, "Tom, come see the jelly tree!" Tom ran over and looked at the tree. "Wow!" he said. "Can we eat the jelly?"
Lily and Tom picked the red jelly from the tree. They took it to Lily's mom, who said, "This jelly looks delicious! Let's share it with our friends."
So, Lily, Tom, and their friends all enjoyed the delicious red jelly from the jelly tree. They laughed and played, and had a great time together. From that day on, Lily and Tom always wondered what other amazing things they might find in their world.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby cat named Lucy. Lucy liked to take a tour around her big yard every day. She would walk and walk, looking at the trees and the flowers.
One sunny day, while Lucy was on her tour, she saw a big hole in the ground. She wanted to look inside but she was scared. Lucy decided to remain near the hole and wait to see if anything would come out.
Suddenly, a little mouse popped out of the hole! Lucy was very surprised. She thought the mouse would be scared of her, but it wasn't. The mouse said, "Hi, I'm Molly! Want to be friends?" Lucy was so happy to make a new friend. From that day on, Lucy and Molly played together every day during Lucy's tour.

Once upon a time, there was a fox who was running through a field. The fox was very dirty but he just kept running and running.
Suddenly, the fox heard a voice calling him to stop. He looked up and saw a little girl looking at him. She said, "Come here, fox!"
The fox ran right away, but the girl kept calling out to him. He couldn't help himself and stopped to listen.
The girl said, "You're so dirty! I want you to be clean. I'm going to snap my fingers and make you clean."
The fox wasn't sure what to do. He just stood there and waited. Then, the girl snapped her fingers. But nothing happened. The fox was still as dirty as ever.
The girl was disappointed. She said, "Oh, too bad! You won't ever be clean now." Then she walked away, leaving the poor fox standing in the field.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She loved exploring and every day she found something new. One day, as she was exploring, she came across an amazing freezer. "What's this?", Lucy said as she pulled on the handle. Suddenly, the freezer opened, and there was a loud noise. 
"What was that?", Lucy asked. Suddenly, a voice came from the freezer. "It's me!", said the voice. Lucy was so surprised and curious, so she peered inside. There was a little robot!
"Hello", said the robot. "I'm Bellow. I've been stuck in this freezer for a long time. Can you help me out, please?"
Lucy was amazed at the robot. She smiled and said, "Of course I can help you! Let's pull you out of the freezer together!" Together, Lucy and Bellow pulled, and with one big tug, Bellow was free. 
Lucy had found something amazing. Her new friend, Bellow!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue had a fan. The fan was hidden under her bed. Sue hoped to find it on a hot day.
One hot day, Sue looked under her bed. She found her hidden fan! Sue was happy. She hoped the fan would make her cool. Sue took the fan outside to play.
Sue played with her fan all day. The fan made her cool in the sun. Sue was glad she found her hidden fan. Sue hoped to play with her fan every hot day.

One morning, a little girl named Michelle woke up very early. She was so excited that she decided to take a walk in the woods. As she walked, she saw something that made her stop. It was a fat, juicy steak! She wanted to take it home and eat it. 
She grabbed the steak and started walking home. But suddenly, a big, scary monster appeared from behind a tree! The monster started to scream very loudly. Michelle was so scared that she dropped the steak, and started running away.
Back home, Michelle told her mother about the monster. Her mother warned Michelle not to go back to the woods. But Michelle wanted to get the steak, so she decided to go back the next day.
The next day, Michelle was ready. She marched into the woods and the monster was waiting for her! This time, the monster didn't scream. But Michelle was still scared. She reached out to grab the steak, and the monster didn't do anything. It seemed like it wanted Michelle to take it.
Surprised and happy, Michelle grabbed the steak and ran home with it. It was the best steak she had ever had! She realized that the monster wasn't as scary as she thought. It had just been protecting its food.

Once upon a time, there lived two friends named Jack and Jill. One day they decided to take a walk. As they walked, they saw a beautiful house with a dependable roof. Jack and Jill stopped and wondered what was inside the house.
Jack said to Jill, "Let's examine the roof." Jill agreed, and they started to climb up to the roof. When they got there, they marveled at how dependable the roof was, and enjoyed the view of the beautiful nature around them.
Suddenly, Jack said, "Look, there is something inside, let's go and have a look!"
Jill agreed, and so they climbed down from the roof and ventured into the house. What a surprise! There was a big pile of toys waiting for them. Jack and Jill started playing with the toys, and that's how they spent their whole day.
