Once upon a time, there was a nice lady. She had a pot and a spoon. She was very impatient. Every day she would stir the pot with her spoon to make something yummy.
One day she decided to try a new way. She put some fruit in the pot and she stirred it for a long time. Finally, the fruit became a delicious jam.
The lady shared the yummy jam with everyone. Everyone was so happy because it tasted so delicious!
The next day the lady was just as impatient. She stirred the pot again, but this time with some vegetables. She created a yummy vegetable soup.
Once again, the lady shared the soup with everyone. Everyone was so happy again!
From then on, the lady kept finding new ways to stir her pot. Every day she made something new and delicious!

Once upon a time, there was a little monkey named Momo. Momo lived in a big tree with his family. One day, Momo went to the market with his mom. At the market, they saw many things to buy. Momo's mom wanted to buy a cheap toy for him.
Momo found a toy he liked. He said, "Mom, I want this toy, please!" His mom looked at the toy and saw it was cheap. She said, "Okay, Momo, you can have this toy."
On the way home, Momo played with his new toy. But, oh no! The toy got dirty. Momo was sad. His mom said, "Don't worry, Momo, we can wipe it clean." So, Momo and his mom wiped the toy with a cloth.
When they got home, Momo showed his new toy to his dad. His dad smiled and said, "Wow, Momo, that's a nice toy!" Momo was happy and played with his toy all day.
From that day on, Momo took care of his toy and always wiped it clean. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a good cat named Tom was playing with his friend, a little dog named Max. They were having fun in the park when Max fell down and hurt his leg. Max cried, "Tom, help me! My leg hurts."
Tom knew he had to help his friend. He saw an ambulance nearby and called out, "Please, help my friend Max!" The ambulance man came over and looked at Max's leg. He said, "Don't worry, we will take Max to the doctor."
Tom wanted to go with Max, but the ambulance man said, "I'm sorry, Tom. We cannot permit you to come with us. It is not safe for a cat to ride in the ambulance." Tom was sad, but he knew the ambulance would take good care of Max.
Later, Tom went to visit Max at the doctor's office. Max had a bandage on his leg and was feeling much better. Max said, "Thank you, Tom, for getting help. You are a good friend." Tom was happy that Max was okay, and they promised to always take care of each other.

Once upon a time, there was a dependable painter named Tom. Tom was always happy and loved to paint. He would paint beautiful pictures on his canvas, which he would give to his friends to celebrate. 
One day Tom wanted to try something different. He decided to celebrate by bringing his friends to a fun party! Everyone was so excited, especially Tom. 
After the party ended, Tom's friends asked him âHow did you plan such an amazing party?â.
Tom smiled and said âIt was easy! I had help from my dependable painter. He brought us all the things we needed to celebrate!â 
Tom and his friends thanked the painter for being so dependable, and they all laughed and celebrated together. 
And that is how Tom and his friends celebrated their special day.

Once upon a time, there was a tidy little house. In the house lived a nice cat and a happy dog. They liked to play together.
One day, they wanted to gain a new friend. They saw a little fire outside. The fire was not too big, but it was alone. The cat and the dog thought the fire could be their new friend.
But, the fire was not a good friend. The fire got too big and tried to hurt the house. The cat and the dog got water and put the fire out. They learned that not all things can be friends. They were happy with just each other.

Once upon a time, there was a king named Tom. He liked to travel very much. One day, he wanted to go to a far away place. So, he got on his slow horse and started his trip.
As King Tom went on his journey, he met a small cat. The cat said, "Hello, King Tom! I want to travel with you!" King Tom smiled and said, "Yes, you can come with me, little cat."
They traveled together for a long time. One day, they found a big box. King Tom opened the box, and guess what? The small cat turned into a big lion! The lion said, "Thank you, King Tom, for helping me. I was a lion under a spell, and you set me free!" King Tom was very happy, and they became good friends. They traveled together and had fun every day.

Once upon a time, in a bright sunny park, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her friends and always had a big smile on her face. One day, Lily was playing with her toy crab, and she thought it would be fun to pinch her friends like the crab did.
So, Lily went to her friend Tom and pinched him gently. Tom laughed and said, "Hey, that's like your toy crab!" Lily smiled and nodded. Then, she went to her friend Sue and pinched her too. Sue giggled and said, "That's so funny, Lily!"
After pinching all her friends, Lily felt happy. She saw that her friends were laughing and smiling too. They all played together in the bright sun, and they had a great day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a polite little girl named Mia. She loved to play in the earth, making mud pies and digging holes. One day, while she was playing, she found a shiny, round rock. Mia thought it was very pretty, so she picked it up and showed it to her mom.
Her mom looked at the rock and said, "Mia, this is a magic rock. When you need something, just ask the rock and it will help you." Mia was very happy and took the rock with her everywhere she went. 
One day, Mia was playing with her friends and they needed a ball to play a game. Mia remembered her magic rock and asked it for a ball. Suddenly, the rock turned into a big, bouncy ball! All of Mia's friends were very surprised and happy. They played with the ball all day long. When they were done, Mia said "thank you" to the rock and it turned back into a shiny, round rock. From that day on, Mia always remembered to be polite and ask for help when she needed it.

Once upon a time, there was a bee named Buzzy. Buzzy lived in a hive with his family. The hive was in a tree near a big flower field. Buzzy loved to go to the flower field every day.
One day, Buzzy saw a tasty treat on the ground. It was a big, red apple. Buzzy wanted to eat the apple, but he was scared to go down. He thought about the apple all day and all night.
The next day, Buzzy decided to go down and get the apple. He flew down from the hive and landed on the apple. But when Buzzy touched the apple, it was not tasty. It was bad and made Buzzy sick. Buzzy was sad and wished he had stayed in the hive with his family.

Lisa was a little girl who liked to imagine. She had many toys, but her favorite was a rag doll. She called her doll Anna and pretended that Anna was her best friend. They would talk, play, and hug every day.
One day, Lisa's big brother Tom came into her room. He saw Lisa and Anna on the bed and laughed. "What are you doing with that old rag?" he asked. "That's not a real doll. It's ugly and dirty. You should throw it away and get a new one."
Lisa felt sad and angry. She loved Anna and did not want to lose her. She said to Tom, "Anna is not a rag. She is my friend. She is beautiful and kind. You are mean and rude. Go away and leave us alone."
Tom did not listen. He grabbed Anna and ran out of the room. He wanted to tease Lisa and make her cry. He threw Anna into the trash can outside and shouted, "Bye-bye, rag!"
Lisa ran after him and saw what he did. She screamed and cried. She tried to get Anna out of the trash, but it was too high and dirty. She felt helpless and alone.
Mom heard the noise and came outside. She saw Lisa and Tom and asked what happened. Tom told her the truth and said he was sorry. He realized he was wrong and hurt Lisa's feelings. Mom scolded him and told him to apologize to Lisa and give her back Anna.
Tom said he was sorry to Lisa and lifted her up to the trash can. Lisa reached for Anna and hugged her tight. She was happy to have her friend back. She thanked Tom and forgave him.
Mom smiled and hugged them both. She said, "I'm glad you made up. You are brother and sister, and you should love and respect each other. It doesn't matter what your toys look like, as long as they make you happy. And it doesn't matter what others think, as long as you are kind and honest. Remember, the most important thing is what's in your heart."
Lisa and Tom nodded and agreed. They learned a lesson and felt sorry for their fight. They decided to play together and share their toys. They went inside and had a peaceful afternoon. Lisa and Anna were happy, and so was Tom.

One day, a group of ants went on a march. They wanted to find a big score of food. They walked and walked, looking for something yummy to take back to their home.
As they marched, they found a comfortable spot with lots of food. The ants were so happy! They started to pick up the food and carry it back home. But then, something unexpected happened.
A big gust of wind came and blew all the food away! The ants were sad, but they did not give up. They marched again, and this time, they found an even bigger score of food. They took it back to their home and shared it with their friends. The ants were happy and knew that even when things go wrong, they can still find a way to make it right.

Once upon a time, there was a little brown dog. He lived in a house with a big yard. In the yard, there was a tall sunflower. The dog loved to play near the sunflower every day.
One day, the dog saw a squirrel near the sunflower. The squirrel did not belong there. The dog barked and chased the squirrel away. The dog was happy that he saved the sunflower.
But then, something unexpected happened. The sunflower started to shake and bend down. The dog was scared. But then, the sunflower turned into a big, friendly bird! The bird thanked the dog for saving her. The dog was so surprised but happy. Now, the dog and the bird played together every day. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big bookcase in a small room. The bookcase had many books in it. It was very cold in the room, so the bookcase was cold too.
One day, a cat named Kitty came into the room. Kitty saw the bookcase and wanted to climb it. Kitty stretched her legs and jumped up onto the bookcase. She was very happy to be up high.
Kitty sat on the cold bookcase and looked around. She saw a warm sunbeam coming through the window. Kitty stretched again and jumped down from the bookcase. She lay in the warm sunbeam and took a nap. The end.

Once upon a time, in a big nation, there lived many animals. They were angry at each other. They did not play or talk to each other. The nation was not a happy place.
One day, a wise old owl said, "We should not be angry. We should unite and be friends." The other animals listened to the owl. They thought about what the owl said.
The animals talked to each other. They said, "Let's not be angry. Let's unite and be friends." The animals played and laughed together. The nation was happy again.

In July 2000 , McCall accepted his first coaching role , when he was appointed assistant manager to Chris Hutchings at Bradford City , after Hutchings was promoted from the role to replace Paul Jewell as City manager . Just four months later , Hutchings was sacked , and McCall was appointed as caretaker – player manager . His first game in the role was against his former team Everton , who were led by his former manager Walter Smith , but ended with a 1 – 0 defeat . He was in charge for one more game , which also ended in defeat , until Jim Jefferies was appointed the new manager . Jefferies brought with him his own assistant Billy Brown , and McCall was appointed first-team coach .

Once upon a time there was a pig who wanted to go for a ride. He asked a polite boy if he would help him.
The boy said, "Yes, I can help you ride."
So the pig got on the boy's back and they rode through the fields. The pig was happy to be riding on the boy's back with the wind blowing in his face.

One day, a little girl named Mia found a box of jewelry. She was very glad. The jewelry was shiny and pretty. Mia wanted to wear it all.
Mia tried to put on a necklace, but it was hard. She started to struggle with it. Mia's big sister, Lily, saw her trying. Lily wanted to help her sister.
Lily came over and helped Mia with the necklace. They worked together and soon, Mia was wearing the pretty jewelry. Mia was very happy and thanked her sister. They both smiled and played with the jewelry all day.

Once upon a time, there was a big swamp. In the swamp, there lived a frog. The frog was very sad and miserable. He did not have any friends to play with.
One day, a little girl named Lucy came to the swamp. She saw the frog and wanted to be his friend. Lucy took a step into the swamp to get closer to the frog.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She had a big stack of toys in her room. Amy loved to play with her toys, but she did not like to share them with her friends.
One day, Amy's friend Tom came over to play. Tom saw the stack of toys and asked, "Can I play with your toys, Amy?" Amy did not want to share, but she knew it was the right thing to do. So, she said, "Yes, you can play with my toys, Tom."
They played together all day and had lots of fun. When it was time for Tom to go home, they put the toys back in a stack and covered them with a warm blanket. Amy learned that sharing her toys with her friends made them both happy. The moral of the story is that sharing is caring.

Tommy loved to play with his toy dragon. He named it Spike and he liked to imagine that it was a real dragon that could fly and breathe fire. He would make Spike roar and flap his wings and chase his other toys around the room.
One day, Tommy's mom brought home a surprise for him. It was a big box with a bow on it. "What is it, Mommy?" Tommy asked, excited.
"It's a gift for you, Tommy. Open it and see," Mommy said, smiling.
Tommy tore off the bow and the paper and opened the box. Inside was a huge stuffed dragon, much bigger than Spike. It was green and chubby and had shiny scales and a long tail. Tommy gasped and hugged the dragon. "Wow, Mommy, thank you! It's a giant Spike!"
Mommy laughed and said, "You're welcome, Tommy. I thought you would like it. You can play with it and imagine that it's a real dragon, too."
Tommy was very happy. He put the giant Spike next to his bed and played with it every day. He imagined that they were flying over mountains and forests and having adventures. He still loved his toy Spike, but he liked the giant Spike more. He thought it was more fun and more real.
But one night, something strange happened. Tommy woke up and heard a loud roar. He opened his eyes and saw the giant Spike moving and glowing in the dark. He was scared and confused. He reached for his toy Spike, but it was gone. He looked around and saw that his other toys were gone, too. He saw the giant Spike's mouth open and fire coming out. He realized that the giant Spike was not a stuffed dragon, but a real dragon. And he was hungry. Tommy screamed and tried to run, but it was too late. The giant Spike snapped his jaws and swallowed Tommy whole. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sue. Sue was a regular girl, just like you. She had a friend named Tom. Tom had a big thumb. One day, they went to the park to play.
At the park, they saw a man. He made a sign with his hands. Sue and Tom did not know what the sign meant. They asked the man, "What is that sign?" The man said, "It is a sign for 'hello'."
Sue and Tom learned the sign and said 'hello' to the man. Then, something unexpected happened. Tom's big thumb started to glow! The man was surprised and said, "Your thumb is magic!" From that day on, Sue and Tom used the sign for 'hello' and Tom's magic thumb to make new friends.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a dependable bus driver named Tom. Tom loved to give tours to people on his big, blue bus. Every day, he would drive around the town, showing the people all the nice places.
One sunny day, while Tom was giving a tour, a little girl named Lily noticed that her toy bunny had disappeared. She started to cry. "My bunny is gone!" she said. Tom heard her and stopped the bus. He wanted to help Lily find her bunny.
Tom and all the people on the bus looked for the bunny. They looked under the seats, behind the trees, and in the bushes. Finally, they found the bunny hiding under a big, green leaf. Lily was so happy. She hugged Tom and said, "Thank you for helping me find my bunny!" Tom smiled and said, "You're welcome, Lily. I'm always here to help." And they all continued the tour, happy and smiling.

Lily liked to collect magazines. She had many magazines in her room. She liked to look at the pictures and the words. She wanted to learn more words.
One day, she saw a new magazine at the store. It had a big picture of a dog on the cover. Lily loved dogs. She asked her mom if she could buy the magazine.
"Sorry, Lily, we don't have enough money for that today," her mom said. "Maybe next time."
Lily felt sad. She really wanted the magazine. She looked at the dog again. It had brown fur and black spots. It looked friendly and soft.
She had an idea. She waited until her mom was busy. Then she took the magazine and hid it under her coat. She walked out of the store with her mom. She thought she was very clever.
But when she got home, she found out that the magazine was not what she expected. It was not a magazine about dogs. It was a magazine about gardening. The dog was only on the cover. The rest of the pages had pictures of plants and flowers and tools. Lily did not like plants and flowers and tools. She liked dogs.
And the magazine was not friendly and soft. It was rough and scratchy. It hurt her skin when she touched it. It made her itch and sneeze.
Lily felt bad. She had taken something that was not hers. She had lied to her mom. She had wasted her time. She did not like the magazine at all.
She decided to tell her mom the truth. She hoped her mom would not be angry. She hoped her mom would forgive her. She hoped she could find a real magazine about dogs someday.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a weird toy, a lime. He loved to play with it all day. One day, Tim lost his lime at the park. He was very sad.
Tim went to the park to look for his lime. He saw his friend Sue. Sue saw Tim was sad. "Why are you sad, Tim?" she asked. Tim said, "I lost my lime at the park." Sue wanted to help Tim find his lime.
Tim and Sue looked everywhere for the lime. They looked under the slide, by the swings, and in the sandbox. Finally, they found the lime by a big tree. Tim was so happy to have his lime return. He said, "Thank you, Sue!" They played with the lime together and had a fun day at the park.

McCall started his professional career with Bradford City , where he made his senior debut in 1982 . He played six seasons at Valley Parade , during which time he won the Division Three championship , a title which was overshadowed by the Bradford City stadium fire when 56 people died and in which his father Andy was injured . After missing out on promotion in 1987 – 88 , McCall moved to Everton , for whom he scored twice but finished on the losing side in the 1989 FA Cup Final . In 1991 , he moved to Rangers , with whom he spent seven seasons and won six league titles , three Scottish Cups and two Scottish League Cups . McCall returned to Bradford City as captain to take them into the top division of English football for the first time in 77 years . After four seasons he moved to Sheffield United , where he retired as a player in 2005 .

Anna and Ben love to play soccer in the park. They have a ball and two cones for the goal. They take turns to kick the ball and try to score. Anna is very good at soccer. She can zoom past Ben and shoot the ball into the goal. Ben is not so good at soccer. He tries hard, but he is slow and misses the ball a lot.
One day, they meet a new friend in the park. His name is Sam. He has a red shirt and a big smile. He asks Anna and Ben if he can play soccer with them. They say yes, and they make two teams. Anna and Sam are on one team, and Ben is on the other team. Ben feels sad. He thinks Anna and Sam will win easily, and he will lose.
The game starts. Anna and Sam zoom around the field. They pass the ball to each other and score many goals. Ben runs after them, but he cannot catch them. He feels tired and angry. He wants to score a goal too. He thinks it is not fair.
Then, something happens. Anna kicks the ball too hard, and it flies over the fence. She says, "Oh no! We need the ball to play!" She looks at Sam and Ben. She says, "Who can get the ball back?" Sam shakes his head. He says, "I can't. The fence is too high for me." Anna looks at Ben. She says, "Ben, can you get the ball back? It is very important. We need the ball to play."
Ben looks at the fence. He sees the ball on the other side. He thinks for a moment. He says, "I can try." He runs to the fence. He finds a small hole in the fence. He crawls through the hole. He gets the ball. He crawls back through the hole. He holds the ball in his hands. He feels happy and proud. He says, "I got the ball back!"
Anna and Sam clap their hands. They say, "Well done, Ben! You are awesome! You saved the game!" They hug Ben and smile. Ben smiles too. He says, "Thank you, Anna and Sam. You are my friends. Can we play some more?" They say, "Yes, of course. Let's play some more." They kick the ball and have fun. Ben scores a goal. He zooms around the field. He feels like a star. He thinks soccer is the best game ever.

Live & Kicking is a BBC Saturday morning children 's magazine programme , running from 1993 to 2001 . The fourth in a succession of Saturday morning shows , it was the replacement for Going Live ! , and took many of its features from it , such as phone-ins , games , comedy , competitions and the showing of cartoons . Once Live & Kicking had become established in series two , it reached its height in popularity during series four , when it was presented by Zoë Ball and Jamie Theakston ; their final episode won a BAFTA award . After this the series ratings dropped with the launch of SMTV Live on ITV and was eventually cancelled in 2001 .

The term condom first appears in the early 18th century . Its etymology is unknown . In popular tradition , the invention and naming of the condom came to be attributed to an associate of England 's King Charles II , one " Dr. Condom " or " Earl of Condom " . There is however no evidence of the existence of such a person , and condoms had been used for over one hundred years before King Charles II ascended to the throne .

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play near the water. He liked to throw stones in it and watch the water splash. But his mom was always worried when he went near the water.
One day, Tim asked his mom, "Mom, can I go play near the water?" His mom thought about it and said, "Yes, Tim, but you must be careful. I will allow you to play near the water, but do not go too close."
Tim was so happy! He ran to the water and started to play. He threw stones and watched the water splash. As he played, a little duck came to him. The duck said, "Quack! I am worried about my baby ducks. They are lost. Can you help me find them?"
Tim wanted to help the worried duck. He looked around and saw the baby ducks near the water. He carefully walked over and picked them up. He brought them back to the worried duck. The duck was so happy and said, "Thank you, Tim! You are a good friend."
Tim went back home and told his mom about the worried duck and her baby ducks. His mom was proud of him for being careful near the water and for helping the duck. From then on, Tim and the duck became best friends and played near the water every day.

Once upon a time, there was a fast car. This car was very good at helping people. It could provide help when people were sick or hurt. The car had a big job to do, and it was very good at its job.
One day, the fast car got a call. A little girl was sick and needed to go to the hospital. The car went to her house as fast as it could. The little girl and her mom got in the car. The car was very fast, and they got to the hospital very quickly.
At the hospital, the doctors and nurses helped the little girl feel better. The fast car was happy that it could provide help to the little girl and her mom. The car went back to its home, ready to help more people when they needed it.

The New Zealand Brigade commander had been taken ill , so Birdwood appointed Brigadier-General Harold Walker , a staff officer already ashore , as commander . The Auckland Battalion had landed by 12 : 00 , and were being sent north along the beach to Walker 's Ridge on their way to Russell 's Top . Seeing that the only way along the ridge was in single file along a goat track , Walker ordered them to take the route over Plugge 's Plateau . As each New Zealand unit landed they were directed the same way to Baby 700 . However , in trying to avoid Turkish fire , they became split up in Monash Valley and Rest Gully , and it was after midday that two of the Auckland companies reached Baby 700 .

Once upon a time, there was a jolly boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his blocks. Every day, he would look at his blocks and build big towers.
One sunny day, Tim was playing with his blocks outside. He was building a very big tower. Suddenly, a little bird flew down and sat on top of the tower. Tim was very surprised! He did not know that birds liked to play with blocks too.
Tim and the little bird became good friends. They played with the blocks together and built the biggest tower ever. But then, something unexpected happened. The little bird flew up and pushed the tower with its beak. The tower fell down and all the blocks went everywhere. Tim was sad, but then he saw the little bird was laughing. Tim realized it was just a fun game for the bird. So, Tim laughed too and they played together all day long.

Once there was a young boy who wanted to play a game. He went to a big building and he wanted to steal something. He looked around for something to steal but he couldn't find anything. Suddenly, he saw a young girl playing with a balloon. He decided to steal the balloon from her. He ran away with the balloon. The young girl was very angry and started to cry.
The boy felt bad for stealing the balloon, so he decided to take it back to the young girl. He ran back to the building and returned the balloon to her. The young girl was very happy and thanked the boy. From that day on, the boy learned to never steal again.

Once upon a time, there were twin boys, Tim and Tom. They liked to play with their toys. One day, Tim found a big, red ball. It was so much fun to play with! Tim did not want to share the ball with Tom.
Tom felt hurt that Tim would not share. He was sad and went to sit under a tree. While sitting there, he saw something shiny in the grass. It was a magic key! Tom picked it up and decided to share it with Tim.
Tim was happy that Tom shared the magic key. They used the key to open a secret door in their house. Inside, they found a room full of toys! Now, they had many toys to play with and share. The twins learned that sharing makes everyone happy.

Tim and Sue are friends. They like to play with toys and books. One day, they find a big map in the library. The map shows many nations. Nations are places where people live and have different names.
"Look, this is our nation. It is called Canada. It is big and cold and has many trees," Tim says.
"And this is my nation. It is called China. It is far and big and has many people," Sue says.
They point to other nations and learn their names. They have fun with the map.
But then, Tim sees a nation he does not like. It is called France. It is small and has a funny shape. Tim thinks it is silly.
"I do not like this nation. It is bad and ugly. I will bite it," Tim says.
He opens his mouth and tries to bite the map. Sue is shocked and angry.
"No, Tim, no! You cannot bite the map. That is rude and mean. You will hurt the map and the people in the nation. You have to be nice and respectful," Sue says.
She pulls the map away from Tim and scolds him. Tim feels ashamed and sorry. He realizes he was wrong.
"I am sorry, Sue. I was silly and mean. I will not bite the map again. I will be nice and respectful. I want to learn more about the nations and the people. Can you teach me?" Tim says.
Sue smiles and forgives him. She is happy that Tim learned his lesson. She teaches him more about the nations and the people. They share their stories and cultures. They become better friends.
The moral of the story is: Do not bite what you do not like. Be nice and respectful to others. Learn from your mistakes and grow.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sally. Sally was so happy because she was getting a new toy. She was so excited, she ran to her bedroom to get it.
When Sally opened her bedroom door, she saw all her friends crying. She asked them, "What's wrong?"
Her friend John said, "We were having a cheese party, but all the cheese was gone."
Sally was sad because all her friends were weeping. She wanted to help them so she ran to the kitchen.
"Look," Sally said as she was holding up a big, new cheese. Everyone stopped weeping and cheered. They all hugged and wrapped the cheese in a big hug.
From that day onwards, Sally and her friends were always happy while they enjoyed their cheese and the new toy.

John was playing outside in the garden. He loved to slide down the tall slide, which made him squeal with delight. He would slide over and over again, until his clothes were covered with mud.
John ran to the nearby puddle, with a mischievous smile on his face. But as he was about to slide into it, he saw something he hadn't before. It was a huge, tall monster with huge arms, legs, and a big scary face.
John was terrified and wanted to run away. He scrambled up the tall slide and slid down it quickly, trying to get away from the monster. But the monster chased him and got closer. John was too scared to move.
But suddenly, the monster stopped and started to laugh. It wasn't a monster at all - it was his dad, who was wearing a costume! John was relieved and laughed along with his dad. They hugged each other, and John went back to playing in the puddle.

Tina was excited to go to the park with her Mom and Dad. She liked the park because there were always so many fun things to do. When they arrived, she spotted a colorful slide. She wanted to run right over and give it a try. But then she noticed that it looked a little dull. Her Mom noticed it, too. She told Tina that she and Dad would need to add some sparkles to the slide, so it was pretty enough for her to have fun sliding down. 
Tina and her parents worked together to make the slide look better. They added some paint, some glitter and extra sparkles. After it was all finished, the slide looked so different! Tina was so excited that she didn't even wait for her parents to try the slide first. She ran to the top and slid down in a flash! Now, the slide looked colorful and shiny enough for her to have fun sliding. 
Tina and her parents spent the rest of the afternoon at the park. They had a great time playing and sliding on the colorful slide together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a brown toy dog. He loved his toy dog very much. They played together every day. The toy dog was Tim's best friend.
One day, Tim saw a big, brown toy bear in a store. He wanted the bear so much. He asked his mom if he could have it. Mom said, "You can have the bear if you are good for one whole week."
Tim tried very hard to be good. He helped mom with the dishes, and he was nice to his little sister. At the end of the week, mom said, "You have been very good, Tim. Let's go get the brown toy bear."
Tim was so happy when he got the brown toy bear. Now, he had two brown toy friends to play with. He played with his toy dog and toy bear every day. They all had lots of fun together.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy had a candle that she loved very much. The candle was her friend, and she would talk to it every night.
One day, Amy's friend Sam came to play. Sam saw the candle and wanted to play with it, too. Amy was scared that Sam would break her candle. But she wanted to be a good friend, so she let Sam play with it. They were both very happy.
In the end, Amy learned that sharing made her and her friends happy. She also learned that being kind and sharing with others is important. And from that day on, Amy and Sam played together with the candle, and they were always happy.

In 1853 the Royal Society 's project was concluded , and the observatory was set to be abandoned . After a lengthy debate , the fledgling colonial government decided to take over its operation . Rather than disappearing like its three counterparts , the Toronto observatory was upgraded , and its mission was expanded as it became a meteorological station ( see Meteorological Service of Canada ) under the direction of the Ministry of Marine and Fisheries . During the expansion , the original buildings were replaced with a permanent structure .

John was a 3 year old boy who had a clock that he loved very much. Every day he would look at it and say, "Wow, my clock is so clean!"
One day, something strange happened. The clock started to move in reverse. John had never seen this before and he was so curious. He wanted to figure out why the clock was going in reverse.
John asked his mom, "Why is my clock going in reverse?". His mom replied, "Oh honey, don't worry about it. It will go back to normal soon."
However, every day the clock kept going in reverse. It was a mystery! John asked his mom multiple times, but his mom never had a good answer.
John kept trying to find a solution himself. He thought that maybe he could reverse the clock. He figured out a way to do it.
John tried to reverse the clock, but it didn't work. In fact, the reverse had broken the clock. Now it would never work correctly again.
John had to go without his beloved clock. He was so sad and he wished that he had never tried to reverse the clock.

Once upon a time there was a nice girl named Jane. Jane loved to help people. One day, Jane was playing with some paper. She wanted to make something special out of the paper. She thought it would be nice to make a picture and give it to someone who could use some help.

Once upon a time, in a big blue sea, there was a red dolphin named Dolly. She loved to play with her fish friends all day long. They would swim, jump, and laugh together.
One day, Dolly's fish friend, Finny, said, "I want to quit playing. I am tired." Dolly did not want to stop, but she knew it was important to listen to her friend. So, they took a break and rested near some pretty rocks.
After a little while, Finny felt better and said, "Thank you, Dolly. I am not tired anymore." Dolly was happy to hear that, and they started to play again. They swam and jumped, having lots of fun. And from that day, Dolly and Finny always made sure to take breaks when they needed to.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty dog named Max. Max was a big, strong dog who liked to help people. One day, Max saw a little cat who was stuck in a tree. The cat was very sad and scared.

Everyone saw what Max did and they all clapped their hands. They all said "Yay!" and "Good job, Max!" Max felt very proud and happy. He knew he had done a good thing by helping the cat. And from that day on, Max and the cat became best friends.

Ben and Mia were twins who liked to play together. They had many toys, but their favorite was a big dollhouse. They pretended to be a family and made up stories.
One day, they decided to play lawyers. They put on their dad's ties and glasses and used books as papers. Ben was the lawyer for the dollhouse family, and Mia was the lawyer for the toy car family. They had a problem: both families wanted to use the same parking spot.
Ben and Mia sat on the floor and talked to each other.
"I think the dollhouse family should have the parking spot, because they have more dolls and need more space," Ben said.
"No, I think the toy car family should have the parking spot, because they have faster cars and need to go to work," Mia said.
They could not agree. They started to raise their voices and argue. They got angry and frustrated.
Then, Mia did something naughty. She reached over and pinched Ben's arm hard. Ben felt a sharp pain and cried out.
"Ow! That hurts! Why did you pinch me?" Ben asked.
"Because you are a bad lawyer and you don't listen to me," Mia said.
"That's not fair! You are a mean lawyer and you don't share," Ben said.
They both felt sad and sorry. They did not want to fight. They wanted to play and have fun.
They looked at each other and said, "I'm sorry."
They hugged and made up. They decided to be nice lawyers and find a solution. They agreed to take turns using the parking spot and to play with both the dollhouse and the toy car families.
They were excited and happy. They continued to play and laugh. They learned to be good lawyers and good friends.

Once upon a time, in a rich, green garden, there lived a happy bunny named Spring. Spring loved to hop and play all day long. One day, while hopping around, Spring found a big prune tree. The tree had many sweet prunes. Spring wanted to eat them.

Once upon a time, in a wide green park, there lived a tiny insect named Buzz. Buzz was a happy insect who loved to play and make new friends. One sunny day, Buzz found a shiny ring on the ground. The ring was very pretty, and Buzz wanted to keep it.
Buzz showed the ring to his friend, Hop, the bunny. Hop told Buzz that the ring belonged to someone else, and they should try to find the owner. But Buzz did not want to give the ring back. He thought it would make him happy to keep it.
Hop and Buzz went on a search to find the owner of the ring. They asked all their friends if they had lost a ring. Finally, they found the owner, a little girl who was very sad because she lost her ring. When Buzz gave the ring back to the girl, she was so happy, and she thanked Buzz and Hop. Buzz felt good inside for doing the right thing. The moral of the story is that it is better to be honest and kind, rather than keeping something that does not belong to you.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a small house with her mom, dad, and her dog, Max. Lily and Max loved to play outside in the sun. One day, they saw a big cloud of dust in the sky.
"Max, what is that?" Lily asked. "Woof!" Max barked, wagging his tail. They decided to join their friends, Tim and Sam, to find out what was making the dust.
As they got closer, they saw a big truck with tasty ice cream on it. "Wow, look at that!" said Tim. "Yummy!" said Sam. Lily, Max, Tim, and Sam all went to the truck and got some ice cream.
"Thank you!" they said to the ice cream man. They all sat down and enjoyed their tasty treats. The dust was gone, and they had a fun day with their friends.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a red fox. The red fox was very fast and very smart. One day, while the red fox was playing, he saw a hunter. The hunter was looking for animals to catch. The red fox knew he should run away, but he decided to ignore the hunter and keep playing.
The hunter saw the red fox and started to follow him. The red fox did not know the hunter was behind him. He kept playing and having fun. The hunter was getting closer and closer, but the red fox still did not know.
At last, the hunter caught the red fox. The red fox was very sad. He wished he had not ignored the hunter when he first saw him. If he had run away, he would still be free and happy in the big forest.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Ben. Ben loved to play and act in front of his friends. One day, Ben found a big bow in the park. The bow was red and shiny. Ben thought it was pretty, so he put it on his head.
Ben went to his friends and started to act silly. He jumped and danced around with the bow on his head. His friends laughed and clapped. But one of his friends, a cat named Tom, thought Ben looked stupid with the bow on his head. Tom told Ben he was not funny, but Ben did not listen.
Ben kept acting silly with the bow on his head. His friends stopped laughing and began to walk away. Ben felt sad and took off the bow. He went to Tom and said sorry for acting stupid. Tom forgave Ben, and they all played together again. The moral of the story is: always listen to your friends and be yourself.

Inland areas are warmer in summer and colder in winter . Usually around 40 days of the year are below freezing 0 ° C ( 32 ° F ) at inland weather stations , compared to 10 days at coastal stations . Ireland is sometimes affected by heat waves , most recently in 1995 , 2003 , 2006 and 2013 . In common with the rest of Europe , Ireland experienced unusually cold weather during the winter of 2009 / 10 . Temperatures fell as low as − 17. 2 ° C ( 1 ° F ) in County Mayo on 20 December and up to a metre ( 3 ft ) of snow fell in mountainous areas .

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a boy named Tim. Tim was a part of a club where kids played and had fun. One day, it was very rainy and Tim felt miserable. He wanted to play with his friends, but he couldn't go out.
Tim thought of an idea. He said to his mom, "Mom, can we unlock the big room so the club can play inside?" His mom smiled and said, "That's a great idea, Tim! Let's do it!" So, Tim and his mom unlocked the big room and all the kids from the club came over.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was very good at running fast. One day, he found a long stick called a spear. He liked to play with the spear all day.
In the village, there was a big, angry bear. The bear was hungry and wanted to eat people. The villagers were tired of the bear and wanted to escape. So, they made a plan to catch the bear using Tim's spear.

There was an event at the park. Jack and Julie were excited to go but their mom told them it had to be a modest event. So Jack and Julie left the house and went to the park.
When they got to the park, they looked around but all they could see was a pile of dirt. Jack said, "Mom said it was an event! Where is it?!" Julie said, "Maybe there's something buried here?"
So Jack and Julie started to dig. Sure enough, after a short time, they found a box buried in the dirt. Jack said, "We found something! Open it up, Julie!" Julie said, "Ok!"
When Julie opened the box, she found a strange creature inside. Jack and Julie screamed in terror. "Run!" Jack shouted, and they both ran away as fast as they could.

Once upon a time, there was a little ant who loved to work. He would work all day in the hot sun, carrying food to his ant friends. One day, he met a lazy grasshopper who did not like to work.

The grasshopper laughed and said, "You worry too much. I will be fine." But the ant did not listen and kept working.
Soon, winter came, and it was very cold. The ant and his friends were warm and had food because they had worked hard. The grasshopper was cold and hungry. He went to the ant's home and asked for help. But the ant said, "You did not work, so you do not get food."

One day, a boy named Tim went for a walk with his dog, Max. They walked to the park where they saw a big fog. Tim could not see very well, but he could hear Max barking. He called out, "Max, where are you?"

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a modest kitchen. In this kitchen, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy loved to help her mom cook. One day, Amy's mom went to the store and left Amy alone in the house.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Bob and Sue. One day, Bob said to Sue, "I have a joke for you." Sue was excited, so she said, "Tell me!"

Jill was hungry. She wanted lunch. She asked Mom for lunch. Mom said, "Not now, Jill. I am busy. Wait a little bit."

Once upon a time, there was a little pet dog named Spot. Spot was a happy dog, but sometimes he was impatient. He wanted to play all day long and did not like to wait.

One day, a clever cat named Penny went for a walk. She liked to look for fun things to play with. Penny loved the sun on her face and the grass under her feet.

One day, a little girl named Lily went for a walk. She saw a pretty red flower called Poppy. Poppy was not an ordinary flower. She could talk! Lily and Poppy started to discuss the weather. They talked about the sun and the rain.
As they talked, something unexpected happened. A big wind came and blew Poppy away. Lily was very sad. She looked for Poppy everywhere, but could not find her. She missed her new friend.

Anna and Ben were best friends. They liked to play in the park near their homes. There was a big oak tree in the park. It had many branches and leaves. Anna and Ben liked to climb the oak tree and pretend they were birds.
One day, they found a nest in the oak tree. It had three eggs inside. They were blue and speckled. Anna and Ben were very curious. They wanted to see the eggs up close. But they also knew they should not touch them. The eggs belonged to the mother bird.
"Let's just look at them, but not touch them," Anna said. "We can be honest and careful."
"OK," Ben agreed. "But we have to be quick. The mother bird might come back soon."
They climbed up the oak tree and reached the nest. They peeked inside and saw the eggs. They were very pretty. Anna and Ben smiled.
Suddenly, they heard a loud squawk. It was the mother bird. She was angry. She saw Anna and Ben near her nest. She thought they wanted to hurt her eggs. She flew towards them and flapped her wings.
"Uh-oh," Anna said. "We have to go. Now!"
Anna and Ben were scared. They climbed down the oak tree as fast as they could. They ran away from the park. They did not want to make the mother bird more angry.
They reached their homes and hugged each other. They were glad they were safe. They also felt sorry for the mother bird. They did not mean to upset her.
"We should not have gone near the nest," Ben said. "It was wrong."
"You're right," Anna said. "We should have left the eggs alone. They were not ours."
They learned their lesson. They decided to be more honest and respectful. They also decided to be more careful. They did not want to end their friendship over a mistake. They loved each other very much.

" True Blue " was released in the United States in October 1986 . It debuted on the Billboard Hot 100 at number 40 , six weeks later it reached its peak of number three , remaining at the position for three consecutive weeks , and spent a total of 16 weeks on the chart . The song performed equally well on the other Billboard charts , peaking at number five on Adult Contemporary , and number six on the Hot Dance Club Songs chart . In October 1998 , the single was certified gold by the Recording Industry Association of America ( RIAA ) for shipment of 500, 000 copies . In Canada , the song debuted at number 84 the RPM singles chart on September 27 , 1986 , reached the top for one week in November 1986 , and stayed on the chart for 23 weeks . It ended at the 37th position of the year-end chart .

" Underneath " is the twelfth episode of the ninth season of the American science fiction television series The X-Files . The episode first aired in the United States on March 31 , 2002 on the Fox network . The episode was written and directed by executive producer John Shiban . The episode is a " monster-of-the-week " episode , a stand-alone plot which is unconnected to the mythology , or overarching fictional history , of The X-Files . The episode earned a Nielsen rating of 4. 4 and was viewed by 4. 64 million households and 7. 3 million viewers . It received mixed reviews from critics .

One day, a big cat and a little dog were in the park. They both liked to play on the bench. But today, the cat was not happy. The cat wanted to sit on the bench alone. The dog felt sorry for the cat and let the cat sit alone.

Once there was a Mommy who loved her three year old son very much. She always wanted to take care of him. So, Mommy prayed to God every day. She asked God to always keep her son safe and happy.
One day, Mommy decided to take her son to the park. But, when they got there, it was all filled with junk! Everything was broken and unplayable. Mommy was very sad, so they went home.
Mommy didn't want to forget all the junk, though, so she decided to make something special. She made a delicate sculpture out of the junk. It was so beautiful, and she could keep it forever.
Mommy and her son looked at the sculpture every day and remembered their visit to the park. They also said a special prayer for all the junk and for all the happy times.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a dog named Spot. Spot was a very upset dog. He was always hungry and wanted some meat to eat. One day, Spot saw a big piece of meat on the table in a house. He really wanted it.
Spot went to the house and tried to speak to the people inside. He said, "Woof, woof! Can I have some meat, please?" But the people did not understand Spot. They just looked at him and said, "Go away, dog!" Spot was very sad.
Spot tried to find another way to get the meat. He climbed up a tree near the house and jumped onto the roof. But he slipped and fell down. Spot was hurt and still very hungry. He did not get the meat and the people were still upset with him.

One day, a bunny named Bob wanted to play golf. He put on his hat and hopped to the golf place. The sun was hot, and the grass was green.
Bob saw his friend, Tim the frog. Tim was eating a tasty bug. "Hi, Bob!" Tim said. "Do you want to play golf with me?" Bob asked. Tim said, "Yes, I love golf!"
They hopped and played golf all day. They hit the ball and laughed. When they were done, they ate tasty bugs together. They were very happy and had lots of fun.

One day, a thoughtful boy named Tim went to a party. At the party, there were many balloons. Tim really liked balloons. He saw a big, red balloon that he wanted to take home. But there was only one big, red balloon at the party.
Tim's friend, Sue, also wanted the big, red balloon. They both looked at the balloon and didn't know what to do. Tim said, "I want the balloon." Sue said, "I want it too." They both felt sad and didn't want to fight.
Tim thought for a moment and decided to share the balloon with Sue. He said, "Let's share the balloon. We can play with it together at the party and then take turns taking it home." Sue liked the idea and they both felt happy.
So, Tim and Sue played with the big, red balloon at the party. They took turns holding it and made sure it didn't fly away. At the end of the party, Tim let Sue take the balloon home first. They were both happy and became even better friends.

One day, a bird and a bee were playing near a big tree. The bird saw a cobweb and said, "Look, a cobweb! Let's dive and see what's there." The bee said, "Okay, let's go!" They both dived towards the cobweb.
As they got closer, they saw a spider on the cobweb. The spider was very loud and said, "Hello, friends! Do you want to play with me?" The bird and the bee were scared but decided to play with the spider.
They played a game of tag. The bird, the bee, and the spider ran and flew around the tree. Suddenly, the spider tripped and fell. The cobweb caught the spider and saved him from falling. The bird and the bee cheered, and they all laughed together. They became good friends and played together every day.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park. He saw a big bush with red berries on it. Tim was very hungry, so he wanted to eat the berries. But he was not sure if the berries were ready to eat.
Tim saw a girl named Sue playing nearby. He walked over to her and said, "Sue, do you think these berries are ready to eat?" Sue looked at the berries and said, "I don't know, Tim. I have never seen berries like these before."
Tim and Sue decided to try the berries. They each picked one and ate it. The berries did not taste good. In fact, they tasted very bad. Tim and Sue felt sick to their stomachs. They wished they had not eaten the berries.
From that day on, Tim and Sue learned to never eat berries they didn't know about. They also told their friends about their bad experience, so they wouldn't make the same mistake.

Once upon a time, there was a big truck. The truck was very quiet. It drove down the street without making any noise. People would stop and admire the truck as it went by.
One day, the quiet truck met a little boy named Tim. Tim loved the truck and said, "Wow! I admire your truck. It's so quiet and big!" The truck was happy to hear this and replied, "Thank you, Tim! I am happy to be quiet and big."
Tim and the quiet truck became good friends. They would play together every day. Tim would ride in the truck and they would go on fun adventures. Everyone in the town loved the quiet truck and admired it very much. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once there was a little girl named Anna. Anna liked to learn the names of things. Every morning she would grab her dictionary and run to her mommy. 
One day she woke up and the dictionary was gone. Anna felt so sad. She looked everywhere but couldn't find it. She started to cry. 
Just then, she saw it. It was in the garden and it looked broken. Anna ran up to her mommy and told her what had happened. Her mommy was very sad too. 
But they decided to fix the dictionary. They tape and glued it back together. When they were done, it was better than before. Anna was so happy and she couldn't wait to start learning names again.

Once upon a time, there was a restless little boy named Tim. He liked to run and play all day. One day, he found an onion in the kitchen. Tim thought it was a ball, so he picked it up and played with it.
While playing, Tim saw his friend, the cat, sleeping on the floor. Tim wanted to play with the cat too, so he rolled the onion to the cat. The cat woke up and didn't like the smell of the onion. The cat felt upset and slapped the onion away with its paw.
Tim was sad that the cat didn't want to play with the onion. But then, his mom came into the room and saw the onion on the floor. She smiled and said, "Let's put the onion back in the kitchen and find a real ball to play with." Tim and his mom found a ball, and they played with the cat. The cat was happy, and so was Tim. They all had a fun day together.

One day, a little infant went to nap in his bed. His mom gave him a big, soft, fake bear to hug. The infant was very happy with his bear. He closed his eyes and started to nap.
While the infant was napping, the fake bear came to life! The bear looked around the room and saw the infant. The bear wanted to play, but the infant was still napping. So, the bear waited for the infant to wake up.
After a while, the infant woke up from his nap. He saw the bear was alive and got very excited. They played and laughed all day. When it was time for the infant to nap again, the bear became fake once more. The infant hugged the bear and went back to sleep, happy to have a magical friend.

One sunny day, Betty had a small notebook with her. She was very excited to see what was inside and thought it would be fun.
Betty opened the notebook and saw that it was filled with lovely pictures. She smiled and ran outside, eager to share her notebook with others.
While running, Betty spotted a shiny object on the ground. She quickly picked it up and found it was a beautiful bracelet. It shone in the sunlight and Betty knew she had to have it.
Suddenly, she heard a voice. It was an old woman yelling at her.
"That is mine! Give it back!"
Betty didn't want to give it away, so she ran away with the bracelet. The old woman was very angry and shouted after her.
When Betty got home, she realized the bracelet was fake. She was very sad and wished she had given it back to the old woman. Her small notebook also seemed less fun as the bracelet had shone so brightly.

Once there was a small dog named Spot. Spot had a new toy. He loved to play with his new toy all day. One day, Spot felt a little shiver. He did not know what it was. He went to his mom and dad.
Spot told his mom and dad about the shiver. They said, "Maybe it will happen again. Just wait and see." Spot went to play with his toy again. He still felt happy but also a little scared.
The next day, Spot felt the shiver again. This time it was a big shiver. It was an earthquake! Spot's mom and dad came to him. They were all safe. Spot was happy he told his mom and dad about the shiver. They were ready for the earthquake.

Kubica 's strong finish promoted BMW Sauber to the lead in the Constructors ' Championship , after BMW driver Nick Heidfeld finished fourth . Ferrari and McLaren trailed , one and two points behind , respectively . Räikkönen took the lead in the Drivers ' Championship , with 19 points , three points ahead of Heidfeld and five ahead of Hamilton , Kubica and Kovalainen , with 15 races remaining in the season .

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a clown named Bobo. Bobo loved to make people laugh and be happy. He had a big red nose, funny shoes, and a silly hat. Every day, he would go to the park and play with the kids.
One day, a boy named Timmy saw Bobo and said, "You look stupid!" This made Bobo very sad, and he started to cry. Timmy felt bad for making Bobo cry, so he said, "I'm sorry, Bobo. I didn't mean to hurt your feelings."
Bobo stopped crying and said, "Thank you, Timmy. It's okay. We all make mistakes." Timmy and Bobo became friends, and they played together in the park every day. The other kids in the park saw how much fun they were having and wanted to be friends with Bobo too.
Soon, everyone in the town loved Bobo the clown, and they all learned a very important lesson: it's not nice to call people names or make fun of them. We should always be kind and treat others the way we want to be treated. And that is how Bobo the clown taught the town the value of being kind to one another.

One day, a bird named Bob was ready to soar. He flapped his wings and went up in the sky. He saw his friend, the cat named Sam, on the ground. Sam had a small cut on his lip.
"Sam, are you okay?" asked Bob as he flew down to see him. Sam looked sad and said, "I am okay, but I want to soar like you, Bob."
Bob thought for a moment and had an idea. He found a big leaf and told Sam to hold on tight. Then, Bob carried the leaf with Sam on it, and they began to soar together.
But as they were flying, something unexpected happened. The wind blew very hard, and Sam lost his grip on the leaf. He fell down and landed on the ground with a thud.
Bob quickly flew down to check on his friend. Sadly, Sam was not okay this time. He had many cuts and a big bump on his head. Bob felt bad for trying to make Sam soar like a bird. From that day on, he never tried to make his friends do things they were not meant to do.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to visit her grandma. Grandma lived in a small house with a big garden. Lily loved to play on the floor with her toys when she was at grandma's house.
One day, while playing on the floor, Lily found a fake bug under the table. She thought it was real and screamed. Grandma came running to see what was wrong. Lily showed her the fake bug, and they both laughed.
Then, something unexpected happened. The fake bug started to move! It was not a fake bug after all. It was a real bug that just looked fake. Lily and grandma were very surprised. They let the bug go outside, and from that day on, they always checked if a bug was real or fake before they played with it.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. While they were walking, Tim found a prune on the ground. He picked it up and showed it to his mom. "Look, mom, a prune!" he said. His mom said, "That's a nice prune, Tim. But we should test it to see if it is good to eat."
They took the prune to a wise old man who lived near the park. He was known to be very reliable. They asked the old man, "Can you test this prune for us?" The old man agreed and took the prune. He looked at it closely and then something unexpected happened.
The prune started to grow bigger and bigger! It turned into a giant prune! The old man, Tim, and his mom were all very surprised. The old man said, "I have never seen a prune like this before!" Tim and his mom laughed, and they all enjoyed the rest of the day playing with the giant prune at the park.

Miami got off to a good start doing just that as it raced out to four consecutive wins to begin the season , including a victory over nationally ranked rival No. 9 Florida State . On October 11 , however , Miami traveled to South Bend , Indiana , to face the Notre Dame Fighting Irish and suffered its first loss of the season to the undefeated Irish , who would go on to be ranked No. 1 in the country . This defeat was followed in succession by two others , but the Hurricanes were able to stop the slide on November 8 with a homecoming win over East Carolina . Miami added two more wins before the end of the season , and brought the regular season to a close with an overall record of 8 – 3 .

Once upon a time, a mom and her daughter went to visit their friend. The friend lived in a small house near a big tree. The daughter was kind and liked to help others. Her mom was proud of her.
As they walked, they saw a little bird with a hurt wing. The compassionate daughter wanted to help the bird. The mom said, "We can take the bird to our friend's house. Maybe she can help the bird too."
When they got to the friend's house, the friend opened the door. The mom and daughter were surprised! Their friend was a bird too! The friend said, "I can help the little bird." The daughter was happy. They all became good friends and helped the little bird together.

Once upon a time, in a small and cozy house, there lived a powerful cat named Tom. He loved to jump on soft cushions and take naps. One day, he found his cushions all mixed up and messy.
Tom had an idea. "I will organize my cushions, so I can nap better!" he said to his friend, a little mouse named Jerry. Jerry was very smart and liked to help Tom. "I will help you, Tom!" said Jerry.
They worked together to fix the cushions. Tom put the big ones on the bottom, and Jerry put the small ones on the top. When they were done, the cushions looked very nice. Tom and Jerry smiled at each other.
"Thank you, Jerry!" said Tom. "Now we can both enjoy the cushions together." They sat on the organized cushions and took a long nap. From that day on, Tom and Jerry learned that working together made things easier and more fun. And they lived happily ever after.

One day, a little girl named Mia went to play in the park. She saw a small, delicate flower on the ground. Mia wanted to take a closer look at the flower, so she kneeled down. The flower was very pretty, and Mia smiled.
While Mia was looking at the flower, a boy named Max came running. Max wanted to race with Mia. They both stood up and got ready to run. They ran very fast, and Mia won the race. Mia felt happy about her victory.
Mia and Max played in the park all day. They had lots of fun together. They ran, jumped, and laughed. When it was time to go home, Mia and Max said goodbye. They knew they would play together again soon.

Observation made of the atmosphere of Venus simultaneously from Earth-based telescopes and from the Venus Express gives scientists a better opportunity to understand the intermediate level of Venus ' atmosphere than is possible from either viewpoint alone . This will provide new information about the climate of the planet .

Tim and Kim are twins. They like to play in the park. They see a big boot on the grass. They run to the boot and look inside.
"Who left this boot here?" Tim asks.
"Maybe a giant," Kim says.
They discuss what a giant would look like. They think he would be very tall and strong and have big feet.
"Maybe he is hungry," Tim says.
"Maybe he likes to eat boots," Kim says.
They laugh and pretend to be giants. They pick up the boot and pretend to bite it.
"Yuck, this boot is not tasty," Tim says.
"Let's find something else to eat," Kim says.
They put the boot back on the grass and run to the swings. They have fun playing in the park. They forget about the boot and the giant.

Once there was a boy and he was three years old. He liked playtime with his friends, but he often felt very sleepy. One day, his friends asked him to come and play with them. He wanted to go but he was so sleepy he said no. He sat down in front of a cupboard and he hated it.
The cupboard was very big and it was made of wood. He was scared of it. It looked like it was watching him. He thought it wanted him to be scared. He started to cry.
He asked his mummy to help him, but she said she was too busy. She told him to stop being so silly and not to be scared of the cupboard. He didnât understand why she said that.
He started to get angry and he started to throw things at the cupboard. He was so angry that he didnât even notice the big hole he had made in the cupboard! He ran away and he never saw that cupboard again. 
He never got over his fear of cupboards and he always felt like he was being watched by something. It was a bad ending for him and he never felt the same again.

One day, a little boy named Tim saw a broken toy car on the ground. Tim wanted to fix the toy car. He tried and tried, but the car was still broken. Tim was persistent. He didn't give up. He asked his mom for help.
"Mom, can you help me fix this car?" Tim asked. Mom came over and looked at the broken toy car. "I see the point that is broken," Mom said. She took some glue and helped Tim fix the car. They waited for the glue to dry.
When the glue was dry, the toy car was fixed. Tim was so happy. He learned that being persistent and asking for help can fix things. Tim played with the toy car all day, knowing that he didn't give up and fixed it with his mom's help. The moral of the story is to never give up and always ask for help when you need it.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She liked to play in the park. One sunny day, she saw a small, fragile mushroom. It was all alone under a big tree.
Amy said to the mushroom, "Hello, little mushroom! Do you want to play with me?" The mushroom did not talk, but it seemed to nod its head. So, Amy decided to lead it to her friends.
Amy and the mushroom walked to her friends, Tom and Sue. Tom and Sue were very happy to see the fragile mushroom. They all played together and had lots of fun.
At the end of the day, Amy said, "Goodbye, little mushroom! We will come back and play with you again soon!" The mushroom seemed to smile and wave goodbye. And they all went home, excited to play together again another day.

Lily and Ben are twins. They like to walk in the park with Mom and Dad. They see many things in the park. They see trees and flowers and birds and squirrels. They also see a big pond with ducks and fish.
One day, they see something new in the park. They see a deer. The deer is brown and has antlers. The deer is very shy and runs away when it sees people. Lily and Ben want to see the deer better. They follow the deer quietly.
But the deer is hurt. It has a bad cut on its leg. It bleeds and limps. Lily and Ben feel sad for the deer. They want to help the deer. They call Mom and Dad. Mom and Dad see the deer too. They say the deer is poor and needs a vet.
They call the park ranger. The park ranger comes with a truck and a net. He catches the deer gently and puts it in the truck. He says he will take the deer to the vet. He says the vet will fix the deer's leg and make it well. He says he will bring the deer back to the park when it is better.
Lily and Ben are happy. They hope the deer will be well soon. They say goodbye to the deer and thank the park ranger. They go back to the pond and feed the ducks. They say they will come back to the park and look for the deer again. They love the park and the animals.

Once upon a time, there was a big event in a small town. All the kids were very excited. They wanted to stand and watch the event. The event was a big parade with many fun things to see.
In the parade, there were clowns, balloons, and funny animals. The kids laughed and clapped their hands. They were very happy. But then, something unexpected happened. A scary monster came into the parade.
The kids were scared and wanted to run away. But the monster took off its head, and it was just a man in a costume. The man said, "Don't be scared, kids! I am not a real monster. I am here to make you laugh too!" The kids laughed and clapped their hands again. The scary monster was not scary after all. The event was fun and everyone had a great time.

Once upon a time, there was an adorable little dog named Spot. Spot loved to run and play in the park. One day, when he was playing, he saw a path he had never seen before. He decided to follow the path to see where it went.
As Spot walked down the path, he met a big cat named Whiskers. Whiskers said, "Hello, Spot! I saw you on this path and wanted to say hi." Spot replied, "Hi, Whiskers! I've never been on this path before. Have you?" Whiskers mentioned, "Yes, I have. It's a fun path to walk on."
They both walked down the path together, talking and laughing. Soon, they reached the end of the path and found a beautiful pond. They played by the pond all day, splashing in the water and chasing each other. At the end of the day, they were both very tired but happy. Spot and Whiskers had found a new place to play and a new friend in each other.

Season 2 ran 23 episodes from March 13 , 2011 to November 27 , 2011 , though many sources refer to the episodes airing from September 25 , 2011 to November 27 , 2011 as Season 3 . This is due to a short hiatus from June 5 , 2011 to September 25 , 2011 .

Sara and Ben are twins who like to play with paper. They can fold paper into many shapes, like birds, boats and hats. They have a lot of fun making paper crafts.
One day, they find a big book of paper crafts in their room. The book has many pictures of different things they can fold. They are very excited and want to try them all.
They start to fold a cell, which is a small box with many sides. They follow the steps in the book and make a cell with red paper. They think it looks very pretty and want to show it to their mom.
They run to the kitchen, where their mom is cooking. They see a big pot on the stove, with steam coming out. They think it is water and want to put their cell in it.
They say, "Mom, look what we made! It is a cell! Can we put it in the water?"
Their mom turns around and sees them holding the paper cell. She says, "No, no, no! That is not water, that is soup! It is very spicy and hot! It will burn your cell and your fingers! You should not touch the pot, it is dangerous!"
She takes the cell from them and puts it on the table. She hugs them and says, "I am glad you are safe. I am sorry your cell is ruined. But you can make another one later. You are very good at folding paper. But you should always ask before you touch something you do not know. You should be careful and listen to your mom. Do you understand?"
Sara and Ben nod and say, "Yes, mom. We understand. We are sorry. We will be careful and listen to you. We love you."
Their mom smiles and says, "I love you too. Now, do you want to help me make some bread? You can fold the dough and make shapes with it. It is not spicy and hot, it is soft and yummy."
Sara and Ben say, "Yes, mom. We want to help you. We like to fold dough and make shapes. It is fun and tasty."
They wash their hands and go to the counter, where their mom gives them some dough. They start to fold it into different shapes, like stars, hearts and flowers. They have a lot of fun making bread crafts. They learn that folding can be fun, but they should also be careful and listen to their mom.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a big pair of pants that his mom gave him. He loved his big pants very much. They were red and blue, just like his favorite toy car.
One day, Tim went to play at the park. He saw a girl named Sue who was sad. Sue didn't have any pants to wear, and she felt cold. Tim wanted to help Sue and make her happy. He thought about what he could do.
Tim decided to give Sue his big pants. Sue was so happy and thanked Tim. They played together all day at the park. Tim learned that sharing and giving can make others happy, and that made him happy too.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Anna. She was three years old.
Anna wanted to play, so she went outside. She saw a lot of noisy birds singing in the trees. Anna was very happy. She smiled and nodded her head.
Then Anna heard a loud noise. It was her mom and dad playing in the garden. They were being very noisy. Anna smiled and nodded her head again.
Anna wanted to join in the fun too. She ran over and started to play with her parents. They played together until it was time to go home.
When it was time to go inside, Anna was very tired, but also very happy. She smiled and nodded her head one last time before going inside.

Once upon a time there was a furry, brown dog. His name was Fido and he loved to race. One day, Fido was keen to go racing. He ran to the nearest store and waited at the door. 
The storekeeper came out and said, "Sorry, Fido, no dogs allowed".
Fido tried his best to explain, "But I just want to race!"
The storekeeper shook his head, "No, no. No racing inside the store".
Fido didn't give up. He thought hard and came up with an idea. He started to race around the store, going faster and faster. 
The storekeeper couldn't help but laugh and let Fido keep racing. Fido was so happy, he was still racing around the store by the time the sun went down.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom was a little sad and miserable. He wanted to play with his friends, but they all lived far away. Tom had an idea. He would mail a letter to his friends and ask them to play.
Tom found a piece of chalk and wrote a letter on the sidewalk. He wrote, "Dear friends, please come play with me. Love, Tom." Tom was not sure how to mail the letter. He thought and thought. Then, he had another idea. He would take a picture and mail the picture.
Tom took a picture of the letter and went to the mailbox. He put the picture in the mailbox and waited. The next day, something unexpected happened. Tom went outside and saw his friends standing there. They had all received the picture and came to play with him.
Tom was so happy. He was not miserable anymore. They all played and laughed together. From that day on, Tom and his friends always found ways to play together, even when they were far apart. And it all started with a piece of chalk and a letter.

On defense , Virginia Tech linebacker Ashley Lee 's 15 tackles remains the most ever recorded by a Tech defender in a bowl game .
