Tom and Lily like to play with their toy boat. They take it to the pond and sail it on the water. They pretend they are pirates and look for treasure.
One day, they see a big orange ball in the sky. It is the sun, but it looks very bright and round. Tom and Lily think it is a gold coin.
"Look, Lily, a gold coin!" Tom says. "We can get it and be rich!"
"How can we get it, Tom?" Lily asks. "It is too high and too far."
Tom has an idea. He takes out his camera and points it at the sun. He presses the button and makes an image of the sun on the camera screen.
"See, Lily, I got the gold coin!" Tom says. "Now we can buy anything we want!"
Lily looks at the image and smiles. She thinks Tom is very clever. She hugs him and says, "You are the best pirate, Tom! And I am the best pirate too!"
They sail their boat back to the shore and show their image to their mom and dad. They are very proud of their treasure. Mom and dad are very happy and give them a hug and a kiss. They tell them they love them very much. Tom and Lily love them too. They are a happy pirate family.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim really wanted a puppy to play with. One day, he saw a powerful puppy near his house. The puppy was big and strong.
Tim went to the puppy and said, "Hi, puppy! I want to play with you." The puppy looked at Tim and wagged its tail. They played all day and had lots of fun. Tim was very happy.
But then, something unexpected happened. The powerful puppy started to grow even bigger! It grew so big that it could not play with Tim anymore. Tim was sad and said, "Bye, big puppy." The big puppy walked away, and Tim never saw it again.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck named Ducky. Ducky loved to splash in the pond all day. One day, while Ducky was playing, he saw a tiny needle on the ground. Ducky didn't know what it was, so he went to ask his friend, Bunny.
Bunny was a fearful rabbit who was always afraid of new things. When Ducky showed Bunny the needle, Bunny got scared. He told Ducky to be very careful with it because it could hurt them.
Ducky and Bunny decided to take the needle to their friend, Owl. Owl was very wise and knew many things. Owl told them that the needle could be used to fix things, but they need to be careful. So, Ducky and Bunny put the needle in a safe place and went back to the pond to splash and play together.

Once upon a time, there was a small, attractive bird named Beaky. Beaky loved to fly high up in the sky, close to the ceiling of the clouds. One day, Beaky saw something shiny and pretty far away. He knew he had to find it.
Beaky flew close to the ground, looking for the shiny thing. He saw a big tree and knew it was hiding the pretty thing. Beaky flew around the tree, getting closer and closer. He could not wait to see what it was.
Finally, Beaky found the shiny thing. It was a beautiful, sparkly nest! Beaky was so happy that he had found the attractive nest. He made the nest his new home, close to the ceiling of the clouds, just like he always wanted. And Beaky lived happily ever after.

One day, a little dog named Spot was playing in the park. He was running and jumping and having lots of fun. Today was a very sunny day, and Spot was glad to be outside.
While playing, Spot saw a big red ball. He wanted to play with the ball, so he ran to it. But when he tried to catch the ball, he missed it. Spot felt a little sad, but he didn't give up.
Spot tried again and again to catch the ball. Finally, he caught it! Spot was so glad that he didn't miss the ball today. He played with the ball all day long and had lots of fun.

One day, a big tree had a small leaf. The leaf was green and happy. The tree wanted to teach the leaf how to dance with the wind.
"Leaf, I will teach you to dance," said the tree. "When the wind blows, you move like this." The tree showed the leaf how to dance. The leaf tried to dance, but it looked foolish. The tree and the leaf laughed.
Then, something unexpected happened. A bird came and sat on the leaf. The bird was heavy, but the leaf did not break. The tree was surprised. The bird said, "Leaf, you are strong. You can dance with me." The leaf danced with the bird, and it was not foolish anymore. The tree was happy, and they all danced together.

Once upon a time, in a far away land, there was a weird big animal named Bobo. Bobo was very kind and liked to help others. One day, while Bobo was walking, he met a little bird named Lulu. Lulu was sad, so Bobo asked, "Why are you sad, Lulu?"
Lulu said, "I am sad because I cannot fly like my friends. I feel heavy and I don't know why." Bobo wanted to help Lulu, so he thought of an idea. "Maybe you have something in your feathers that makes you weigh more," said Bobo.
Bobo and Lulu looked at Lulu's feathers and found a tiny toy war soldier stuck in them. They took it out and Lulu felt lighter. Lulu tried to fly and she could! Lulu was so happy and thanked Bobo for his help. From that day on, Bobo and Lulu became best friends and played together all the time.

Once upon a time there was a big bossy monster. He was mean and he always wanted to be in charge. Every day he would make everyone perform silly jobs. Everyone was scared of him.
One day a small monster came to visit. He was nice and very brave. He offered to help with the jobs. He didn't even want the bossy monster to tell him what to do. He just wanted to help out of the love in his heart.
The bossy monster didn't like this at all. He was mad that someone wasn't scared of him. He was even madder that someone was being so nice. The bossy monster got so angry that he chased the small monster away and nobody ever saw him again. 
The end.

The two species of Corythosaurus are both present in slightly different levels of the Dinosaur Park Formation . Both still co-existed with theropods and other ornithischians , like Daspletosaurus , Brachylophosaurus , Parasaurolophus , Scolosaurus , and Chasmosaurus .

Lily and Ben were playing in the garden with a hose. They liked to spray water on the flowers and the grass. Sometimes they sprayed each other and laughed.
"Look, Lily, a butterfly!" Ben said, pointing to a big yellow and black one. "It is so pretty and rare. I want to catch it."
Ben ran after the butterfly with the hose. He tried to spray it, but he missed. The butterfly flew away. Ben was sad.
"Ben, don't spray the butterfly!" Lily said. "It is not nice. The butterfly will feel pain. You will hurt its wings."
Lily put down the hose and went to Ben. She gave him a hug. "It's okay, Ben. There are more butterflies. We can watch them, but not spray them. They are our friends."
Ben nodded. He felt sorry for the butterfly. He hugged Lily back. "You are right, Lily. I am sorry. I will be nice to the butterflies. They are our friends."
Lily and Ben smiled. They held hands and walked to the flower bed. They saw many butterflies of different colors. They were happy. They watched them and said hello. They did not spray them. They were kind to them.

Ben and Sam were brothers who liked to play near the old mill. The mill was big and black and made a lot of noise. Sometimes they saw the miller come out with sacks of flour. They wondered what was inside the mill.
One day, they decided to sneak into the mill when the miller was away. They climbed over the fence and ran to the door. They pushed it open and saw a lot of machines and wheels and belts. They were curious and wanted to touch everything.
But they did not see the sign that said "Danger! Keep out!" They did not hear the miller coming back. They did not notice the belt that was moving fast and caught Sam's shirt. Sam screamed and Ben stared in fear. The belt pulled Sam towards the big wheel that was spinning and grinding.
The miller heard the scream and ran to the mill. He saw Ben and Sam and quickly turned off the machines. He freed Sam from the belt and checked if he was hurt. Sam was scared and crying, but he only had some scratches and bruises. The miller was angry and shouted at them. He told them to never come back to the mill and to stay away from danger.
Ben and Sam learned a lesson that day. They said sorry to the miller and ran back to their home. They told their mom what happened and she hugged them and scolded them. She told them to always obey the signs and to be careful and smart. They promised to never go to the mill again and to play in safer places. They were glad that they were not badly hurt and that the miller was kind. They understood that the mill was not a place for fun, but for work.

Once upon a time, there was a big crocodile named Coco. Coco was an amazing crocodile with many friends. One day, Coco's toy ball broke. Coco was very sad.

The island has two groups of caves in the rock-cut architectural style . The caves are hewn from solid basalt rock . All caves were painted in the past , but only traces remain . The larger group of caves , which consists of five caves on the western hill of the island , is well known for its Hindu sculptures . The primary cave , numbered as Cave 1 , is about 1. 5 km ( 0. 93 mi ) up a hillside , facing the ocean . It is a rock-cut temple complex that covers an area of 5, 600 m2 ( 60, 000 sq ft ) , and consists of a main chamber , two lateral chambers , courtyards , and subsidiary shrines . It is 39 metres ( 128 ft ) deep from the front entrance to the back . The temple complex is the abode of Shiva , depicted in widely celebrated carvings which reveal his several forms and acts .

Once upon a time, there was a sailor named Tom. Tom was a good sailor, but he was embarrassed because he could not pray. Every night, he would watch his friends pray before they went to sleep. Tom wanted to learn how to pray, but he did not know how.
One day, Tom asked his friend, Sam. "Sam, can you teach me how to pray?" Sam smiled and said, "Of course, Tom! It is easy. Just close your eyes and talk to the sky." Tom did as Sam said, but he still felt embarrassed. He was scared that he was not doing it right.
The next night, Tom tried again. He closed his eyes and talked to the sky. This time, he felt better. He was not embarrassed anymore. Tom had learned how to pray, thanks to his friend Sam. Now, Tom could pray with his friends every night before they went to sleep.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a cute little bear named Ben. Ben loved honey very much. One day, it was very wet and rainy outside, but Ben still wanted to find some honey to eat. He put on his rain boots and went out to look for honey.
Ben walked for a long time and saw a big tree. He thought, "I hope there is honey in this tree!" Ben climbed up the tree and found a beehive full of honey. He was so happy! But he also saw a sad bee sitting on a branch. "Why are you sad?" Ben asked the bee.
The bee said, "I am sad because my wings are wet and I can't fly home." Ben wanted to help the bee. He said, "I will help you get home, and then we can share the honey together!" The bee smiled, and they became friends. Ben carried the bee on his back, and they went to the bee's home.
When they got to the bee's home, the bee's family was so happy to see her. They thanked Ben for helping her. The bee's family gave Ben lots of honey to take home with him. Ben and the bee were both very happy, and they knew they would be friends forever.
From that day on, Ben and the bee always shared honey together, even on wet and rainy days. And they always remembered to help each other when they needed it.

One day, a humble boy named Tim found a kayak near the river. He wanted to play with it. Tim called his friend, Sam, to come and see the kayak.
"Sam, come here! I found a kayak," said Tim. Sam came running and saw the kayak. They were both very happy. They decided to enter the kayak and play in the river.
As they played in the kayak, the water began to move fast. Tim and Sam got scared. They tried to paddle back to the land, but the water was too strong.

Once upon a time, there was a colorful journal. It was a very special journal. It could print anything you wanted. A little girl named Lily had this journal. She loved to draw and write in it.
One sunny day, Lily went to the park with her journal. She sat under a big tree and started to draw a pretty flower. She wanted to print the flower in her journal. But something unexpected happened. Instead of the flower, a big, friendly bear appeared on the page.
Lily was surprised but not scared. The bear smiled at Lily and jumped out of the journal. They played together all day long. They ran, jumped, and laughed. Lily and the bear became best friends.
At the end of the day, the bear said, "I must go back to my home now." Lily was sad but understood. She printed the bear back into her colorful journal. From that day on, whenever Lily wanted to play with her bear friend, she would print him out of her journal. And they lived happily ever after.

One day, a little girl named Lucy went to the park. She saw a big tree with a small hole in it. Lucy thought it was the perfect spot to sit and have her snack. She sat down and took out her yummy apple.
A little squirrel came up to Lucy and said, "Hello! That apple looks very good. Can I have some?" Lucy smiled and broke off a piece of her apple for the squirrel. They shared the snack and talked about their day.
The squirrel told Lucy that the hole in the tree was his home. He said, "This is where I belong. I keep my food and my toys here." Lucy was happy to make a new friend and share her snack. They played together until it was time for Lucy to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a slow snail named Sam. Sam loved to travel around the garden. One day, Sam met a friendly worm named Wally.
"Hi, Wally!" said Sam. "Do you want to travel with me?"
"Sure, Sam!" said Wally. "Let's go!"
As they traveled, they saw a big, long hose. The hose was used to give water to the plants. Sam and Wally decided to travel along the hose to see where it went. They moved very slow because they were small.
At the end of the hose, they found a beautiful flower. They were so happy to see it. Sam and Wally sat near the flower and talked about their slow travel. They had so much fun together.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big parade. All the people in the town were happy. They liked to watch the parade. They saw many fun things in the parade, like big balloons and pretty flowers.
In the parade, there was a man who did a foolish dance. He wore a funny hat and had a big red nose. He made everyone laugh. The little kids loved to watch him dance and do tricks.

Once upon a time, there was a little black dog named Spot. Spot loved to play and run in the park. One day, Spot saw a tunnel. He was very curious and wanted to see what was inside.
Spot went into the tunnel and it was very dark. He heard a voice say, "Hello, I am Momo the mouse. Be careful, or you will regret going further." Spot didn't listen to Momo and kept going. Soon, he was lost and scared.

I won't go into dark tunnels again." Momo smiled and said, "It's okay. Now you know to be careful and listen to your friends." And they both played happily in the park.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a very hairy dog named Buddy. Buddy loved to dance to the rhythm of the music that played in the village. All the people in the village would clap and laugh when they saw Buddy dance.
One day, a new dog named Max came to the village. Max did not like to dance, and he did not like to see Buddy dance. Max would bark loudly and make Buddy stop dancing. The people in the village were sad because they missed Buddy's dancing.

Once upon a time, there was a big, scary cat. The cat lived in a small house. In the house, there was a table. The cat liked to sit under the table. One day, a little mouse came to the house.
The mouse was very scared of the big, scary cat. But the cat saw the mouse and said, "Welcome, little mouse. Do not be scared. I will not hurt you." The mouse was happy and went to sit with the cat under the table.
The cat and the mouse became good friends. They played together and ate food on the table. The mouse was not scared of the big, scary cat anymore. They lived happily in the small house and always welcomed new friends.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a black cat named Tom. Tom was a good cat who liked to follow the law. One day, Tom went for a walk and saw a little girl named Sue. Sue was sad because she lost her toy.
"Hi Sue," said Tom. "Why are you sad?"
"I lost my toy," said Sue. "Can you help me find it?"
Tom and Sue looked for the toy together. They looked near the big tree and under the small bridge. They looked near the pond and in the park. At the end of the day, they found the toy under a bush.
Sue was very happy. "Thank you, Tom!" she said. And they became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a big ugly figure. He lived in a dark cave. All the kids were scared of him. They would not go near the cave.
One sunny day, a little girl named Lily walked by the cave. She saw the ugly figure and stared at him. She was not scared. The figure stared back at her. Lily said, "Hi, I am Lily. What is your name?"
The ugly figure was surprised. No one had ever talked to him before. He said, "I am Tom. No one wants to be my friend because I am ugly." Lily smiled and said, "I will be your friend. It is not nice to call someone ugly."
Tom and Lily became best friends. All the kids in the town saw that Tom was not scary. He was just lonely. They all became friends with Tom. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a curious little girl named Lily. She loved to explore and learn new things. One day, Lily saw her mom display a big cup of coffee on the table. Lily had never seen coffee before and she wanted to know what it was.
"Mommy, what is that?" Lily asked, pointing at the cup. Her mom smiled and said, "That is coffee, Lily. It is a drink for grown-ups, not for little girls like you."
Lily was very curious about the coffee. She wanted to know what it tasted like, but she knew she had to listen to her mom. Instead, she decided to display her toys on the floor and pretend they were having a tea party. She poured pretend coffee into little cups for her toys and had a fun time playing.
Later, her mom saw Lily's display of toys and smiled. She was proud of her curious little girl for finding a way to learn about coffee without trying it. Lily was happy too, because she got to have a fun tea party with her toys.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. She had a toy bunny that was her prize. Mia loved her bunny so much. One day, while playing, the bunny got a big tear. Mia felt fearful.
Mia's mommy saw her sad face and asked, "What's wrong, Mia?" Mia showed her mommy the tear on her bunny. Her mommy said, "Don't worry, we can restore your bunny."
Mia's mommy took a needle and thread. She sewed the tear and made the bunny look new again. Mia was so happy to see her prize bunny fixed. She gave her mommy a big hug and said, "Thank you, mommy!" Mia was not fearful anymore. They played with the bunny all day and lived happily ever after.

Anna and Ben were twins who loved to play music. They had a drum, a flute, a guitar and a piano. They liked to make loud and lively sounds with their instruments. Sometimes they played together, and sometimes they played alone.
One day, Anna wanted to play the drum, but Ben was already playing it. Anna said, "Ben, give me the drum. I want to play it too."
Ben said, "No, Anna, I was playing it first. You can play the flute or the guitar."
Anna said, "But I don't want to play the flute or the guitar. I want to play the drum. It is the most fun."
Ben said, "Well, I want to play the drum too. It is the most fun."
They started to argue and tug at the drum. They made a lot of noise and their mom heard them. She came to their room and said, "Anna and Ben, what are you doing? You are making too much noise and you are not sharing. You need to settle down and take turns."
Anna and Ben looked at their mom and felt sorry. They said, "Sorry, mom. We were fighting over the drum. We both like it a lot."
Mom said, "I know you both like the drum, but you can't play it at the same time. You have to share and be fair. How about you play the drum for five minutes, and then you switch with your sister or brother? That way, you can both enjoy the drum and the other instruments."
Anna and Ben thought that was a good idea. They said, "Okay, mom. We will do that. Thank you for helping us."
Mom smiled and said, "You're welcome. I'm glad you settled your problem. Now, you can play music nicely and have fun."

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim lived in an ordinary house with a garage. He liked to play with his toys in the garage all day.
One day, Tim found a big box in the garage. He opened the box and found a big, soft bear inside. Tim loved the bear and decided to hold it all the time.
Tim and the bear became best friends. They played together in the garage every day. Tim's mom and dad were happy to see him having so much fun. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy boats. His favorite boat was a little navy boat. He would sail it in his bathtub or the pond near his house.
One sunny day, Tim went to the pond with his navy boat. As he played, he saw another boy named Sam. Sam had a big, shiny boat. Tim felt jealous of Sam's boat. He thought, "I wish I had a boat like that."
Tim walked up to Sam and said, "Hi, I like your boat." Sam smiled and said, "Thank you! I like your navy boat too." They decided to play together and soon discovered that they both loved boats.
As they played, they talked about their boats and shared stories. Tim was not jealous anymore. He was happy to have a new friend who loved boats just like him.
From that day on, Tim and Sam played together at the pond with their boats. They had lots of fun and their friendship grew stronger. And they both learned that it's not the toys you have, but the friends you make that matter the most.

Once upon a time, there was a little frog named Tim. Tim loved to jump all day long. One day, Tim saw a big building. It was a theater. Tim wanted to go inside and see what was there.
Tim jumped into the theater and saw many people. They were all watching a show. Tim saw an icy stage with dancers. The dancers were wearing shiny clothes. Tim thought it was so pretty. He wanted to jump on the icy stage too.
Tim waited for the show to end. Then, he jumped onto the icy stage. He slipped and slid but had so much fun. Everyone clapped and laughed. Tim was happy. He loved the theater and his new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a team of animals. The team had a big dog, a little cat, and a funny bird. They all played together and had fun. But one day, the little cat became jealous of the big dog. The big dog could run fast and jump high, and the little cat wanted to do that too.
One day, a nice man came to the park. He said he could help the little cat if the cat would pay him with a big hug. The little cat was very happy and gave the nice man a big hug. The nice man clapped his hands, and something unexpected happened. The little cat could now run fast and jump high like the big dog!
The big dog, the little cat, and the funny bird played together again. But then, the big dog became jealous of the little cat. The big dog wanted to be the only one who could run fast and jump high. One day, a boy named Tim wanted to play a sport. He liked to be healthy and have fun. Tim asked his mom, "Can I go out and play with my friends?"

They started to play a game of ball. They were all having fun. Then, something unexpected happened. A big dog came running into the game. The dog picked up the ball in its mouth and ran away.
The kids were sad because they could not play without the ball. They decided to follow the dog. The dog led them to a big park. There were many kids playing different sports in the park. Tim and his friends joined in and played all day. They had more fun than they ever imagined.

Boreas displaced 1, 360 long tons ( 1, 380 t ) at standard load and 1, 790 long tons ( 1, 820 t ) at deep load . The ship had an overall length of 323 feet ( 98. 5 m ) , a beam of 32 feet 3 inches ( 9. 8 m ) and a draught of 12 feet 3 inches ( 3. 7 m ) . She was powered by Parsons geared steam turbines , driving two shafts , which developed a total of 34, 000 shaft horsepower ( 25, 000 kW ) and gave a maximum speed of 35 knots ( 65 km / h ; 40 mph ) . Steam for the turbines was provided by three Admiralty 3-drum boilers . Boreas carried a maximum of 390 long tons ( 400 t ) of fuel oil that gave her a range of 4, 800 nautical miles ( 8, 900 km ; 5, 500 mi ) at 15 knots ( 28 km / h ; 17 mph ) . The ship 's complement was 134 officers and enlisted men , although it increased to 142 during wartime .

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He was very restless. He liked to run and play all day long. Tim had a small room with many toys. One day, he saw a big ball in his room. He wanted to play with it, but it was stuck under his bed.
Tim tried to get the ball, but he could not reach it. He felt sad. His mom saw him and asked, "What is wrong, Tim?" Tim said, "I want the ball, but I can't get it." His mom said, "You can do it. Try again and you will succeed."
Tim tried again. He pushed and pulled. At last, he got the ball out from under the bed. He was so happy! Tim succeeded in getting the ball. Now, he could play with it all day long. His mom was proud of him. And Tim learned that with a little help and trying, he could do anything.

Once upon a time, there was a jellyfish who was very popular. Everywhere he went, lots of people said hello to him. One day, he decided to go for a swim in the ocean. Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a toy that he loved very much. It was a big red cross. One day, Tim saw a girl named Sally with her toy. Her toy was a shiny gold star. Tim felt envious because he thought her toy was better.
Tim wanted to have that shiny gold star. So, he took it from Sally when she was not looking. Sally looked for her toy, but could not find it. She was sad and began to weep. Tim saw her cry, but he did not want to give the shiny gold star back.
In the end, Tim kept the shiny gold star and the big red cross. But he was not happy. He knew he did the wrong thing. Sally was still sad and cried. Tim wanted to say sorry, but he was too scared. And so, they both stayed sad and did not play together again.

One day, a shy cat named Kitty was playing on a carpet. The carpet was big and soft. Kitty loved to play with her toy mouse on the carpet. She would run and jump and have lots of fun.
Kitty's friend, Doggy, came over to play. Doggy was big and loud. Kitty was scared of Doggy. Doggy said, "Kitty, let's play on the carpet!" Kitty hid under the table. She was too shy to play with Doggy.
Doggy tried to get Kitty to come out. He said, "Kitty, I will be nice. I will not be loud. Please come play with me." Kitty thought about it. She wanted to play with Doggy, but she was still scared.

Once upon a time, there was a delicate little bird who lived in a tree. The bird loved to sing and play with its friends. One day, the bird noticed a big cross on the ground. The cross was made of sticks and stones. The bird was curious and wanted to know more about the cross.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to eat prunes. One day, he found an interesting prune tree in his yard. The tree was big and had many prunes.
Tim wanted to get the prunes from the tree. He asked his friend, Sam, "Can you help me get the prunes?" Sam said, "Yes, let's do it!" They tried to reach the prunes, but they were too high. So, Tim and Sam found a big stick to poke the prunes.
As they poked the prunes, some fell on the ground. Tim and Sam were happy. But then, Tim slipped on a prune! He fell and laughed. Sam laughed too. They picked up the prunes and shared them. They had a fun day with the interesting prune tree.

John heard a noise outside his window. He was scared and he knew he should not go out there by himself. He pulled the covers over his head and waited. Then he heard a gentle whisper that said: "Don't be scared, John. It's only me, your shadow". 
John got out of bed and looked outside. He saw a big shadow in the night. It was bigger than him, but he could see it had a friendly face. John wanted to be brave so he opened the window and asked who was there. 
The shadow answered "Don't be scared, I'm here to help you. My name is Shadow". Shadow showed John he could give him courage and help him be brave. John asked Shadow to come inside and the Shadow said he could not because it was too hard. 
John thought for a minute and then began to look around his room. He found some old blankets and a pillow and just like that, Shadow had a bed! John was so happy that he and Shadow could be friends. 
Every night when it was dark, Shadow would come to visit John and help him be brave and face his fears. They would then go to bed and sleep happily until morning.

One day, a creative little girl named Lily wanted to play with water. She put on her boots and went outside. She found a big puddle of water and jumped in it. The water went "splash!" and Lily laughed.
Lily saw her friend, Tom, walking by. She said, "Tom, come play in the water with me!" Tom smiled and said, "Okay, Lily! Let me put on my boots too." Tom zipped up his boots and joined Lily in the puddle.
They both jumped in the water, making more splashes. They laughed and played together. After a while, they got tired and went home. They both had a fun and creative day playing in the water.

One day, a big red car went down the road. The car went fast. The sky was dry, and the sun was hot. The car stopped near a tree. A girl named Lily and a boy named Tim came out of the car. They wanted to play under the tree. 
Lily found a ball and said, "Let's play catch!" Tim shrugged and said, "I don't know how to play." Lily smiled and said, "I will show you." They started to play, but the ball went far away. They both ran to get the ball.
As they got close to the ball, they saw a big hole in the ground. They looked at each other, and Lily said, "What is in the hole?" Tim said, "I don't know." They went closer to see. A big frog jumped out of the hole! They were scared and ran back to the car.
The frog followed them and said, "Wait! I just want to play too!" Lily and Tim stopped running. They looked at the frog and smiled. They played catch with the frog, and they all had fun. The frog was a new friend, and they were not scared anymore.

Ben and Lily were twins who loved waffles. Every morning, their mom made them yummy waffles with butter and honey. They ate them with big smiles and said thank you to mom.
One day, mom had to go to the store and left them with dad. Dad was busy with work and did not know how to make waffles. He gave them cereal and milk instead. Ben and Lily did not like cereal and milk. They wanted waffles.
They saw the waffle maker on the counter and decided to make their own waffles. They poured the batter into the waffle maker and closed it. They waited for a few minutes and then opened it. The waffle was big and golden. They were happy.
They put the waffle on a plate and cut it in half. They each took a half and put butter and honey on it. They were about to eat it when they heard dad coming. They quickly hid the waffle under the table.
Dad came into the kitchen and saw the mess. He saw the waffle maker, the batter, the butter and the honey. He was angry. He asked them what they did. Ben and Lily did not answer. They felt guilty.
Dad looked under the table and saw the waffle. He sighed. He told them that they should not use the waffle maker without his permission. He said that they could have burned themselves or broken the waffle maker. He said that they should have asked him for help or waited for mom to come back.
He also told them that they should not waste food. He said that the waffle was enough for four people and that they should have shared it with him. He said that they should be grateful for what they have and not be greedy.
Ben and Lily realized that they were wrong. They said sorry to dad. They gave him the waffle and asked him to eat it with them. They said that they loved him and that they would not do it again.
Dad smiled and hugged them. He said that he loved them too and that he was proud of them for admitting their mistake. He said that he would teach them how to make waffles safely next time. He said that they could still have cereal and milk if they wanted.
They all sat down and ate the waffle together. It was still yummy. They thanked dad and said that they learned a lesson. They said that they would always listen to dad and mom and be good twins.

One day, a little sheep was in a big field. The sheep saw a distant tree. The tree had yummy leaves. The sheep wanted to eat the leaves.
The sheep walked to the tree. The sheep said, "Tree, please yield your leaves to me." The tree nodded and dropped some leaves. The sheep was happy.
The sheep ate the leaves. The sheep said, "Thank you, tree." The tree smiled. The sheep went back to the field. The sheep and tree were friends.

One day, a gentle cat and a small dog found a big case. They did not know what was inside. The cat and dog wanted to share the case, but they could not open it. They tried and tried, but it was too hard.
Then, a tiny mouse came by and saw the cat and dog with the case. The mouse wanted to help. The cat and dog were not sure if the mouse could do it, but they let the mouse try. The mouse opened the case with a small key it had.
Inside the case, there were many toys and treats. The cat, dog, and mouse were very happy. They all shared the toys and treats from the case. The cat and dog learned that even a tiny mouse can do big things. They all became good friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia loved to draw with her powerful crayons. One day, she drew a beautiful picture of a big, happy sun.
Mia wanted to share her picture with her best friend, Max. So, she decided to mail it to him. She put the picture in an envelope and walked to the mailbox with her mom. Mia said, "Mom, can you help me mail my picture to Max?"
Her mom smiled and said, "Of course, Mia!" They put the envelope in the mailbox and raised the red flag.
A few days later, Max got the picture in the mail. He was so happy to see Mia's beautiful sun. He called Mia and said, "Thank you for the pretty picture, Mia! I love it!" Mia felt happy that she could share her powerful crayon drawing with her friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He liked to design things. One day, he found a weird piece of metal. He wanted to make something special with it.
Tim showed the metal to his friend, Sam. Sam said, "That's a weird metal! What will you design with it?" Tim thought hard and said, "I want to make a big, strong robot!" But Sam wanted to make a fast car with the metal. They both wanted to use the metal, but they could not agree on what to make.
Tim and Sam talked and talked. They thought of a great idea. They would work together to design a robot car! It would be big, strong, and fast. They were both happy and started to work on their new project. And they became even better friends.

Once upon a time, there was a blue bird named Bob. Bob loved to sing and clap his wings. One day, he saw a label on a big tree. The label had a picture of a bird like him.
Bob flew to his friend, a little girl named Sue. "Sue, look at the label on the tree!" Bob said. Sue looked at the label and smiled. "It is a label for a bird house, Bob! Let's build one for you," she said.
Together, Sue and Bob built a beautiful bird house. Other birds saw the house and wanted one too. Sue and Bob helped them build houses. All the birds clapped their wings and sang happily. The moral of the story is that when we help each other, everyone can be happy.

Once upon a time, there was a big truck. The truck was red and shiny. It liked to drive fast and beep its horn loud. The truck had a job to remove dirt from a yard. It was a fun job for the truck.
One day, the truck saw a delicate flower in the yard. The flower was small and pretty. The truck did not want to hurt the flower. So, the truck was very careful when it removed the dirt near the flower.
The truck and the flower became friends. The truck would always be gentle around the flower. The flower was happy, and the truck was proud. They both lived happily in the yard.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a poor boy named Tom. Tom did not have many toys, but he loved to play and have fun. One day, while he was playing outside, he saw a big box. The box had a note on it that said, "For Tom, with fun inside."
Tom was very excited and said, "Wow! Fun for me!" He opened the box and found a big red ball. He played with the ball all day, kicking it, throwing it, and rolling it. Tom was very happy and had lots of fun with his new toy.
The next day, Tom saw another poor child named Sue who did not have any toys to play with. Tom thought about how happy the big red ball made him, and he wanted to share the fun with Sue. He went to Sue and said, "Look, I have a big red ball. Let's play together!" Sue smiled, and they played with the ball all day long. Tom was glad he could share his fun with Sue, and they became good friends. They promised to always share their toys and send fun to other kids in the village who needed it.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Mark. Mark was a pale little boy who liked to play outside. One day, he went to the park with his mom. They saw a big tree with a swing.
Mark's mom said, "Mark, do you want to play on the swing?" Mark was very happy and said, "Yes, please!" He played on the swing for a long time. The sun was shining and the birds were singing.
After a while, Mark's mom mentioned, "Mark, it's time to go home now." Mark felt sad but he knew it was time to leave. They walked home together, holding hands. Mark couldn't wait to come back to the park and play on the swing again.

Once upon a time, there was a kind boy named Tim. Tim liked to spend his days playing with his friends. They loved to play in the park and look for special things.
One day, Tim found a shiny mineral. It was very pretty and he was happy. He showed it to his friends and they all wanted to find one too. So, they spent the day looking for more shiny minerals.
In the end, they all found a shiny mineral to keep. They were so happy and had a fun day. They learned that spending time together and being kind made them feel good. And they knew they would always remember the day they found the shiny minerals.

One day, a restless dog named Spot wanted to play. He ran around the yard, but he was bored. He saw a big cauliflower in the garden. It looked like a fun toy.
Spot went to his friend, a rabbit named Hop. "Can I borrow your ball?" asked Spot. Hop said, "Sure, but be careful. It's my favorite." Spot was happy and took the ball.
Spot played with the ball all day. He forgot about the cauliflower. When it was time to give the ball back, Spot said, "Thank you, Hop." Hop was happy that his friend had fun. From that day on, they played together and had a great time.

Once upon a time, there was a young princess. She lived in a castle and loved to play in the garden with her friends.
One day, when the princess and her friends were playing, they spotted a group of people marching in the street.
The people were carrying signs and shouting about a new law. The princess asked her friends what was happening.
They explained that the new law would give everyone more freedom, and everyone was excited about it. 
The princess and her friends joined the marchers, clapping and cheering with excitement.
The people in the street were so happy. They applauded the princess, who smiled and waved back.
The law was a success, and the people of the land lived happily ever after. The young princess was proud of the new law, and she was applauded by all.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to look up at the sky and see the stars. One day, he saw a small, shiny light in the sky. It was a new planet! Tim was very happy and excited.
Tim wanted to know more about the new planet. He asked his mom to whisper a story about it. Mom said, "This planet is a special place where everything is sour. The trees, the grass, and even the water are all sour." Tim listened carefully and smiled.
One night, Tim had a dream. He went to the sour planet and played with the sour trees and grass. He even drank some sour water. It was a fun adventure for Tim. When he woke up, he told his mom about his dream. They both laughed and whispered about the sour planet all day.

Once upon a time, there was a tall tree in a big park. A little boy named Timmy loved to play near the tree. One day, Timmy saw a big wheel near the tree. He was very happy and wanted to play with it.
Timmy's friend, Sally, came to play with him. She saw the wheel and said, "Let's play with the wheel, Timmy!" Timmy agreed, and they started to play. They rolled the wheel and ran after it, laughing and having fun.
But then, the wheel rolled too fast and went near a big road. Timmy and Sally tried to stop it, but they could not. The wheel rolled onto the road, and a big car hit it. The wheel broke into many pieces. Timmy and Sally were very sad. They should have been more careful with the wheel.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a gifted boy named Tom. He loved to bake cakes. One day, he wanted to make a big cake for his mom's birthday. He knew he needed sugar, but he could not find it. He looked all around the house. Tom was sad.
Tom's dad saw him looking sad. He asked, "Why are you sad, Tom?" Tom said, "I want to make a cake for mom, but I can't find the sugar." Dad smiled and said, "I know where the sugar is, but first, you have to play a game with me." Tom was excited and nodded his head.
They played a fun game of hide and seek. When the game was about to end, dad said, "I hid the sugar in a special place." Tom looked in the kitchen and found the sugar in a big jar. He was so happy! Tom made the cake and gave it to his mom. She loved it! Everyone was happy, and they had a great day.

One day, a little monkey was playing in the jungle. He saw a big, mysterious box. The monkey was curious and wanted to see what was inside.
As the monkey walked closer to the box, he stumbled on a rock. "Ouch!" he said. He got up and opened the box. Inside, he found a big, shiny ball. The monkey was so happy and started to play with the ball.
But then, another monkey came and wanted the ball too. "Give me the ball!" said the other monkey. The first monkey didn't want to share. They both started to fight over the shiny ball. Then, a wise old monkey saw them fighting and said, "Stop! If you both play together, you can have more fun." The two little monkeys listened and started to play with the ball together. They became good friends and had lots of fun in the jungle.

One day, Thomas was walking through the yard. Suddenly, he heard a loud sound and he saw that his little brother was angry. Thomas asked him why he was so angry and his brother started to tear up. When Thomas asked him again why he was so sad, his brother said he was worried about something.
Thomas hugged his brother and said he would help him. He promised his brother he would make it okay. After that, he hugged his brother again and started to cry. 
Suddenly, Thomas's mom came to them. She asked Thomas and his brother what was wrong. Thomas told her that his brother was worried about something and so he hugged him to make him feel better.
His mom hugged them both and said everything was going to be okay. She said all they had to do was talk and share their worries and then it would be alright. She promised them that no matter what, she would always be there to help. 
Thomas smiled and wiped his tears away. His brother hugged him again and they both were relieved. After that, they started to play together happily.

Alice had a great idea. She suggested to her family that they should take a walk in the morning. Every morning Alice wanted to get outside quickly, so her family had to hurry fast. She was so excited, it was going to be the best morning ever!
So early the next morning, Alice was ready and waiting. Suddenly, she heard the jingle of a blue van pulling up. To her surprise and delight, it was an ice cream truck! She couldn't believe her eyes. She ran to her family, shouting "Ice cream! Ice cream!" Everyone was so excited.
Alice had suggested the morning walk, but she had also suggested stopping for ice cream too! Even better than she had imagined, it was a morning filled with wonderful surprises and delicious treats!

One day, a boy named Tim went to the store with his mom. They bought a box of cereal. Tim felt lucky because it was his favorite kind. He could not wait to eat it.
When they got home, Tim helped his mom unpack the bags. He found the cereal box and showed it to his mom with a big smile. She smiled too and said, "You are a good helper, Tim!"
The next morning, Tim ate his lucky cereal for breakfast. It made him very happy. He told his mom, "I am so lucky to have this cereal and you!" His mom hugged him and they had a great day.

Lily was a smart girl who liked to help her mom at the hospital. She admired the doctors and nurses who made people feel better. Sometimes, she got to watch them do an operation, where they opened up someone's body and fixed what was wrong.
One day, she saw a doctor do an operation on a boy who had a bad heart. The doctor used a special machine that made the boy's heart stop and start again. Lily was amazed by how the doctor knew what to do.
"Wow, you are so brave and smart, doctor!" Lily said to him after the operation. "How did you learn to do that?"
The doctor smiled and thanked Lily for her kind words. He told her that he studied a lot of books and practiced a lot of times. He said that he loved his job because he could help people like the boy.
Lily nodded and said, "I want to be like you when I grow up. I want to help people too."
The doctor hugged Lily and said, "I'm sure you will, Lily. You have a good heart and a curious mind. Just keep learning and trying new things. And always admire those who do good in the world."

Lila and Tom are playing on the beach. They like to build sand castles and dig holes. They have a bucket and a shovel and some shells. They are having fun.
"Look, Tom, I made a big castle!" Lila says. She puts a shell on top of the tower. "It is the king's house."
"Wow, Lila, your castle is very nice!" Tom says. He makes a moat around his castle. "My castle has water. It is a boat."
They play some more. Then they hear a sound. It is the tide. The water is coming closer and closer. It is very wide and fast.
"Oh no, Tom, the water is coming!" Lila says. She grabs her bucket and shovel. "We have to go. It will break our castles."
"Wait, Lila, I want to see!" Tom says. He runs to the water. He wants to touch it. He thinks it is fun.
"Tom, come back!" Lila says. She is scared. The water is too big and strong. "It will hurt you. It will make you wet."
But Tom does not listen. He runs to the water. He feels it on his feet. It is cold and salty. He laughs. He likes it.
Then the water becomes higher and higher. It reaches his knees. It pushes him. He falls. He cries. He is wet and cold and scared.
"Help, Lila, help!" Tom says. He tries to get up. He wants to go back.
Lila sees Tom. She is worried. She runs to him. She helps him up. She hugs him. She is wet too.
"Tom, you are silly!" Lila says. She is angry and sad. "Why did you do that? The water is not a toy. It is dangerous."
"I'm sorry, Lila, I'm sorry!" Tom says. He is sorry and sad. "I did not know. I wanted to see. I thought it was fun."
They look at their castles. They are gone. The water broke them. They are sad.
"Come on, Tom, let's go," Lila says. She takes his hand. "We can make new castles another day. But we have to be careful. We have to watch the tide."
They walk to their mom. She is sitting on a towel. She sees them. She is surprised.
"What happened, Lila and Tom?" she says. She sees they are wet and dirty. "Did you have fun?"
They tell her what happened. She listens. She is glad they are safe. She is proud of Lila. She is not mad at Tom.
"I'm sorry, mom, I'm sorry!" Tom says. He is still sorry.
"It's okay, Tom, it's okay," mom says. She smiles. She hugs them. "You learned something today. The tide can be fun, but it can also be dangerous. You have to be careful. You have to listen to Lila. She is smart."
They nod. They agree. They love mom. They love Lila. They love the beach. But they respect the tide.

Once upon a time, there were two friends - Kiki and Tena. They would go to the park and play together each day.
One day, when they were walking in the park, Kiki noticed Tena had something special in her pocket. Kiki asked Tena what it was and Tena said it was a rich lip. She had found it in the park. 
Kiki was jealous and wanted the lip instead. She asked Tena to give it to her and Tena said no. Kiki asked again, but Tena still said no. They began to quarrel. 
Kiki was mad but Tena didn't want to give her the lip. She knew that if she gave it to Kiki, there would be no payoff.
Kiki was upset and began to walk away. As she was walking, she saw something in the grass. She bent down and found another rich lip. She laughed and called to Tena to tell her what she'd found. 
Kiki and Tena were friends again and shared the two rich lips. They laughed together, knowing that together there would always be a payoff.

Lila and Ben were playing in the park. They liked to run and slide and swing. They saw a big hill with a lot of rocks. They wanted to climb it and see what was on the other side.
"Let's go, Lila!" Ben said. "Maybe we can find something cool!"
"OK, Ben!" Lila said. "But be careful. The rocks look sharp."
They ran to the hill and started to climb. They used their hands and feet to find good places to hold on. They went higher and higher. They could see the park and the trees and the sky. They felt happy and brave.
But then, Ben slipped. He lost his grip and fell. He hit a sharp rock on the way down. He cried out in pain. Lila saw him and was scared. She tried to go down to help him, but she was too high. She could not find a safe way.
"Ben, Ben, are you OK?" Lila shouted.
"No, Lila, it hurts!" Ben shouted back. "I'm bleeding! Help me, Lila!"
Lila did not know what to do. She looked around for someone to help them, but no one was there. They were too far from the park. They were alone on the hill. Lila felt sad and sorry. She wished they had not climbed the hill. She wished they had stayed in the park. She wished they had listened to their mom, who had told them not to go too far. But it was too late. They had made a bad choice. And now they were in trouble.

Once upon a time, there was a helpful fish named Fin. Fin liked to talk to his friends in the sea. One day, he saw a big fish who was sad.
The big fish said, "I need oxygen to breathe, but I can't find any." Fin wanted to help, so he talked to his friends. They all tried to find oxygen for the big fish.
Fin and his friends found a lot of oxygen and gave it to the big fish. The big fish was very happy. They all became friends and played together in the sea. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a fat cat named Tom. Tom loved to eat and play all day. One sunny day, Tom's friend, a little girl named Sue, had a great idea. Sue wanted to have a picnic with Tom in the park. Tom was very excited and wagged his tail.
Sue and Tom went to the park with a big basket. They found a nice spot under a big tree. Sue took out yummy food from the basket. They had sandwiches, apples, and cookies. Tom's favorite was the cookies. They ate and laughed together.
After the picnic, Sue had a surprise for Tom. She gave him a gift. Tom was happy to receive the gift. Inside the gift was a new toy for Tom to play with. They played with the toy all day long. Tom and Sue had the best day ever.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to nap under a big tree. One day, she found a small silver box under the tree. Lily was very curious about the box but she was a little scared too.
Lily took a deep breath and opened the silver box. Inside, she found a tiny kitten. The kitten was scared just like Lily. But when the kitten saw Lily, it started to purr and rub against her.
Lily and the kitten became best friends. They played and napped under the big tree together. One day, while they were napping, the kitten turned into a big, friendly bear! Lily was surprised, but she loved her new big friend even more. They had many fun adventures together and were never scared again.

The cost of the tickets was too high for many fans in South America , so the band broadcast the 11 February concert in Chile live on television . Knowing that many people in the country would be watching , they played " Mothers of the Disappeared " in place of " Wake Up Dead Man " . The stadium in which the concert was held had been used as a prison camp by Pinochet 's regime following the coup d 'état . Again it was performed solely by Bono and the Edge against footage of the Madres , and they invited the women to join them on stage a second time . The Madres held up photographs of their children and spoke about them briefly during the performance , an act which received a mixed reception from the audience . Bono made a plea to Pinochet , asking him to " tell these women where are the bones of their children . "

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy liked to play with her fragile toy tea cups. One day, she wanted to have a tea party with her friends. She took out her toy tea cups and put them on the table.
Amy wanted to make sure that everything was ready for her friends, so she took her measure and checked the size of the table. While she was doing this, her cat jumped on the table and knocked over the fragile tea cups. Amy frowned because her tea cups were broken.
Just then, her mommy came into the room and saw the broken tea cups. She gave Amy a big hug and said, "Don't worry, I have a surprise for you." Mommy brought out new, unbreakable tea cups for Amy and her friends. Amy's frown turned into a big smile, and she had the best tea party ever.

One day, a boy named Tim went to play baseball with his friends. The sun was shining, but the wind was a bit harsh. They played on the grass and laughed a lot.
Suddenly, the sky turned dark, and it started to rain. Tim and his friends ran to a big tree to stay dry. They looked at the rain and felt sad because they could not play baseball anymore.
Tim said to his friends, "Let's sing a song to make the rain go away." They sang and clapped their hands. Soon, the rain stopped, and the sun came out again. Tim and his friends went back to playing baseball, happy that their song worked.

One day, a girl named Mia went for a walk. She saw an open door. She went in and found a seat. There was a big box. Mia heard a sound from the box.
"Help me, please," said a voice. Mia opened the box. Inside was a bird with a broken arrow. The bird was sad. Mia knew what to do.
Mia took the bird home. She took the arrow out. The bird felt better. Mia said, "You can stay with me." The bird was happy. They were friends. And Mia knew that the open door was a sign of a new friend.

One day, a sleepy cat named Tom went for a tour in the park. He saw many things like trees, flowers, and other animals. Tom liked the park very much.
Tom met a bird named Sue. Sue said, "Hi Tom! Do you want to play with me?" Tom was sleepy but decided to play with Sue. They played hide and seek, and Tom felt happy.
After playing, Tom and Sue decided to rest under a big tree. They talked about their fun day in the park. Soon, Tom felt very sleepy. He said, "Sue, I am sleepy. I want to go home now." Sue said, "Okay Tom, see you again soon!" Tom went home and had a good sleep.

One day, a big ostrich went for a slow walk. He saw a little boy sitting under a tree. The boy looked sad. The ostrich walked up to him and said, "Why are you sad?"
The little boy looked up and said, "I lost my ball. Can you help me find it?" The ostrich nodded his head and said, "Yes, I will help you."
They walked together, looking for the ball. The boy saw the ball near some flowers. He was happy and said, "Thank you, ostrich!" The ostrich nodded and smiled. They played with the ball and had a fun day.

One day, a little girl named Sally went to the store with her mom. They needed to buy some things for their house, like food and toys. Sally was very excited because her mom said she could pick a toy for herself. She looked and looked, and finally found a toy she loved. It was a pretty doll with a big, red dress.

Originally scheduled to be played on November 20 , in July 2010 this game was moved to Thursday , November 18 to give the Crimson Tide extra time to prepare for its game against Auburn . In the first ever meeting against the Georgia State Panthers , the Crimson Tide was victorious 63 – 7 . Alabama scored first on an eight-yard Greg McElroy pass to Julio Jones . After a Mark Barron interception ended the first Georgia State drive , Alabama responded with a 71-yard drive capped by a one-yard Mark Ingram touchdown run to take a 14 – 0 lead .

The little girl was excited. She had been waiting all day for the big surprise her mom had promised. Finally, the doorbell rang. She jumped off the couch and ran to the door.
When she opened the door, there stood her mom with a big smile on her face. "Look what I brought for you," she said, lifting a beautiful pink bike into view.
The little girl squealed with joy and hugged her mom. She couldn't wait to ride the bike.
"First let's show you how it works," her mom said, helping her sit on the bike. She showed her how to pedal and turn the handlebars.
The little girl wobbled at first, but soon found her way. She rode up and down the driveway, feeling as happy as could be.
But, in her excitement, the little girl didn't realize her mom hadn't shown her how to break. As she rode faster and faster, she realized too late that she couldn't stop.
The little girl screamed as she flew off the bike, crashing into a nearby tree. Her mom ran out to help, and she was rushed to the hospital.
The doctor said it was a bad accident, ending the little girl's excitement for the day.

Once upon a time, there was a boy who felt very scared. He looked out of the window and saw his cat in his yard. He became very worried and shouted for help. 
His mom heard him. She rushed to the door and asked what was wrong. The boy said, âMy cat is stuck in the yard!â 
His mom smiled and said, âDonât worry. I will rescue your cat.â She ran out to the yard and was able to help the cat.
