Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max wanted to go on a journey. He asked his friend, a big cat named Tom, to go with him.
Max said, "Tom, let's go on a journey! But we must behave, okay?" Tom agreed, "Yes, Max! We will behave and have fun!"
They walked and walked, and soon they found a fake bone. Max looked at it and said, "This bone is fake, but that's okay. We can still play with it!" Tom and Max played with the fake bone and had a great time.
After playing, they continued their journey. They saw many things like trees, flowers, and birds. They behaved very well and had a lot of fun together.
At the end of the day, Max and Tom went back home. They were happy and tired from their journey. They promised to go on another journey soon, and always behave.

One day, a cat and a dog were playing in a big yard. The cat saw a shiny thing high up in a tree. It was a laser! The cat wanted to play with the laser, but the dog was scared.
The dog said, "Cat, don't go up there! I need to warn you, it might be bad!" But the cat did not listen. The cat climbed the tree to get the laser. When the cat touched the laser, something unexpected happened.
The laser turned the cat into a big, pretty bird! The dog was very surprised. The bird flew down and said, "Thank you, dog, for trying to warn me. But now I can fly high in the sky!" The dog and the bird stayed friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a yellow duck. The duck lived in a small pond with his friends. They liked to play and swim all day.
One day, the duck found a bottle of lotion. He didn't know what it was, but he thought it was special. He showed it to his friends, and they all wanted to try it.
The duck and his friends decided to decorate their pond with the lotion. They put it on the rocks and the plants. It made everything look shiny and pretty. They were all very happy with their beautiful pond.

Because Miami received the ball to begin the game , Virginia Tech received the ball to begin the second half . After Miami 's kickoff and a touchback , Tech began the first possession of the second half at its 20-yard line . The Hokies picked up a quick first down off a rush each by Lawrence , Dovel , and Casey . Lawrence picked up another with two rushes that resulted in 13 yards and drove the Hokies to their 44-yard line . There , Casey completed his longest pass of the game — a 42-yard throw to tight end Rob Purdham — that gave Tech a first down at the Miami 14-yard line . Tech continued to drive , picking up short yardage with multiple rushes . The Hokies suffered a near-disaster when Lawrence fumbled the ball , but Tech retained possession when the ball rolled out of bounds at the one-yard line . Two plays after the fumble , Lawrence vaulted over the goal line for Tech 's first and only touchdown of the game . Following the extra point , Tech cut Miami 's lead to 14 – 10 with 8 : 52 remaining in the quarter .

Once upon a time, in a small cheerful town, there lived a little girl named Lily. Lily had a big dog named Max. They loved to play together outside.
One day, Lily and Max were playing near a house. They saw smoke coming from the house. Lily said, "Oh no, Max! We need to tell someone!" So, they ran to find Lily's mom.
Lily's mom saw the smoke too. She told Lily to stay back and she called for help. While they waited, Lily's mom asked Lily to kneel down with Max to stay safe. Lily held Max close and said, "Don't worry, Max. Help is coming."
Soon, the big red truck came with the people who put out fires. They put water on the house and the smoke went away. Everyone was safe and happy.
After the fire was gone, the people in the town had a big party. They were all cheerful and thankful that Lily and Max had found the smoke. Lily and Max got lots of hugs and treats for being so brave.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sophie. Sophie had a lot of friends who always made her laugh. Every day, the friends would joke and laugh together.
One day, they all decided to go to the park. When they got there, they saw a garden of beautiful roses. They all ran up to it and admired the lovely colours. Sophie touched one of the roses, but she pricked her finger on a thorn. 
Ouch! Sophie didn't understand why the rose was so sharp - she had thought it would be soft. Her friends were sad to see her hurt. They all looked at her and said, "Sophie, next time you touch something, be sure to be lively!
Sophie learned her lesson that day. From then on, she was always lively when touching something new. Her friends were glad to see that she was being careful. 
Moral of the story: Be lively when you touch something too, so that you don't get hurt!

" The Jackson Five " would release a second and final single through Steeltown Records — " We Don 't Have To Be Over 21 ( to Fall in Love ) " . The two singles were to be supported by an eleven track studio album but it was never released . On July 26 , 1968 , the group signed a contract with Motown Records . However , as the group 's Steeltown contract had not yet expired , the new contract could not be fully executed until March 11 , 1969 . Motown Records tried to get the group out of their Steeltown contract , and ultimately succeeded with a financial settlement .

Once upon a time, there was a sweet little cat named Kitty. Kitty was very loved by her family. She liked to play with her ball and eat tasty food. Kitty was a happy cat.
One day, Kitty managed to open the door of her house. She went outside to explore. The sun was shining, and the birds were singing. Kitty was very excited to see the big world.
But Kitty got lost. She walked and walked, but she could not find her way home. Kitty was very sad and scared. She missed her family and their love. In the end, Kitty could not find her way back home, and she stayed lost forever.

Once upon a time, there was a little cat named Fluffy. Fluffy had soft fur and liked to play with a ball. One day, Fluffy went outside to play, but it was getting dark. Fluffy did not like the dark, but she wanted to find her ball.
Fluffy looked and looked for her ball. She started to struggle because it was so dark. She tried to be brave and kept looking. Then, she found a big tree. Fluffy thought her ball might be near the tree.
As Fluffy got closer to the tree, she felt something with her paw. She gave it a rub, and it was her ball! Fluffy was so happy she found her ball, even in the dark. She picked up her ball and ran back home, ready to play some more.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom liked to play with his toy car. One day, he saw a weak bird on the ground. The bird could not fly because it was stuck in a cable. Tom wanted to help the bird.
Tom found a seat near the bird and thought about what to do. He was very careful not to scare the bird. He slowly moved the cable away from the bird. The bird was free! The bird tried to fly, but it was still weak. Tom gave the bird some food and water to make it strong again.
After a while, the bird was strong enough to fly. The bird thanked Tom and flew away. Tom was happy that he could help the bird. He learned that it is good to be kind and help others when they are in trouble.

Once upon a time there was a naughty boy called Sam. He loved to skip along the path whenever he went outside. One day he was skipping along and he came to the sea. He had never seen the sea before and he thought it was so big and wide.
He wanted to play in the sand but he knew that his parents wouldn't let him so he started to skip back home. Then he suddenly remembered that it was a holiday. He got so excited and started to skip faster and faster down the path.
He ran back home and asked his parents if he could go to the beach to play in the sand. They said yes and he ran all the way to the beach. He laughed happily as he skipped through the sand. He had so much fun building sandcastles and running in the waves. 
He skipped all the way back home that evening with a big smile on his face. He was so happy that he had such a fun holiday!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom liked to play with his toys. One day, he got a new toy. It was a fake bird. He wanted to give the bird a name.
Tom asked his mom, "What should I name my bird?" His mom said, "You can pick any name you like, Tom." So Tom thought and thought. He picked the name "Sky" for his bird.
The next day, Tom and Sky went outside to play. Suddenly, something unexpected happened. Sky started to move like a real bird! Tom was so surprised. "Wow, Sky, I didn't know you could fly!" Tom and Sky played together all day, and they were very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a big, scary cat. The cat liked to dance. One day, the cat decided to decorate his home. He wanted to make it look nice for a dance party.
The cat invited all his friends. They were excited. One friend, a small mouse, said, "I can't wait for the dance party!" The cat smiled and said, "It will be fun!"
At the party, everyone danced and had fun. But then, something unexpected happened. The scary cat was not scary anymore! He was happy and nice. All his friends were surprised. They all danced and laughed together, and they had the best time ever.

Tim and Jen are twins. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big hill. They want to climb it.
"Let's go, Jen!" Tim says. "We can be like soldiers and march to the top!"
"OK, Tim!" Jen says. "But be careful. The hill is very steep and rocky."
They start to march up the hill. They hold hands and sing a song. They are happy and ready for adventure.
But the hill is harder than they think. They get tired and thirsty. The rocks are sharp and slippery. They fall and hurt their knees and elbows.
"Tim, I don't like this hill," Jen says. "Let's go back."
"No, Jen, we can do it!" Tim says. "We are almost there. Look, I see a flag!"
Tim sees a red flag on a stick. He thinks it is a prize. He lets go of Jen's hand and runs to get it.
But the flag is not a prize. It is a warning. The flag means danger. The flag means there is a hole.
Tim does not see the hole. He steps on it and falls in. He screams and cries. Jen hears him and crawls to the edge. She sees Tim in the dark hole. She is scared and sad.
"Tim, Tim, are you OK?" Jen shouts.
But Tim does not answer. He is hurt and alone. Jen does not know what to do. She calls for help, but no one comes. She wishes they never climbed the hill. She wishes they stayed in the park. She wishes they listened to their mom.

Once upon a time, there was a leopard who was very dirty. He tried to find a place to bathe for days and days, but he could not find anything.
He got so desperate that he started asking other animals if he could use their bath. But the animals said no, and the leopard was still stuck being very dirty.
One morning, he smelled something very delicious. The smell was coming from a nearby pond. He ran as fast as he could, and when he got there, he saw that it was full of delicious bubbles.
The leopard jumped right in and rolled around in the bubbly water. It felt so good to be clean again. After he was done, he noticed that the bubbles had made his coat very soft and shiny.
The leopard smiled and thanked the pond for giving him the most delicious bath ever. And the leopard lived happily ever after.

Not Quite Hollywood , which premiered at the 2008 Melbourne International Film Festival , did not perform well at the box office upon its Australia-wide release , but garnered universally positive reviews from critics and a nomination for " Best Documentary " at the 2008 Australian Film Institute Awards .

Once upon a time, in a cheerful little house, there lived a boy named Tim. Tim loved to jump and play all day long. One day, Tim found a camera in his toy box. He was very happy.
Tim went to his friend, Sam, and said, "Look! I found a camera! Let's take pictures while we jump and play." Sam smiled and said, "Yes! That sounds like fun!"
So, Tim and Sam spent the whole day jumping and taking pictures with the camera. They laughed and played together. At the end of the day, they looked at the pictures they took and smiled. They had so much fun and made many happy memories.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lucy. All she wanted was to find a new boot she had lost. 
She was walking around the park when she noticed a dead bird on the ground.
Lucy looked around to see where it had come from, and noticed a boot lying in the bushes. She went over to it and found that it was the same boot she had lost!
Lucy said with delight: âI found it! I found my lost boot!â
She put her boot back on and went home. From then on, she was more careful not to lose her boot again.

One day, a big lion was walking slow in the forest. He was very hungry and wanted a snack. He looked around and saw a small rabbit.
"Hello, rabbit," said the lion with a big roar. "I am hungry and you look like a good snack."
The rabbit was scared. "Please, Mr. Lion, don't eat me! I can show you where to find a better snack."
The lion thought for a moment and said, "Okay, show me."
The rabbit led the lion to a big tree with lots of yummy fruit. The lion ate the fruit and was very happy. He thanked the rabbit and they became good friends. From that day on, the lion never roared at the rabbit again.

One day, a healthy dog named Spot went into a warm house. In the house, there was a fireplace. Spot liked to sit by the fireplace and feel the heat.
Spot saw a girl named Jane. Jane was playing with a ball. Spot wanted to play too. Jane said, "Spot, come play with me!" Spot was happy and ran to Jane.
Jane threw the ball and Spot ran to get it. They played for a long time. Then, they got tired. Jane and Spot went near the fireplace. Jane knelt down next to Spot. They both felt warm and cozy by the fire. They loved playing together.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Anna. She loved baking. Every day, Anna wanted to bake something new. Today, Anna wanted to bake something special. She searched through her kitchen cupboards and found some broccoli!
Anna took out the broccoli and put it on the counter. She found some butter, a bowl and a spoon. Anna tried to stir the ingredients together, but it was hard. She was a little bit hurt. 
But Anna didn't give up. She kept stirring until everything was mixed together. Then, she put it on a baking sheet and put it in the oven. Anna could smell the broccoli baking, and it smelled yummy! 
After a few minutes, Anna opened the oven door and saw a tray of golden brown broccoli. She took it out and carefully put it on the counter. Anna was so happy with how her special bake had turned out. She couldn't wait to eat it!

Once upon a time, in a big, green forest, there was a witch. The witch had a big, black hat and a big, black cat. She liked to play with her cat all day.
One day, the witch met a little girl. The girl was lost and scared. The witch said, "Don't be scared. I will help you go home." The girl looked at the big, black hat and the big, black cat. She was still scared.
The witch insisted, "Please, trust me. I am nice." The girl said, "Okay, I trust you." The witch and the big, black cat helped the girl find her way home. They all became good friends and played together every day.

Once there was a little girl called Lucy. She was very happy but sometimes she had worries. Today was one of those days. 
Lucy had a toy that was broken. She was so sad because she couldn't play with it anymore. She looked all around but couldn't find anything to fix it. 
That's when her dad stepped in. He showed her a special tool box and began to fix her toy. He was very flexible and was able to make the toy work again. 
Lucy was so happy! She jumped up and down with joy. Then she hugged her dad and thanked him for fixing her toy. Her worries were now gone.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a boy named Ben. He had a toy bow and arrow. Ben loved to play with his arrow. He felt very comfortable with it. He would run around and pretend to be a hero.
One day, Ben saw a big tree. He believed he could hit the tree with his arrow. He took a deep breath and let the arrow fly. It hit the tree and made a loud sound. Ben was very proud of himself. 
Ben's friends saw what he did and they all wanted to try. They all took turns and tried to hit the tree with their arrows. Some missed, but some hit the tree too. They all cheered and clapped for each other. They learned that when they believe in themselves, they can do great things. And that was the moral of the story: always believe in yourself.

Lily and Tom were going to church with Mom and Dad. They liked church because they could sing and pray and see their friends. They also liked to pick flowers from the garden outside the church. They always asked Mom and Dad if they could pick some flowers to take home.
One day, as they were walking to church, they saw a big dog on the street. The dog was barking and running towards them. Lily and Tom were scared and held Mom and Dad's hands. Mom and Dad told them not to worry, they would keep them safe.
"Shoo, shoo, go away!" Mom said to the dog. "You are not nice, you are scaring the children!"
The dog stopped and looked at Mom. Then it wagged its tail and licked Mom's hand. Mom smiled and petted the dog. She said the dog was just lonely and wanted to play.
"Can we play with the dog, Mom?" Lily asked.
"Only if the dog's owner says it's okay," Mom said. "We don't know if the dog is friendly or not."
They looked around and saw a man coming towards them. He was holding a leash and a collar. He said he was sorry, he had lost his dog and was looking for him. He thanked Mom and Dad for stopping the dog and said his name was Max.
"Can we play with Max, please?" Tom asked the man.
"Sure, you can play with Max for a little while," the man said. "He is very gentle and loves children. But don't pick his fur, he doesn't like that."
Lily and Tom nodded and played with Max. They threw a ball and Max fetched it. They rubbed his belly and Max wagged his tail. They had fun with Max and forgot they were scared.
"Okay, kids, it's time to go to church," Dad said. "We don't want to be late."
"Bye, Max, we'll see you again," Lily and Tom said. They gave Max a hug and a kiss.
"Bye, kids, thank you for playing with Max," the man said. He put the leash and the collar on Max and waved goodbye.
Lily and Tom went to church with Mom and Dad. They sang and prayed and saw their friends. They also picked some flowers from the garden outside the church. They gave some to Mom and Dad and some to Max's owner. They were happy and safe.

Along with England , Wales and Scotland , Northern Ireland forms one of the three separate legal jurisdictions of the UK , all of which share the Supreme Court of the United Kingdom as their court of final appeal .

Once upon a time, there was a hairy dog named Max. Max loved to play with his ball. One day, Max saw a bottle of perfume on the table. He thought it was his ball.
Max said, "I want to play with my ball!" He jumped up and tried to grab the perfume. But it was too high for him. Max asked his friend, a little bird, to help him.
The little bird said, "Okay, Max! I will help you!" The bird flew up and grabbed the perfume with its beak. It dropped the perfume on the ground, and Max sniffed it. He realized it was not his ball after all.
Max and the little bird laughed. They went outside and played with Max's real ball. They had a fun day together.

A native of Texas , Applewhite attended several universities and , as a young man , served in the United States Army . After finishing school at Austin College , he taught music at the University of Alabama . He later returned to Texas , where he led choruses and served as the chair of the music department at the University of St. Thomas in Houston . He left the school in 1970 , citing emotional turmoil . His father 's death a year later brought on severe depression . In 1972 , he developed a close friendship with Bonnie Nettles , a nurse ; together , they discussed mysticism at length and concluded that they were called as divine messengers . They operated a bookstore and teaching center for a short while , and then began to travel around the U.S. in 1973 to spread their views . They only gained one convert . In 1975 , Applewhite was arrested for failing to return a rental car and was jailed for six months . In jail , he further developed his theology .

Jane was a lucky girl, with bright light shining in her eyes. One day, she saw a box with something that she wanted to own.
"What is in the box, Mommy?" she asked.
"That, my darling," replied Mommy, "is a surprise. You'll have to wait until tomorrow to open it."
The next day, Jane couldn't wait to open the box. A cloud of light shined inside, and when she pulled something out, it was a brand new bicycle!
"I own a bicycle now!" Jane exclaimed with joy. She knew it was her lucky day and she would ride that bicycle for many days to come.

Once upon a time there was a very adorable gorilla named Henry. He lived in the jungle with his family. Every day, he and his family went to the river to have a drink and play. 
One day, when Henry and his family were walking to the river, Henry stopped and said, "Wait, what's that?"
He saw a bright red bird perched on a branch. As he looked at it he thought, "That is so pretty."
His family looked at Henry curiously and said, "Henry, why do you want to remain here and look at the bird?" 
Henry smiled and said, "Because it's so adorable. I want to stay here to admire it."
His family smiled and they all remained in the spot admiring the bird together. They had a wonderful time looking at the beautiful bird. 
After a while, Henry said goodbye to the bird and he and his family went on their way to the river. 
The end.

Lila was a curious girl who liked to explore. One day, she found a big shield in the attic. It was shiny and had a picture of a lion on it. Lila wondered what it was for.
She took the shield and went outside. She saw some boys playing with sticks and stones. They pretended to be knights and dragons. Lila wanted to join them, but they said she was too small and had no sword.
Lila felt sad, but then she had an idea. She held the shield in front of her and said, "I have a shield! It is stronger than a sword. I can be a knight too!"
The boys laughed and threw sticks and stones at her. But Lila did not run away. She stayed behind the shield and blocked them. The shield made a loud noise when it was hit. Lila felt brave and proud.
The boys stopped throwing and looked at her. They saw that she was not afraid. They saw that the shield was cool. They said, "Wow, you have a nice shield. Can we see it?"
Lila smiled and said, "Yes, you can see it. But you have to be nice and share. And you have to let me play with you."
The boys agreed and said, "OK, you can play with us. You can be a knight too. But what is your name?"
Lila said, "My name is Lila. And this is my shield. It is my friend."

One day, a little girl named Sue went to a big hotel with her mom and dad. The hotel was very tall and had many rooms. In the hotel, there was a black cat. The cat liked to play and jump around.
Sue saw the cat and wanted to play with it. The cat jumped up and tried to hang on a tree branch. Sue laughed and said, "Silly cat, you can't hang on the tree!" The cat looked at her and meowed.
Sue's mom and dad came over and saw the cat too. They all played with the cat and had a fun time at the hotel. The cat was happy to have new friends. They all said goodbye to the cat when it was time to go home.

One day, a little frog named Tim wanted to join the big march. All the animals were going to walk together in a long line. Tim was very excited. He wanted to hop, hop, hop all the way.
As the march started, Tim hopped happily. But soon, he hopped on the tail of a big dog named Max. Max yelled, "Ouch! Who did that?" Tim felt guilty. He knew he should say sorry, but he was scared. He hid behind a small bush.
Max looked around and saw Tim hiding. He walked over and said, "Did you hop on my tail?" Tim nodded his head and said, "I am sorry, Max. I did not mean to. I just wanted to hop in the march." Max smiled and said, "It's okay, Tim. Just be careful next time."
Tim and Max became friends. They walked together in the march. Tim hopped carefully and Max wagged his tail. They had a lot of fun and were happy to be part of the big march.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Hannah. She was curious and liked to explore. One day, she was walking in the woods, looking for something interesting.
Suddenly, she saw a yellow branch. It looked interesting, so she decided to open it. When she opened the branch, she found a nest of baby birds inside. She was so excited. 
The baby birds were yellow and so fluffy. Hannah wanted to stay and play with them, but she knew she had to leave them alone. Gently, she put the branch back, and carried on walking.
The End

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a thin tree. This tree was very sad because it did not have many leaves. One day, a kind man saw the tree and wanted to help it.
The man had an idea. He took a big palm leaf from another tree and put it on the thin tree. The thin tree now had a big leaf to display. The tree was very happy and felt proud.
Soon, other trees saw the thin tree with the big palm leaf. They wanted to be kind too. So, they shared their leaves with other trees that did not have many leaves. In the end, all the trees in the town were happy and had many leaves to display. The moral of the story is to be kind and share with others.

Once upon a time, there was a little muffin. The muffin lived in a big box with other muffins. They all liked to play and have fun. The muffin wanted to become a fierce and strong muffin, so it could protect its friends.
One day, a hungry cat came to the box. The cat wanted to eat the muffins. The muffins were very scared. The little muffin knew it was time to become fierce and strong. It puffed up its top and said, "Go away, cat! You can't eat us!"
The cat looked at the little muffin and said, "You're just a small muffin. I will eat you all!" But the little muffin did not give up. It jumped up and down, shouting, "No, you won't! I am fierce and strong!"
The cat was surprised by the brave little muffin. It thought that maybe the muffin was telling the truth. The cat decided to leave the muffins alone and find something else to eat. The other muffins cheered and thanked the little muffin for being so fierce and strong.
From that day on, the little muffin was known as the fierce and strong muffin. It always made sure to protect its friends and keep them safe. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a little boy named Tim and his friend Sue went to the beach to play. They saw a lot of sand and thought it was a good place to build a big sandcastle. They started to build the castle with their hands and small shovels. They were very happy.
Tim said, "Sue, let's add more sand to make the castle taller!" Sue agreed and they both added more sand to their castle. They worked together and made the castle very big and strong.
As they finished their sandcastle, a nice man walked by and said, "Wow, that's a very good sandcastle you made!" Tim and Sue smiled and thanked the man. They were very proud of their work and had a fun day at the beach.

One day, a girl named Lily wanted to travel. She put on her bright red hat and went outside. She walked and walked, looking at the pretty flowers and big trees.
Lily saw a wallet on the ground. She picked it up and looked inside. There was a picture of a happy family. She wanted to give the wallet back to them.
Lily asked her friends, the birds, to help her find the family. They all flew high and saw the family in a park. Lily went to the park and gave the wallet back. The family was so happy and thanked Lily. They all played together in the park and had a fun day.

One day, a boy named Tim and his dog, Max, wanted to play a game. They decided to play hide and seek. Tim would hide and Max would try to find him. Tim thought it would be a hard game for Max, but Max was a smart dog.
Tim said to Max, "Max, you wait here and count to ten. I will go hide." Max barked and started to count. Tim ran and hid behind a big tree. Max finished counting and started to look for Tim.
Max looked near the house, under the car, and behind the bushes. He could not find Tim. Max barked and said, "Tim, this game is hard!" Suddenly, Max saw Tim's foot behind the big tree. Max ran to the tree and found Tim. Tim laughed and said, "Good job, Max! You found me!" They both had fun playing the game and decided to play again.

Once upon a time, there was a loyal dog named Spot. Spot lived in a big house with lots of furniture. He loved to play with his toys, jump on the beds, and twist his body around in circles.
One sunny day, Spot was playing in the house. He ran and jumped on the furniture, having lots of fun. But then, something unexpected happened. Spot twisted his body around and bumped into a big chair. The chair fell over and broke.
Spot was sad and scared. He didn't want his family to be mad at him. But when his family came home, they were not mad. They saw the broken chair and hugged Spot. They knew he was a loyal dog and didn't mean to break the furniture. They all laughed and played together, and Spot learned to be more careful when twisting around the house.

Once upon a time, there was a nice little girl named Mia. Mia loved to clap her hands and dance. One day, she went to the park to play with her friends.
At the park, Mia saw a group of kids, they made a network of friends. They were all playing together and having fun. Mia walked up to them and asked, "Can I play with you?" The kids said, "Yes, of course! Let's all play together!"
Mia and her new friends played games, sang songs, and clapped their hands. They all had a great time. Mia was happy she made new friends in the network. From that day on, the park became a nicer place for everyone.

Once upon a time there was a nosy cat named Luxury. She was always prying into things that weren't hers. One day, while she was snooping around, she found a box of matches. She was fascinated by them and kept pushing them around with her paw. After a while, she accidentally knocked the whole box down and all the matches scattered. Luxury was a bit scared and hid away. But then she heard a little voice say, "Don't be scared! I'm here to help you put the matches back in the box." Luxury was surprised and saw a little girl and her mom. The little girl had a big smile on her face and the mom said, "It looks like you two are a match made in heaven!" Luxury felt happy and thankful. With the help of the little girl and her mom, she managed to put all the matches back in the box. From that day on, Luxury and the little girl were the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a small girl named Mia. She had a fun costume that she loved to wear. It was light and easy to move in. Mia wore her costume every day, and it made her very happy.
One day, her mom told her to shut the door. Mia was so excited to go outside in her costume that she forgot. A big wind came and blew her costume away. Mia was very sad and cried.
Mia's mom found the costume and gave it back to her. She told Mia that she must remember to shut the door. Mia learned her lesson and always shut the door after that. She knew that if she listened to her mom, she could keep her costume safe and be happy.

Once upon a time, there was a pretty little girl named Lily. Lily liked to play in the woods behind her house. One sunny day, she went into the woods to find her friend, a big bear named Ben.
As Lily walked deeper into the woods, she saw Ben near a tree. She ran to him and said, "Hi, Ben! Let's play!" Ben was happy to see Lily and roared, "Yes, let's play, Lily!"
Together, they played hide and seek, and had lots of fun. As the sun began to set, Lily said, "I have to go home now, Ben. See you tomorrow!" Ben roared, "Bye, Lily! See you soon!" And so, Lily went back home, excited to play with Ben again the next day.
The dates of the earliest church cannot be verified , but a church building may have been constructed at the site of Old Pine Church as early as around 1814 , and possibly as early as 1792 .

The Wall Street Journal announced that on Saturday October 29 , it would begin incorporating digital book sales in its best seller lists . When the book debuted in The Wall Street Journal list on November 5 for the week ending October 30 , it was listed first in Hardcover Fiction , Fiction E-Books and Fiction Combined . It retained the hardcover lead the following week , but lost the other leads . After two weeks it was surpassed on the hardcover list as well . It remained on The Wall Street Journal Hardcover Fiction , Fiction E-Books and Fiction Combined best seller lists until the January 7 listing for the week ended on January 1 , 2012 .

Once upon a time, there was an ancient toy. It was old and had a cord. The toy could move when you pulled the cord. It was a little car. The car lived in a big toy box with many other toys. The toys loved to play together.
One day, the little car wanted to go on a big adventure. It asked its friend, the toy dog, to come along. They waited until the night when the boy who owned them was asleep. Then, they pulled the cord and the little car began to move. The toy dog jumped on the car and they went out of the toy box.
As they moved around the room, they saw something unexpected. A big, shiny toy robot was standing near the door. The robot said, "I can help you on your adventure." The little car and the toy dog were happy. They thought the robot would make their adventure more fun.
But then, the robot did something surprising. It picked up the little car and the toy dog and put them back in the toy box. The robot said, "It's not safe to go on adventures at night." The little car and the toy dog were sad, but they knew the robot was right. They decided to wait and have their adventure another day.

Once upon a time, there was a young barber. He had a small shop in town. Every day, he would cut hair and make people look nice.
One day, a boy came to the barber's shop. The boy said, "I want a haircut, but I don't want you to spoil it." The young barber smiled and said, "Don't worry, I will do my best."
As the barber started to cut the boy's hair, a big wind blew into the shop. The wind made a mess of the boy's hair. The barber was very sad because he thought he had spoiled the haircut. But the boy looked in the mirror and laughed. He said, "I love my hair now! It looks so fun and wild!" The young barber was happy that the boy liked his hair, even if it was not what he had planned.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tim. Tim loved to whistle all day long. He had a long tail and bright feathers. Tim lived in a big tree near a small house.
One day, Tim saw a bowl of cereal through the window of the small house. He was very hungry. He flew to the window and looked at the cereal. The window was open, so Tim went inside to eat the cereal.
As Tim ate the cereal, a little girl named Amy came into the room. She saw Tim and smiled. Amy liked Tim's long tail and happy whistle. From that day on, Tim and Amy became best friends. They played and whistled together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a kind little girl called Sarah. Every day she would go outside to play in the garden. One day, she saw a bee buzzing around her. Sarah stopped to watch the bee buzzing around in the sun. She smiled and said hello to the bee. Suddenly, the bee stopped and smiled back at Sarah.
Sarah got very excited and asked the bee if she wanted to play. The bee nodded her head and they started to play together.
They ran around the garden, played hide and seek and made each other laugh. Eventually, Sarah said it was time to go home. She gave the bee a big hug and said goodbye.
The bee smiled and waved as Sarah ran back home. Sarah was very happy that the bee was so kind and that they were able to play together.

Lily and Ben were friends who liked to play in the garden. They liked to dig and water the plants and look for bugs. One day, they saw a big red radish growing in the ground. They both wanted to pick it and eat it.
"I saw it first!" Lily said.
"No, I did!" Ben said.
They pulled on the radish from both sides, trying to get it out. They started to quarrel and shout at each other.
"Let go, it's mine!" Lily said.
"No, it's mine!" Ben said.
They pulled so hard that the radish snapped in half. They both fell back on the grass, holding their pieces. They looked at the radish and felt sad. It was not as nice as they thought. It was dirty and bitter and had a hole in it.
They looked at each other and felt sorry. They did not want to quarrel and hurt their friend. They wanted to share and have fun.
"I'm sorry, Lily," Ben said.
"I'm sorry, Ben," Lily said.
They hugged and made up. They threw away the radish and decided to play something else. They found a ball and a hoop and had a great time. They were happy and forgot about the radish. They were friends again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Molly. She loved looking up at the big moon in the night sky. Every night, she would sit on her balcony and admire the beautiful moon.
One night, something bad happened. There was a scary storm and the wind was blowing so hard! The trees on Mollyâs street were trebling, and Molly was scared.
Molly saw her mum, and ran to her. She said, âMummy, Iâm frightened! Will the moon stay safe?â
Mollyâs mum smiled and said, âOf course, the moon will stay safe. Donât worry, this storm will pass soon.â
Molly felt better after hearing her mumâs words. She hugged her mum and said, âThe moon is so beautiful. Iâm glad itâs safe!â 
Molly and her mum looked up at the sky and admired the moon. The storm had calmed down, and the moon was shining brightly. Molly smiled and said, âI wonât be scared of bad storms again.â

It was the night before Christmas, and Santa was getting ready to leave so he could deliver all the presents around the world. He was dressed in his red suit, and he made last minute checks of his reindeer, ensuring they were all ready to go. 
"Are all of you ready to leave?" He asked in a charming voice. His reindeer answered with a loud and excited, "Yes!!" 
Santa smiled and said, "Then, let us go! We have a lot of presents to deliver tonight." 
The reindeer spread their wings and flew off into the night. They were so excited to help Santa and make everyone around the world happy.
As they flew, Santa and his reindeer saw the most stunning sights. The stars twinkled brightly above them and the snow-covered houses below looked so pretty. 
Everyone was asleep, dreaming of the most wonderful surprises. Santa and his reindeer could not wait to make their dreams come true. 
Eventually, they all arrived at the last stop. The kids there were overjoyed with the presents and thanked Santa with the biggest smiles. 
It was time to leave. Santa, with a heart as big as his beard, thanked his reindeer and waved goodbye. He knew they would come back to him again next year and help make another Christmas special.

Much of the public imagery of the site details the ruthless manner in which the city dealt with its enemies . A 16 by 4 metres ( 52 by 13 ft ) stucco sculpture rising from the fourth to fifth terraces depicts a skeletal death god carrying the severed head of a lord of Palenque in one hand . A frieze on the fifth terrace probably displayed Toniná 's most distinguished victims , dozens of fragments of this frieze were discovered in the plaza below . This frieze was carved from the local sandstone but its style is that of Palenque , suggesting that captured artists carried out the work .

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a brilliant girl named Amy. She had a big toy box full of fun toys. One day, she found a new toy she had never seen before. It was a hook. Amy looked at the hook and thought it was very cool.
Amy went to her mom and said, "Mom, look at my new toy! It's a hook. What can I do with it?" Her mom said, "Amy, mind where you put the hook. You can use it to pick up your toys and hang them on the wall."
Amy was very happy with her new toy. She used the hook to pick up her toys and put them on the wall. Her room looked very nice and clean. Amy's mom was very proud of her. She said, "Amy, you did a great job with the hook. Your room is so tidy now."
Amy felt very happy and proud. She loved her new hook and how it helped her clean her room. From that day on, Amy always minded where she put her toys and used the hook to keep her room clean. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little sheep. The sheep had soft wool. She liked to play in the grass. One day, she went for a walk. She wanted to meet new friends.
As she walked, she saw a big, angry dog. The dog barked loud. The sheep was scared. She thought the dog would be mean. But then, something unexpected happened.
The angry dog stopped barking. He looked at the sheep's soft wool. He touched it with his nose. The dog was not angry anymore. He liked the soft wool. The sheep and the dog became friends. They played in the grass and were happy.

Tom and Lily are in the car with Mom and Dad. They are going to the park to play. Tom is happy, but Lily is not. She hates the park. She hates the swings, the slides, and the sand. She wants to stay home and watch TV.
"Look, Lily, there is a big billboard with a picture of a clown!" Mom says, pointing out the window. "Do you like clowns?"
Lily shakes her head. She hates clowns too. They are scary and loud. She does not want to see them.
"I like clowns!" Tom says. "They make funny faces and jokes. They are fun!"
Lily does not answer. She looks away from the billboard. She sees a clear sky with white clouds. She wishes she could fly away like a bird.
"Are we there yet?" Tom asks. He is excited to get to the park.
"Almost, honey," Dad says. "Just a few more minutes."
Lily sighs. She hopes the park will be closed. She hopes there will be no other kids. She hopes there will be no clowns. She hates the park. She hates everything.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom had a toy named Mr. Flexible. Mr. Flexible was a long, bendy toy that could twist and turn. Tom loved to play with Mr. Flexible every day.
One day, Tom saw a leak in his room. Water was coming from the ceiling. Tom was sad and didn't know what to do. He looked at Mr. Flexible and had an idea. Tom said, "Mr. Flexible, can you help me bring a bucket to catch the water?"
Mr. Flexible nodded and twisted his body to make a handle. Tom picked up a bucket and put it under the leak. He used Mr. Flexible's handle to hold the bucket in place. The water fell into the bucket and the room stayed dry.
Tom was very happy that Mr. Flexible helped him. They became even better friends. Tom knew that Mr. Flexible would always be there to help him when he needed it. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a nurse. She was very nice. She took care of people when they were sick. She had a big heart and loved her job.
One day, a boy named Timmy got sick. He did not want to take his medicine. He said, "No, I refuse!" The nurse tried to make him feel better. She told him a story about a green frog who was envious of a red bird that could fly high in the sky.
The green frog wanted to fly too. So, the red bird helped him. They became best friends. Timmy liked the story. He felt better and took his medicine. The nurse was happy.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends who loved to go on adventures. They lived in a city that had a big river and lots of exciting things to explore.
One day, the friends went to the river to find a special surprise. There was a very big and lively yacht floating on the water. They were very excited!
The friends ran up to the yacht and began to explore. They went all around the boat and discovered many wonderful things. They even found a big steering wheel!
Suddenly, a scary storm began to blow and the wind started to howl. The friends were scared and decided to run away. They turned to leave, but one of them heard a loud noise.
The wind had destroyed the yacht! The friends were sad and felt bad for what had happened. But soon enough, the sun came back out, and the river was still just as lively as before. 
The friends smiled and said, "Let's go explore someplace else!" And so they did.

Once upon a time, there was a charming little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy missile. One day, he wanted to dress up his missile to make it look funny.
As Tim put clothes on his missile, something unexpected happened. The missile started to talk! Tim was so surprised. The missile said, "Hi, Tim! I can help you with your games."
Tim was happy to have a new friend. They played together all day long. But then, the missile said, "I have a secret to tell you. I am not really a missile. I am a magic wand!" Tim couldn't believe it.
From that day on, Tim and his magic wand had many fun adventures. They played dress up, and Tim knew that his charming missile was truly special.

The greatest disaster for the Romanian expeditionary force on the Eastern Front came at Stalingrad , where , during the Soviet counter-offensive of November 1942 , the thinly spread forces of the Third Army ( deployed north of Stalingrad ) and of the Fourth Army ( deployed south of Stalingrad ) were attacked by vastly superior Soviet forces and suffered combined losses of some 158, 000 personnel .

Mosley was attracted by the sport , and when his career as a barrister was bringing in sufficient money , he started racing cars himself . The sport 's indifference to his background appealed to Mosley :

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to bring things to her friends. One day, Lily found a shiny crystal. It was very pretty and she wanted to show it to her best friend, Tim.
Lily went to Tim's house and gave him the crystal. Tim thought it was so cool! They decided to go on an adventure to find more crystals. They walked and walked until they found a big tree with lots of fruit.
The fruit looked yummy, so they picked some to eat. But when they tasted it, it was sour! They made funny faces and laughed. Even though the fruit was sour, they had a great time on their adventure. And they always remembered the day they found the shiny crystal.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy octopus. He lived in the sea and loved to sleep all day. He had many legs and was very big. One day, he met a little fish who was very sad.
"Hi, little fish," said the lazy octopus. "Why are you sad?"
"I can't number my friends," said the little fish. "I want to play with them, but they are too many."
The lazy octopus wanted to help the little fish. He used his big legs to count the fish's friends. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight. There were eight friends.
"Little fish, you have eight friends," said the lazy octopus. "Now you can play with them."
The little fish was very happy. He played with his friends all day. The lazy octopus watched them play and felt happy too. From that day, the lazy octopus was not lazy anymore. He helped his friends in the sea and had many fun days.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun. One day, she saw a ball. It was big and heavy. She wanted to play with the ball, but it was too heavy for her to lift.
A nice dog came by and said, "Hi, Lily! I can help you with the heavy ball." The dog used his nose to push the ball. They played together and had lots of fun.
Suddenly, the ball started to get bigger and bigger. It was so big that it made Lily and the dog fall down. They looked at each other and laughed. The big, heavy ball was not a ball at all. It was a big, round, bouncy house! Lily and the dog went inside and played all day.

Once upon a time, in a big school, there was a blackboard. The blackboard was very big and all the kids loved it. Every day, the teacher would write on the blackboard with colorful chalks. The kids would watch and learn many things.
One day, a little boy named Timmy came to the school. Timmy was scared because he did not know anyone. He saw the big blackboard and thought it was fun. The teacher told Timmy, "I recommend you to draw something on the blackboard, so you can make new friends."
So, Timmy took a piece of chalk and drew a big, happy sun on the blackboard. The other kids saw Timmy's drawing and liked it. They came to Timmy and said, "We like your drawing! Can we be friends?" Timmy smiled and said, "Yes, let's be friends!"
From that day on, Timmy had many friends and was not scared anymore. The big blackboard helped Timmy learn that it is good to share and be kind to others. And the kids learned that they should always welcome new friends with a happy heart.

Once upon a time there was a camp in the woods. The camp was full of happy people, but there was one little boy who was different. He was deaf. He liked playing by himself in the woods. He could not hear the birds singing and the breeze rustling the leaves.
One day, he was playing in the woods when he suddenly heard a sound. It was a loud crack and it made him jump. When he looked around, he saw the ground had split in two! He was so scared, but then he noticed a little mouse had come out of the crack. The mouse was walking away, so the little boy followed it. 
The mouse hopped right into a camp fire and split into two. It was so funny! The little boy was amazed, he had never seen anything like it before. 
The little boy watched in amazement as the two mice ran off in different directions. He was so excited to have seen this strange thing happen in the woods. He smiled and went back to his camp, happy to have been able to experience something so new and wonderful.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there lived a reliable dog named Buddy. Buddy was a good friend to all the animals in the forest. One day, a little bird named Chirpy came to Buddy and said, "Buddy, can you help me? I drop my toy in the river."
Buddy said, "Don't worry, Chirpy. I will help you." So, Buddy and Chirpy went to the river to find the toy. They looked and looked, but they could not see the toy. Then, Buddy had an idea. He asked a fish friend to help them look in the water.
The fish friend found the toy and gave it back to Chirpy. Chirpy was very happy and said, "Thank you, Buddy, and thank you, fish friend. You both are very reliable friends." And they all played together in the big forest, happy to have each other.

One day, a cat and her baby were walking in the woods. The baby cat was very small and had a long tail. They were looking for food. The baby cat asked her mother, "When will I become big like you?"
The mother cat said, "You will become big when you learn to be kind and help others."
As they walked, they saw a small bird stuck in a tree. The baby cat wanted to help, but she was scared. The mother cat said, "Help the bird, and you will grow."
The baby cat used her long tail to help the bird. The bird was happy and said, "Thank you!"
After helping the bird, the baby cat became big like her mother. The mother cat was proud. The baby cat learned that being kind and helping others makes you grow.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to wear pretty dresses. One day, she saw a beautiful, modern dress in her sister's room. It was all shiny and new. Lily really wanted to wear it, so she decided to ask her sister if she could borrow the dress.
Lily went to her sister and asked, "Can I borrow your new dress, please?" Her sister was very kind and said, "Yes, you can borrow it, but be careful not to get it dirty."
Lily was so happy and put on the modern dress. She looked in the mirror and felt like a princess. She twirled around and danced all day. When it was time to give the dress back to her sister, Lily carefully took it off and said, "Thank you for letting me borrow your dress. I had so much fun wearing it!"
Her sister smiled and said, "You're welcome, Lily. I'm glad you enjoyed it!" From that day on, Lily and her sister shared their dresses and had many fun days playing dress-up together.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play in Lily's room. Lily has a big carpet. The carpet is soft and pink. Tom likes to watch the cars on the carpet. He makes vroom vroom sounds.
One day, Lily's mom says, "Lily, you have to share your carpet with Tom. He is your guest." Lily does not like to share. She says, "No, mom. It is my carpet. Tom can watch, but he cannot touch."
Tom feels sad. He says, "Lily, please let me play with the cars. They are so fun. I will be careful." Lily says, "No, Tom. They are my cars. You can watch, but you cannot touch."
Tom gets angry. He says, "Lily, you are not a good friend. You are mean and selfish. I don't want to watch. I want to play." He grabs a car from the carpet. Lily screams, "Tom, give it back. It is mine."
Lily and Tom start to fight. They pull and push each other. They knock over the lamp. The lamp falls on the carpet. The carpet catches fire. Lily and Tom are scared. They run out of the room. Lily's mom smells the smoke. She calls the firemen. The firemen come and put out the fire. But the carpet is ruined. The cars are melted. Lily and Tom cry. They are in trouble. They are not friends anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She loved to dress up in her mom's clothes. One day, she found a magic star in her room. She made a wish to the star. She wished to be healthy and strong.
Amy's mom saw her dress up and knew she was trying to be like her. She thought of a great idea. She told Amy that they would play a game. The game would help her be healthy and strong, just like her wish.
Every day, they played the game. They would run, jump, and eat good food. Amy loved the game. She felt healthy and strong. One day, her mom gave her a special dress. It was for being healthy and strong. Amy was so happy. Her wish came true.

Once upon a time there was a little boy who loved to write. He had lots of paper and pens he used to make lots of stories and pictures. One day, he was writing a story about a powerful fairy. But then something happened! As he was writing, junk started to fly around him. It was huge, bigger than the boy! It was so powerful it filled up the whole room.
The little boy was scared. He tried to write but the junk kept getting in the way. He tried to move but it was too strong. Then, he heard a voice. It said, "Do not be scared, little boy. I can help you!" It was the powerful fairy from his story!
The fairy waved its wand and the junk disappeared. The room was clean and the boy felt much better. The fairy said to him, "Help keep your room clean. Don't let junk get in the way of your story!" The boy thanked the fairy and kept writing. He never had to worry about the junk again.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the store with his mom. He was very happy because he was going to receive a new toy. At the store, Tim saw a warm, soft teddy bear that he really wanted. But his mom said he could not have it. Tim was sad.
Then, Tim saw a big box of soap. He had an idea! He put the soap on the floor and waited. When his mom walked by, she slipped on the soap and fell down. Tim thought she would be mad, but she just laughed.
Tim's mom saw how much fun he had with the soap, and she let him receive the warm teddy bear. They both laughed and played with the soap and the teddy bear all day. And in the end, the soap was more fun than the toy Tim wanted.

Filming started on September 23 , 2004 , and concentrated on Enterprise ship scenes on the standing sets for the first two days . After that production moved to the cave sets , which were dressed with Vulcan artifacts . On the fourth day of production , those artifacts were removed so that the same sets could use used to film the visions that Archer has of Surak . All exterior scenes in the Vulcan desert-like Forge were shot on a soundstage . The final day of filming took place on October 1 , when all the scenes set in the Vulcan High Command were filmed . These involved only Foxworth , Graham and Rubinstein as well as a handful of extras .

Once upon a time there was a small bird named Spark. He was very troubled and he was looking for something to save him. One day, Spark decided to fly away and find a place where he could feel safe. He flew far into the sky until he finally found a perfect spot that made him feel at peace. But then trouble came. The wind suddenly got very strong and Spark felt like he was going to get blown away. 
Frightened, Spark quickly looked around for something to hold on to. Just then, a friendly voice called out, "Grab my hand and I will save you!" Startled, Spark saw a little girl smiling at him. He quickly grabbed her hand and she safely guided him to a nearby tree. 
The little girl smiled, "I knew I could help! I knew you needed to be saved. Now Spark you too can help others who need saving."
The moral of the story is that you shouldn't wait for someone else to help you. If you can help others, do it. Everyone needs to be saved sometimes, and it's important to be generous and kind.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play with toys and books. Lily has a big doll that can talk. Ben has a small car that can move. They share their toys and have fun.
One day, Lily and Ben receive a letter from their grandma. Grandma lives far away, on the other side of the sea. She sends them a gift for their birthday. Lily and Ben are happy and excited. They open the letter and find a card and a box.
The card says: "Happy birthday, Lily and Ben! I love you very much. I hope you like your gift. It is something special for you. Love, Grandma."
Lily and Ben open the box and see a fluffy teddy bear. The teddy bear has a red bow and a heart on its chest. It also has a button on its ear. Lily and Ben hug the teddy bear and thank Grandma.
"Let's see what the teddy bear can do," Lily says. She presses the button on its ear. The teddy bear says: "Hello, I am your new friend. I can sing and tell stories. Do you want to hear one?"
Lily and Ben nod and smile. They listen to the teddy bear's voice. But Ben notices something strange. He says: "Lily, the teddy bear only talks in one ear. The other ear is quiet. Why is that?"
Lily looks at the teddy bear and sees a small tag on its other ear. She reads it and says: "Oh, Ben, the teddy bear is deaf in one ear. That means it cannot hear from that side. But it can still talk and sing and tell stories. It is still a nice teddy bear."
Ben nods and says: "You are right, Lily. The teddy bear is still a nice teddy bear. And it is a special gift from Grandma. She knows we love teddy bears. And we love her too."
Lily and Ben hug the teddy bear again and say: "Thank you, Grandma. We love you and your gift. You are the best Grandma ever."

Once upon a time, there was a noisy bird. The bird liked to sing all the time. The bird had many friends who liked to listen to the bird sing.
One day, the bird's friend, a cat, wanted to send a gift to another friend. The cat asked the bird to help. The bird said yes and took the gift to send it far away.
The bird flew for a long time to send the gift. When the gift got to the friend, they were very happy. The bird sang a happy song and flew back home. The cat and the bird were happy they could help a friend.

One day, a girl named Mia found a wet notebook in the park. She wanted to find the owner, but she did not know how. She looked at the notebook and saw that it had many drawings inside. Mia thought that the owner must miss the notebook very much.
She managed to show the notebook to her friends. They all tried to help find the owner. They asked people in the park if they lost a notebook. After a long time, they met a boy named Tom who said the notebook was his.
Tom was very happy to get his notebook back. He thanked Mia and her friends for their help. Mia felt good that she managed to help Tom. The moral of the story is that it is nice to help others when they need it.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. She was very shy. Every day she had to go the barber shop to get her hair cut. Jane was scared because the barber was very sharp with his knifes and scissors.
One day, Jane went to the barber shop, trying to be brave. The barber said,"How would you like me to cut your hair?". Jane didn't want her hair to be cut too short so she said,"Can you be a bit gentle?".
The barber thought Jane was too shy and didn't like her. He was sharp with his scissors and cut her hair very short. Jane was sad. She ran out of the shop, tears rolling down her cheeks. 
But later that day, Jane found out she hadn't been the brbarber's only customer. He had treated all of his customers like that! Jane was so relieved and her sadness quickly disappeared. From that day on, she was brave and wasn't scared every time she went to the barber.

One day, a little girl named Mia was getting ready to play outside. She put on her hat, her shoes, and her sunglasses. But she forgot one important thing: her lotion! Her mom saw her and said, "Mia, don't forget your lotion!"
Mia said, "Oops! I need to spray the lotion on my skin." She took the lotion and sprayed it on her arms and legs. Her mom helped her spray it on her face too. Now, Mia was ready to go outside and have fun.
Mia played in the sun all day. She was happy that she had the lotion to protect her skin. When it was time to go inside, Mia said, "Thank you, Mom, for reminding me about the lotion!" Her mom smiled and said, "You're welcome, Mia. Now you can play outside and be safe."

Once upon a time, there was a humble fisherman. He lived in a small house by the sea. Every day, he went to catch fish in his little boat.
One day, while he was fishing, a big fish came to him and said, "Please, do not catch me. I have a family." The fisherman was kind and said, "Okay, I will let you go."
The big fish was happy and said, "Thank you, humble fisherman. I will help you too." The fish told the fisherman where to find many fish. The fisherman went there and caught a lot of fish.
The fisherman and the big fish became friends. They played and talked in the sea. The fisherman was never sad or hungry again. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a smart little dog named Max. Max loved to watch the sun go up and down every day. It made him feel happy and warm.
One hot day, Max saw a little boy named Tim. Tim was very sad. Max walked up to Tim and asked, "Why are you sad?"
Tim looked at Max and said, "I lost my ball." Max wanted to help Tim find his ball. They looked under a big tree and behind a small bush but they could not find the ball.
Finally, Max saw the ball near a pond. He ran to the pond and picked up the ball with his mouth. Tim was so happy to see the ball again. He hugged Max and said, "Thank you, Max! You are a very smart dog!"
From that day on, Max and Tim became best friends. They played together every day and watched the sun go up and down. And they always felt the warm heat of the sun on their faces.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the sea with his mom. They wanted to see the water and the fish. Tim was very happy. He hoped to see a playful dolphin in the water.
As they walked near the water, Tim and his mom observed a big rock. Tim's mom said, "Remember this rock, Tim. It will help us find our way back." Tim nodded, and they kept walking.
After a while, they saw a playful dolphin in the water. Tim was so excited! He and his mom watched the dolphin jump and splash. When it was time to go home, they found the big rock again. It helped them find their way back, just like mom said.

One day, a cheerful boy named Tim had a pencil. He liked to draw with his pencil. Tim had a friend named Sam. Sam also liked to draw. They both wanted to draw a big picture together.
But they had a problem. They only had one pencil. They did not know how to share the pencil. Tim wanted to draw a big tree. Sam wanted to draw a big house. They could not agree on what to draw.
Then, something unexpected happened. Tim broke the pencil in two parts by accident. Now, they each had a part of the pencil. Tim and Sam were happy. They could both draw what they wanted. In the end, they drew a big tree next to a big house. They were both very happy with their big picture.

Once upon a time, in a lovely big garden, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia had a small, round, red ball. She loved to play with her ball every day. One day, Mia's ball went to the side of the garden where there were many trees and bushes.

Once upon a time, a boy named Tim had a toy boat. He liked to play with his boat and sail it in the water. One day, Tim met a girl named Sue. Sue had a toy rocket that could fly into space. They both wanted to play together.

Cindy was a happy three year old girl. She and her mom were camping in the big tent in the backyard. She was excited to be sleeping in the tent.

Cindy was comforted and started to feel sleepy again. Soon she was fast asleep in the tent, safe in her mom's arms.

One day, a famous cat named Tom went to the park. He saw a big glass by a tree. Tom was very thirsty, so he walked to the glass to drink. As he got close, he leaned on the tree to look inside the glass.

Sue and Tom became good friends. They played in the park all day. And from that day on, they always checked the glass before they drank from it.

Once upon a time, in a small park, there was a little stand. The stand had many toys for kids to play with. Every day, children came to the park to play with the toys from the stand. They were always happy and had a lot of fun.
One day, it was a very cold and wet day. The stand was feeling miserable. It did not like the cold and wet weather. The stand started to complain, "Oh, I don't like this cold and wet day. I wish it was sunny and warm again."
The next day, the sun came out and it was warm. The stand was happy again. The children came back to the park to play with the toys. The stand did not complain anymore. It knew that sometimes there would be cold and wet days, but the sun would always come back.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play at the park. One day, he went to the park with his mom. He was very happy.
At the park, Tim saw a big dog. He was worried. The dog came closer to Tim. He realized the dog wanted to play with him. Tim started to play with the dog, but he forgot to tell his mom.
His mom looked for him and could not find him. She was very worried. Tim did not know his mom was looking for him. He was having fun with the dog.
In the end, Tim's mom could not find him. She was very sad. Tim was lost and did not know how to go home. The dog went away, and Tim was all alone. This story had a bad ending.

On October 24 , cool , dry air entered the newly developed convection , and as a result it transitioned into a subtropical cyclone . Gilda became the first tropical system to pass through a subtropical stage prior to becoming extratropical . The large circulation continued northeast before becoming extratropical on October 27 . The remnants of Gilda intensified as they tracked near Atlantic Canada , attaining a central pressure of 968 mbar ( hPa ; 28. 58 inHg ) near Cape Race , Newfoundland . The system eventually dissipated near southern Greenland on October 29 .

Once upon a time, there was a cool cat named Kitty. Kitty loved to play with her ball and climb trees. One day, she found a new friend, Doggy. Doggy was very nice and they liked to play together.
Kitty said to Doggy, "Let's play more and increase our fun!" Doggy agreed and they played all day long. They ran, jumped, and laughed together. The sun was shining and they were very happy.
After playing, Kitty and Doggy were very tired. Kitty gave Doggy a massage to help him feel better. Doggy said, "Thank you, Kitty. That feels so nice!" They became best friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Jack and Jill. They were playing in the garden. Suddenly a dark cloud came and covered them. It was a bad cloud and it made a loud sound.
Jack said, "What is that? It is scary."
Jill said, "I think it is a threat."
Jack and Jill were very scared. They started to cry. Just then, a magical creature appeared in front of them. It said, "Do not be afraid, I am here to help. I know how to make the bad threat go away."
The magical creature waved its hand and there was a big flash of light. The dark cloud disappeared. Jack and Jill were very happy and thanked the magical creature. It smiled and said, "You are welcome. The bad threat is gone now and it will not come back."

Once upon a time, there was a small cabin in the woods. Inside the cabin lived a polite bear named Ben. Ben loved to measure things. He measured his bed, his chair, and his toys. One day, he decided to measure how tall he was.
Ben went outside and met his friend Cat. "Hi Cat, can you help me measure how tall I am?" Ben asked. Cat said, "Sure, Ben! Let's use this stick to measure you." Cat held the stick next to Ben and marked how tall he was.
After they finished, Ben said, "Thank you for helping me, Cat. You are a good friend." Cat smiled and said, "You're welcome, Ben. It's nice to help friends."
The moral of the story is: It's good to be polite and help your friends when they need it.

According to the Church , people have a right to private property . However , ownership makes that person " a steward " who is expected to make it " fruitful " or profitable in a way that benefits others after that person has first taken care of their family . Private property and the common good are seen as complementary elements that exist for the purpose of strengthening society . The taking of another 's private property " in obvious and urgent necessity " as " the only way to provide for immediate , essential needs ( food , shelter , clothing ) " is not considered by the Church to be stealing . The concept of slavery as private property is condemned by the Church , which classifies it as the stealing of a person 's human rights .

Once upon a time there was a boy named Josh. He was very happy because he was going to arrive at a new place. It was a place to do some work.

Tommy loved his scooter. He liked to ride it fast and make loud noises. He did not like to share it with anyone. One day, he saw his friend Lily at the park. Lily had a new scooter. It was shiny and pink and had a bell.

Lily's mom saw what happened. She was very mad. She ran after Tommy and caught him. She took the scooter from him and gave it back to Lily. She scolded Tommy and told him to go home.
Tommy did not listen. He tried to stand and get the scooter again. He did not see the big rock in front of him. He tripped and fell. He hit his head and his knee. He bled and cried. He had no scooter and no friend. He was very sad and sorry. It was a gloomy day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a big bookshelf in his room. He loved to read books and play with his toys.
One day, Tim was playing with his ball. He threw the ball and it started to roll. The ball rolled and rolled until it hit the bookshelf. Tim was scared. He thought the bookshelf might fall. But, he was lucky. The bookshelf did not fall. Tim was happy.
Tim learned that he should be careful when playing near the bookshelf. He did not want the books to fall or the bookshelf to break. From that day on, Tim played with his ball far away from the bookshelf. He knew that it was important to be safe and protect his books. Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a boy named Tim. He had a rare toy, a big red car. Tim loved his car very much and played with it every day.
One day, Tim was playing with his car near a big tree. He saw a small nail on the ground. Tim thought it would be fun to use the nail to make marks on his car. He scratched the car with the nail, making it dirty and full of marks. Tim's mom saw this and felt sad.
Tim's mom said, "Tim, you should not hurt your car like that. It is not nice to make things dirty." She gave him a cloth to wipe the car clean. Tim wiped the car and saw how nice it looked again. He learned that it is important to take care of the things we love.

One day, a girl named Sally had a huge blouse. She loved to wear it all the time. Her mom told her to be careful, but Sally liked to play and run in her blouse.
Sally went to the park with her big blouse. She saw her friend, Tom. They played catch with a ball. They laughed and had fun. Then, the ball went far away. Sally ran to get it.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim liked to play outside in his yard. One day, it was very cold and icy outside. But Tim still wanted to play.
While playing, Tim noticed a small animal stuck in a drain. The animal was cold and scared. Tim wanted to help the animal, so he went to his mom. He told her about the animal in the drain. His mom said they should help it.
Tim and his mom got the animal out of the drain. They took it inside their warm house. The animal was happy and safe now. Tim felt good for helping the animal. The moral of the story is to always help others when they are in need.

Once upon a time, there was a good cat named Tom. Tom lived in an old house with his best friend, a little girl named Sue.
One day, Sue found a big box in the old house. Inside the box, she saw a record. Sue was very happy. She wanted to play the record and dance with Tom.

Tim and Lily were playing in the park with their toys. Tim had a red motorcycle that made loud noises. Lily had a doll that she liked to dress up. Tim wanted to play with Lily's doll, but Lily said no.
"Give me your doll, Lily. I want to see how she looks on my motorcycle," Tim said. He was bossy and did not like to share.
"No, Tim. She is my doll and you have your motorcycle. Go away and play with your own toy," Lily said. She was angry and did not want to listen.
Tim did not give up. He tried to grab the doll from Lily's hands. Lily pulled back and screamed. "Help, help! Tim is taking my doll!"
A man who was walking his dog heard Lily's scream. He came over to see what was wrong. He saw Tim and Lily fighting over the doll. He frowned and said, "Stop that, children. You should not fight over toys. You should share and be nice to each other."
Tim and Lily looked at the man. They saw his big dog and his shiny badge. He was a policeman. They felt scared and blinked their eyes. They did not want to get in trouble.
"Sorry, sir. We were just playing," Tim said. He let go of the doll and gave it back to Lily.
"Sorry, sir. We will not fight again," Lily said. She hugged her doll and smiled.
The policeman nodded and said, "That's good, children. Now, why don't you play together and take turns with your toys? Maybe you can show me how your motorcycle works, Tim. And maybe you can tell me your doll's name, Lily."
Tim and Lily agreed. They thanked the policeman and his dog. They decided to be friends and share their toys. They had fun playing in the park with the motorcycle and the doll.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy was very careful with her things. One day, she got a big box. She was so happy! She could not wait to unpack the box.

Once upon a time there was a fish. He was very busy swimming around all the time. One day, he wanted to relax and take a break. He started to swim to the surface of the water, but suddenly, something else had appeared. It was a big hand, slapping the water!

Once upon a time, there was a big country. In this country, there was a town. In this town, there was a girl named Sue. Sue liked to prepare food. She liked to make food smooth.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to play in his backyard. One day, it began to rain. Tim was sad because he could not play outside. He looked out the window and saw his toy car in the rain.

One day, a little girl named Sue went to the beach with her mom. They saw the big blue sea and the amazing waves. Sue was very happy. She wanted to play in the water and wash her hands and feet in the waves. "Mom, can I go play in the water?" Sue asked. Her mom said, "Yes, but be careful."

In the following days there were several failed attacks and counter-attacks by both sides . The Turks were the first to try during the Second attack on Anzac Cove on 27 April , followed by the ANZACs who tried to advance overnight 1 / 2 May . The Turkish Third attack on Anzac Cove on 19 May was the worst defeat of them all , with around ten thousand casualties , including three thousand dead . The next four months consisted of only local or diversionary attacks , until 6 August when the ANZACs , in connection with the Landing at Suvla Bay , attacked Chunuk Bair with only limited success . The Turks never succeeded in driving the Australians and New Zealanders back into the sea . Similarly , the ANZACs never broke out of their beachhead . Instead , in December 1915 , after eight months of fighting , they evacuated the peninsula .

Lily looked around. She saw a red scarf on a bench. It belonged to a lady who was reading a book. Lily ran to the bench and took the scarf.

Lily was scared. She ran back to Ben with the scarf. The lady followed her.
"Give me back my scarf, you crazy girl!" the lady said. She reached for the scarf.
But Lily did not want to give it back. She wanted to use it for a flag. She held it tight and ran around the castle.
"Stop, stop!" Ben said. He did not like the lady. He did not like the shouting. He wanted to relax and play with the castle.
He had an idea. He took some sand and threw it at the lady. The sand got in her eyes and mouth. She coughed and blinked.

Lily and Ben saw their chance. They put the scarf on the castle as a flag. They smiled and hugged.

Once upon a time, there was a fancy cat named Tom. Tom loved to play games with his friends. One day, Tom decided to play a new game with his friends. They wanted to see who could drink water the fastest.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She had a pale blue dress that she loved to wear. One sunny day, Amy went to her garden to plant a bulb. She dug a hole, put the bulb in it, and covered it with dirt.
A few days later, Amy saw a worm in her garden. The worm said, "Hello, Amy! I live in the ground, and I saw your bulb. I think it will rot if you don't water it." Amy thanked the worm and ran to get some water. She poured the water on the bulb, hoping it would not rot.
After a while, the bulb grew into a beautiful flower. The flower was so big and colorful. Amy was so happy that she had listened to the worm. The worm came out of the ground and said, "Good job, Amy!
